        uint256 amountToSell,
        uint256 amountToRaise,
        uint256 discount,
        address indexed forgoneCollateralReceiver,
        address indexed auctionIncomeRecipient,
        uint256 auctionDeadline
    );

    event BuyCollateral(uint256 indexed id, uint256 adjustedBid, uint256 collateralBought);
    event SettleAuction(uint256 indexed id, uint256 leftoverCollateral);
    event TerminateAuctionPrematurely(uint256 indexed id, address terminator, uint256 leftoverCollateral);

    constructor(address safeEngine_, bytes32 collateralType_) public {
        authorizedAccounts[msg.sender] = 1;
        emit AddAuthorization(msg.sender);

        safeEngine = ISAFEEngineLike(safeEngine_);
        collateralType = collateralType_;

        discount = WAD;
        lowerCollateralMedianDeviation = WAD;
        upperCollateralMedianDeviation = WAD;
        lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation = WAD;
        upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation = WAD;
        minSystemCoinMedianDeviation = WAD;

        totalAuctionLength = uint48(3 days);
        minimumBid = 1;
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/no-ether-accepted");
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/fallback-not-allowed");
    }

    // --- Authorization ---
    function addAuthorization(address account) external isAuthorized {
        authorizedAccounts[account] = 1;
        emit AddAuthorization(account);
    }

    function removeAuthorization(address account) external isAuthorized {
        authorizedAccounts[account] = 0;
        emit RemoveAuthorization(account);
    }

    // --- Admin ---
    function modifyParameters(bytes32 parameter, address data) external isAuthorized {
        if (parameter == bytes32("oracleRelayer")) {
            oracleRelayer = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("collateralFSM")) {
            (address source, bool ok) = _tryReadAddress(data, bytes4(0x20531bc9));
            require(ok && source != address(0), "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/collateral-fsm-invalid-value");
            collateralFSM = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("systemCoinOracle")) {
            systemCoinOracle = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("liquidationEngine")) {
            liquidationEngine = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("safeEngine")) {
            safeEngine = ISAFEEngineLike(data);
        } else {
            revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/modify-unrecognized-param");
        }

        emit ModifyParameters(parameter, data);
    }

    function modifyParameters(bytes32 parameter, uint256 data) external isAuthorized {
        if (parameter == bytes32("discount")) {
            require(data >= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/no-discount-offered");
            discount = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("lowerCollateralMedianDeviation")) {
            require(data <= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-lower-collateral-median-deviation");
            lowerCollateralMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("upperCollateralMedianDeviation")) {
            require(data <= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-upper-collateral-median-deviation");
            upperCollateralMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation")) {
            require(data <= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-lower-system-coin-median-deviation");
            lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation")) {
            require(data <= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-upper-system-coin-median-deviation");
            upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("minSystemCoinMedianDeviation")) {
            minSystemCoinMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("minimumBid")) {
            minimumBid = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("totalAuctionLength")) {
            totalAuctionLength = uint48(data);
        } else {
            revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/modify-unrecognized-param");
        }

        emit ModifyParameters(parameter, data);
    }

    // --- Auction Lifecycle ---
    function startAuction(
        address forgoneCollateralReceiver_,
        address auctionIncomeRecipient_,
        uint256 amountToSell_,
        uint256 amountToRaise_,
        uint256 initialBid_
    ) external isAuthorized returns (uint256 id) {
        require(amountToSell_ > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/no-collateral-for-sale");
        require(amountToRaise_ > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/null-amount-to-raise");

        id = _add(auctionsStarted, 1);
        auctionsStarted = id;

        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        auction.raisedAmount = initialBid_;
        auction.soldAmount = 0;
        auction.amountToSell = amountToSell_;
        auction.amountToRaise = amountToRaise_;
        auction.auctionDeadline = uint48(_add(block.timestamp, uint256(totalAuctionLength)));
        auction.forgoneCollateralReceiver = forgoneCollateralReceiver_;
        auction.auctionIncomeRecipient = auctionIncomeRecipient_;

        _transferCollateral(msg.sender, address(this), amountToSell_);

        emit StartAuction(
            id,
            initialBid_,
            amountToSell_,
            amountToRaise_,
            discount,
            forgoneCollateralReceiver_,
            auctionIncomeRecipient_,
            uint256(auction.auctionDeadline)
        );
    }

    function buyCollateral(uint256 id, uint256 systemCoinsToBid) external {
        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        require(auction.amountToSell > 0 && auction.amountToRaise > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/inexistent-auction");
        require(systemCoinsToBid > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-bid");

        (uint256 collateralBought, uint256 adjustedBid) = getCollateralBought(id, systemCoinsToBid);
        require(collateralBought > 0 && adjustedBid > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-bid");

        uint256 remainingToRaise = auction.amountToRaise > auction.raisedAmount
            ? _sub(auction.amountToRaise, auction.raisedAmount)
            : 0;

        if (adjustedBid > remainingToRaise) adjustedBid = remainingToRaise;
        require(adjustedBid > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/null-adjusted-bid");
        if (adjustedBid < minimumBid && remainingToRaise > minimumBid) {
            revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-bid");
        }

        auction.raisedAmount = _add(auction.raisedAmount, adjustedBid);
        auction.soldAmount = _add(auction.soldAmount, collateralBought);

        _transferInternalCoins(msg.sender, auction.auctionIncomeRecipient, adjustedBid);
        _transferCollateral(address(this), msg.sender, collateralBought);

        emit BuyCollateral(id, adjustedBid, collateralBought);

        _removeCoinsFromAuction(adjustedBid);

        if (auction.raisedAmount >= auction.amountToRaise || auction.soldAmount >= auction.amountToSell) {
            uint256 leftover = remainingAmountToSell(id);
            if (leftover > 0) {
                _transferCollateral(address(this), auction.forgoneCollateralReceiver, leftover);
            }

            emit SettleAuction(id, leftover);
            delete bids[id];
        }
    }

    function settleAuction(uint256 id) external {
        id;
        // Deliberately left as a no-op for interface compatibility.
    }

    function terminateAuctionPrematurely(uint256 id) external isAuthorized {
        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        require(auction.amountToSell > 0 && auction.amountToRaise > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/inexistent-auction");

        uint256 remainingToRaise = auction.amountToRaise > auction.raisedAmount
            ? _sub(auction.amountToRaise, auction.raisedAmount)
            : 0;
        uint256 leftoverCollateral = remainingAmountToSell(id);

        if (remainingToRaise > 0) {
            _removeCoinsFromAuction(remainingToRaise);
        }
        if (leftoverCollateral > 0) {
            _transferCollateral(address(this), auction.forgoneCollateralReceiver, leftoverCollateral);
        }

        emit TerminateAuctionPrematurely(id, msg.sender, leftoverCollateral);
        delete bids[id];
    }

    // --- Bid Accessors ---
    function bidAmount(uint256) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 0;
    }

    function raisedAmount(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return bids[id].raisedAmount;
    }

    function amountToRaise(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return bids[id].amountToRaise;
    }

    function remainingAmountToSell(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        if (auction.soldAmount >= auction.amountToSell) return 0;
        return _sub(auction.amountToSell, auction.soldAmount);
    }

    function forgoneCollateralReceiver(uint256 id) external view returns (address) {
        return bids[id].forgoneCollateralReceiver;
    }

    // --- Pricing / Oracle Logic ---
    function getCollateralMedianPrice() public view returns (uint256 collateralMedianPrice) {
        (address source, bool ok) = _tryReadAddress(collateralFSM, bytes4(0x20531bc9));
        if (!ok || source == address(0)) return 0;

        (uint256 value, bool valid) = _tryGetResultWithValidity(source);
        if (!valid) return 0;
        return value;
    }

    function getSystemCoinMarketPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        (address source, bool ok) = _tryReadAddress(systemCoinOracle, bytes4(0x09fa15b5));
        if (!ok || source == address(0)) return 0;

        (uint256 value, bool valid) = _tryGetResultWithValidity(source);
        if (!valid) return 0;

        return _mul(value, 10 ** 9);
    }

    function getSystemCoinFloorDeviatedPrice(uint256 redemptionPrice) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (redemptionPrice == 0) return 0;

        uint256 minDev = minSystemCoinMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : minSystemCoinMedianDeviation;
        uint256 lowerDev = lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation;

        uint256 a = _wmul(redemptionPrice, minDev);
        uint256 b = _wmul(redemptionPrice, lowerDev);

        return _max(a, b);
    }

    function getSystemCoinCeilingDeviatedPrice(uint256 redemptionPrice) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (redemptionPrice == 0) return 0;

        uint256 minDev = minSystemCoinMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : minSystemCoinMedianDeviation;
        uint256 upperDev = upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation;

        uint256 a = _wmul(redemptionPrice, minDev);
        uint256 b = _wmul(redemptionPrice, upperDev);

        return _min(a, b);
    }

    function getFinalBaseCollateralPrice(uint256 collateralMedianPrice, uint256 finalSystemCoinPrice) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (collateralMedianPrice == 0 || finalSystemCoinPrice == 0) return 0;

        uint256 lowColl = _wmul(collateralMedianPrice, lowerCollateralMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : lowerCollateralMedianDeviation);
        uint256 highColl = _wmul(collateralMedianPrice, upperCollateralMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : upperCollateralMedianDeviation);
        uint256 boundedCollateral = _bound(collateralMedianPrice, lowColl, highColl);

        uint256 floorCoin = getSystemCoinFloorDeviatedPrice(finalSystemCoinPrice);
        uint256 ceilCoin = getSystemCoinCeilingDeviatedPrice(finalSystemCoinPrice);
        uint256 boundedSystem = _bound(finalSystemCoinPrice, floorCoin, ceilCoin);

        if (boundedSystem == 0) return 0;
        return _wdiv(boundedCollateral, boundedSystem);
    }

    function getDiscountedCollateralPrice(
        uint256 collateralMedianPrice,
        uint256 finalSystemCoinPrice,
        uint256 lowerBound,
        uint256 upperBound
    ) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 base = getFinalBaseCollateralPrice(collateralMedianPrice, finalSystemCoinPrice);
        if (base == 0) return 0;

        uint256 discounted = _wmul(base, discount == 0 ? WAD : discount);

        if (lowerBound != 0 && discounted < lowerBound) discounted = lowerBound;
        if (upperBound != 0 && discounted > upperBound) discounted = upperBound;

        return discounted;
    }

    function getCollateralFSMAndFinalSystemCoinPrices(uint256 redemptionPriceHint) public returns (uint256 collateralMedianPrice, uint256 finalSystemCoinPrice) {
        collateralMedianPrice = getCollateralMedianPrice();

        uint256 systemCoinMarketPrice = getSystemCoinMarketPrice();
        uint256 redemptionPrice = _readRedemptionPrice();

        if (redemptionPrice == 0) redemptionPrice = redemptionPriceHint;
        if (redemptionPrice == 0) redemptionPrice = lastReadRedemptionPrice;
        if (redemptionPrice == 0) redemptionPrice = systemCoinMarketPrice;
        if (systemCoinMarketPrice == 0) systemCoinMarketPrice = redemptionPrice;

        uint256 floorPrice = getSystemCoinFloorDeviatedPrice(systemCoinMarketPrice);
        uint256 ceilPrice = getSystemCoinCeilingDeviatedPrice(systemCoinMarketPrice);
        finalSystemCoinPrice = _bound(redemptionPrice, floorPrice, ceilPrice);

        lastReadRedemptionPrice = finalSystemCoinPrice;
    }

    function getCollateralBought(uint256 id, uint256 systemCoinsToBid) public returns (uint256 collateralBought, uint256 adjustedBid) {
        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        if (auction.amountToSell == 0 || auction.amountToRaise == 0) return (0, 0);

        (uint256 collateralMedianPrice, uint256 finalSystemCoinPrice) = getCollateralFSMAndFinalSystemCoinPrices(lastReadRedemptionPrice);
        uint256 discountedCollateralPrice = getDiscountedCollateralPrice(collateralMedianPrice, finalSystemCoinPrice, 0, 0);
        if (discountedCollateralPrice == 0) return (0, 0);

        collateralBought = _wdiv(systemCoinsToBid, discountedCollateralPrice);

        uint256 remainingCollateral = remainingAmountToSell(id);
        if (collateralBought > remainingCollateral) collateralBought = remainingCollateral;

        adjustedBid = _wmul(collateralBought, discountedCollateralPrice);

        uint256 remainingToRaise = auction.amountToRaise > auction.raisedAmount
            ? _sub(auction.amountToRaise, auction.raisedAmount)
            : 0;

        if (adjustedBid > remainingToRaise) {
            adjustedBid = remainingToRaise;
            collateralBought = discountedCollateralPrice == 0 ? 0 : _wdiv(adjustedBid, discountedCollateralPrice);
        }
    }

    function getAdjustedBid(uint256 id, uint256 systemCoinsToBid) external returns (bool valid, uint256 adjustedBid) {
        (uint256 collateralBought, uint256 bidValue) = getCollateralBought(id, systemCoinsToBid);
        if (collateralBought == 0 || bidValue == 0) return (false, 0);

        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        uint256 remainingToRaise = auction.amountToRaise > auction.raisedAmount
            ? _sub(auction.amountToRaise, auction.raisedAmount)
            : 0;

        if (bidValue < minimumBid && remainingToRaise > minimumBid) return (false, 0);
        return (true, bidValue);
    }

    function getApproximateCollateralBought(uint256 id, uint256 systemCoinsToBid) external returns (uint256 collateralBought, uint256 adjustedBid) {
        return getCollateralBought(id, systemCoinsToBid);
    }

    // --- Internals ---
    function _transferCollateral(address src, address dst, uint256 wad) internal {
        if (wad == 0) return;
        require(_isContract(address(safeEngine)), "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/safe-engine-not-set");
        safeEngine.transferCollateral(collateralType, src, dst, wad);
    }

    function _transferInternalCoins(address src, address dst, uint256 wad) internal {
        if (wad == 0) return;
        require(_isContract(address(safeEngine)), "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/safe-engine-not-set");
        safeEngine.transferInternalCoins(src, dst, wad);
    }

    function _removeCoinsFromAuction(uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount == 0 || liquidationEngine == address(0)) return;
        require(_isContract(liquidationEngine), "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/liquidation-engine-not-set");
        ILiquidationEngineLike(liquidationEngine).removeCoinsFromAuction(amount);
    }

    function _readRedemptionPrice() internal returns (uint256) {
        if (oracleRelayer == address(0) || !_isContract(oracleRelayer)) return lastReadRedemptionPrice;

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = oracleRelayer.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xc5b748c0)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return lastReadRedemptionPrice;

        uint256 redemptionPrice = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
        lastReadRedemptionPrice = redemptionPrice;
        return redemptionPrice;
    }

    function _tryReadAddress(address target, bytes4 sig) internal view returns (address value, bool ok) {
        if (target == address(0) || !_isContract(target)) return (address(0), false);

        (ok, bytes memory data) = target.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(sig));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return (address(0), false);

        value = abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _tryGetResultWithValidity(address source) internal view returns (uint256 result, bool valid) {
        if (source == address(0) || !_isContract(source)) return (0, false);

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = source.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x4fd0ada8)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 64) return (0, false);

        (result, valid) = abi.decode(data, (uint256, bool));
        if (!valid) return (0, false);
    }

    function _isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly { size := extcodesize(account) }
        return size > 0;
    }

    function _bound(uint256 x, uint256 min_, uint256 max_) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 low = min_;
        uint256 high = max_;
        if (low > high) {
            uint256 tmp = low;
            low = high;
            high = tmp;
        }

        if (x < low) return low;
        if (x > high) return high;
        return x;
    }

    function _wmul(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return _div(_mul(x, y), WAD);
    }

    function _wdiv(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return _div(_mul(x, WAD), y);
    }

    function _add(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        z = x + y;
        require(z >= x, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/add-overflow");
    }

    function _sub(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        require(y <= x, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/sub-underflow");
        z = x - y;
    }

    function _mul(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        if (x == 0 || y == 0) return 0;
        z = x * y;
        require(z / x == y, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/mul-overflow");
    }

    function _div(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        require(y > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/div-by-zero");
        z = x / y;
    }

    function _min(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return x <= y ? x : y;
    }

    function _max(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return x >= y ? x : y;
    }
}

    mapping(uint256 => uint128) private _nftIdToNodeId; // slot 0x0b
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _nftIdToStakedAtBlock; // slot 0x0c
    mapping(address => mapping(uint128 => uint256)) private _entityNodeToNftId; // slot 0x0d

    mapping(bytes4 => bool) private _supportedInterfaces; // slot 0x0e

    mapping(uint256 => uint8) private _nftIdToNodesCount; // slot 0x10
    mapping(uint128 => uint256) private _nodeIdToStakedAtBlock; // slot 0x11
    mapping(address => uint256[]) private _entityStakedNftIds; // slot 0x12
    mapping(address => mapping(uint128 => uint256)) private _entityNodeToStakedAtBlock; // slot 0x13

    mapping(address => bool) private _serviceContracts; // slot 0x14
    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint128 => uint256))) private _entityServiceNodeToNftId; // slot 0x15
    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint128 => uint256))) private _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtBlock; // slot 0x16
    mapping(address => bool) private _serviceUsesTimestamp; // slot 0x17
    mapping(address => mapping(bytes32 => uint256)) private _serviceBonusEffectiveAt; // slot 0x18
    mapping(address => mapping(bytes32 => uint256)) private _serviceBonusValue; // slot 0x19
    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint128 => uint256))) private _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtTimestamp; // slot 0x1a

    modifier onlySuperAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == _superAdmin, "not super admin");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == _superAdmin || msg.sender == _serviceAdmin, "not admin");
        _;
    }

    function init(
        address cService_,
        address cERC1155_,
        address cStrongNFTBonus_,
        address serviceAdmin_,
        address superAdmin_
    ) external {
        require(!_initialized, "init done");
        _cService = cService_;
        _cERC1155 = cERC1155_;
        _cStrongNFTBonus = cStrongNFTBonus_;
        _serviceAdmin = serviceAdmin_;
        _superAdmin = superAdmin_;
        _initialized = true;

        _supportedInterfaces[0x01ffc9a7] = true;
        _supportedInterfaces[0x02711897] = true;
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _supportedInterfaces[interfaceId];
    }

    function initDone() external view returns (bool) {
        return _initialized;
    }

    function CService() external view returns (address) {
        return _cService;
    }

    function CERC1155() external view returns (address) {
        return _cERC1155;
    }

    function CStrongNFTBonus() external view returns (address) {
        return _cStrongNFTBonus;
    }

    function serviceAdmin() external view returns (address) {
        return _serviceAdmin;
    }

    function superAdmin() external view returns (address) {
        return _superAdmin;
    }

    function updateContracts(address newCERC1155) external onlySuperAdmin {
        _cERC1155 = newCERC1155;
    }

    function updateServiceAdmin(address newServiceAdmin) external onlySuperAdmin {
        _serviceAdmin = newServiceAdmin;
    }

    function addServiceContract(address service, bool usesTimestamp) external onlySuperAdmin {
        _serviceContracts[service] = true;
        _serviceUsesTimestamp[service] = usesTimestamp;
    }

    function removeServiceContract(address service) external onlySuperAdmin {
        _serviceContracts[service] = false;
        _serviceUsesTimestamp[service] = false;
    }

    function updateBonus(
        string calldata name,
        uint256 lowerBound,
        uint256 upperBound,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 effectiveBlock_,
        uint8 nodesLimit
    ) external onlyAdmin {
        _ensureBonusNameExists(name);
        bytes32 key = _hash(name);
        BonusConfig storage cfg = _bonusByNameHash[key];
        cfg.lowerBound = lowerBound;
        cfg.upperBound = upperBound;
        cfg.value = value;
        cfg.effectiveBlock = effectiveBlock_;
        cfg.nodesLimit = nodesLimit;
    }

    function updateBonusLimits(
        string calldata name,
        uint256 lowerBound,
        uint256 upperBound,
        uint8 nodesLimit
    ) external onlyAdmin {
        _ensureBonusNameExists(name);
        bytes32 key = _hash(name);
        BonusConfig storage cfg = _bonusByNameHash[key];
        cfg.lowerBound = lowerBound;
        cfg.upperBound = upperBound;
        cfg.nodesLimit = nodesLimit;
    }

    function updateServiceBonus(
        string calldata name,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 effectiveAt,
        address service
    ) external onlyAdmin {
        _ensureBonusNameExists(name);
        bytes32 key = _hash(name);
        _serviceBonusValue[service][key] = value;
        _serviceBonusEffectiveAt[service][key] = effectiveAt;
    }

    function nftBonusNames(uint256 index) external view returns (string memory) {
        return _bonusNames[index];
    }

    function getNftBonusNames() external view returns (string[] memory) {
        return _bonusNames;
    }

    function nftBonusLowerBound(string calldata name) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)].lowerBound;
    }

    function nftBonusUpperBound(string calldata name) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)].upperBound;
    }

    function nftBonusValue(string calldata name) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)].value;
    }

    function nftBonusEffectiveBlock(string calldata name) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)].effectiveBlock;
    }

    function nftBonusNodesLimit(string calldata name) external view returns (uint8) {
        return _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)].nodesLimit;
    }

    function serviceNftBonusValue(address service, string calldata name) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _serviceBonusValue[service][_hash(name)];
    }

    function serviceNftBonusEffectiveAt(address service, string calldata name) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _serviceBonusEffectiveAt[service][_hash(name)];
    }

    function getNftBonusName(uint256 nftId) public view returns (string memory) {
        return _findBonusNameForNft(nftId);
    }

    function getNftNodesLeft(uint256 nftId) external view returns (uint256) {
        string memory name = _findBonusNameForNft(nftId);
        if (bytes(name).length == 0) return 0;
        uint8 limit = _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)].nodesLimit;
        uint8 used = _nftIdToNodesCount[nftId];
        if (limit <= used) return 0;
        return uint256(limit - used);
    }

    function nftIdStakedToEntity(uint256 nftId) external view returns (address) {
        return _nftIdToEntity[nftId];
    }

    function nftIdStakedToNodeId(uint256 nftId) external view returns (uint128) {
        return _nftIdToNodeId[nftId];
    }

    function nftIdStakedToNodesCount(uint256 nftId) external view returns (uint8) {
        return _nftIdToNodesCount[nftId];
    }

    function nftIdStakedAtBlock(uint256 nftId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _nftIdToStakedAtBlock[nftId];
    }

    function nodeIdStakedAtBlock(uint128 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _nodeIdToStakedAtBlock[nodeId];
    }

    function entityNodeStakedNftId(address entity, uint128 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _entityNodeToNftId[entity][nodeId];
    }

    function entityNodeStakedAtBlock(address entity, uint128 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _entityNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][nodeId];
    }

    function entityServiceNodeStakedNftId(address entity, address service, uint128 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _entityServiceNodeToNftId[entity][service][nodeId];
    }

    function entityServiceNodeStakedAtBlock(address entity, address service, uint128 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][service][nodeId];
    }

    function entityServiceNodeStakedAtTimestamp(address entity, address service, uint128 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtTimestamp[entity][service][nodeId];
    }

    function getStakedNftIds(address entity) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _entityStakedNftIds[entity];
    }

    function entityStakedNftIds(address entity, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _entityStakedNftIds[entity][index];
    }

    function getStakedNftId(address entity, uint128 nodeId, address service) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 id = _entityServiceNodeToNftId[entity][service][nodeId];
        if (id == 0) {
            id = _entityNodeToNftId[entity][nodeId];
        }
        return id;
    }

    function getStakedNftIdInternal(address entity, uint128 nodeId, address service) external view returns (uint256) {
        return getStakedNftId(entity, nodeId, service);
    }

    function getStakedNftBonusName(address entity, uint128 nodeId, address service) external view returns (string memory) {
        uint256 nftId = getStakedNftId(entity, nodeId, service);
        if (nftId == 0) return "";
        return _findBonusNameForNft(nftId);
    }

    function isNftStaked(uint256 nftId) public view returns (bool) {
        return _nftIdToNodesCount[nftId] > 0;
    }

    function isNftStaked(address entity, uint256 nftId, uint128 nodeId, address service) external view returns (bool) {
        if (_nftIdToEntity[nftId] != entity) return false;
        return (_entityServiceNodeToNftId[entity][service][nodeId] == nftId || _entityNodeToNftId[entity][nodeId] == nftId);
    }

    function isNftStakedLegacy(uint256 nftId) external view returns (bool) {
        if (_cStrongNFTBonus.code.length == 0) {
            return isNftStaked(nftId);
        }
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = _cStrongNFTBonus.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x328f7233), nftId));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return isNftStaked(nftId);
        return abi.decode(data, (bool));
    }

    function isEthereumNode(address candidate) external view returns (bool) {
        return candidate == _cService;
    }

    function stakeNFT(uint256 nftId, uint128 nodeId, address service) external payable {
        require(_initialized, "not initialized");
        if (service != address(0)) {
            require(_serviceContracts[service], "service disabled");
            require(_serviceNodeExists(service, msg.sender, nodeId), "node missing");
            require(!_serviceNodeExpired(service, msg.sender, nodeId), "node expired");
        }

        require(getStakedNftId(msg.sender, nodeId, service) == 0, "already staked on node");
        string memory bonusName = _findBonusNameForNft(nftId);
        require(bytes(bonusName).length != 0, "not eligible");

        uint8 limit = _bonusByNameHash[_hash(bonusName)].nodesLimit;
        uint8 currentCount = _nftIdToNodesCount[nftId];
        if (limit != 0) {
            require(currentCount < limit, "limit reached");
        }

        if (currentCount == 0) {
            _safeTransferIn(msg.sender, nftId);
            _nftIdToEntity[nftId] = msg.sender;
            _addEntityNft(msg.sender, nftId);
        } else {
            require(_nftIdToEntity[nftId] == msg.sender, "different owner");
        }

        _nftIdToNodesCount[nftId] = currentCount + 1;
        _nftIdToNodeId[nftId] = nodeId;
        _nftIdToStakedAtBlock[nftId] = block.number;
        _nodeIdToStakedAtBlock[nodeId] = block.number;

        _entityNodeToNftId[msg.sender][nodeId] = nftId;
        _entityNodeToStakedAtBlock[msg.sender][nodeId] = block.number;

        _entityServiceNodeToNftId[msg.sender][service][nodeId] = nftId;
        if (_serviceUsesTimestamp[service]) {
            _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtTimestamp[msg.sender][service][nodeId] = block.timestamp;
        } else {
            _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtBlock[msg.sender][service][nodeId] = block.number;
        }

        emit StakedToNode(msg.sender, nftId, nodeId, _currentMarker(service), service);
    }

    function unstakeNFT(address entity, uint128 nodeId, address service) external {
        require(msg.sender == entity, "forbidden");
        _unstake(entity, nodeId, service, 0);
    }

    function unStakeNFT(
        uint256 nftId,
        uint128 nodeId,
        uint256 aux,
        address service,
        uint256 claimAmount,
        bytes calldata data
    ) external payable {
        address entity = _nftIdToEntity[nftId];
        if (entity == address(0)) entity = msg.sender;
        require(msg.sender == entity || msg.sender == _serviceAdmin || msg.sender == _superAdmin, "forbidden");

        if (service != address(0)) {
            require(_serviceContracts[service], "service disabled");
            if (data.length > 0) {
                (bool ok, ) = service.call{value: msg.value}(data);
                require(ok, "service call failed");
            } else if (claimAmount > 0) {
                bytes memory payload = abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xac44ff31), aux, claimAmount, entity);
                (bool ok2, ) = service.call{value: msg.value}(payload);
                require(ok2, "claim failed");
            }
        }

        _unstake(entity, nodeId, service, nftId);
    }

    function migrateNFT(address entity, uint128 fromNodeId, uint128 toNodeId, address service) external {
        require(msg.sender == entity, "forbidden");
        uint256 nftId = getStakedNftId(entity, fromNodeId, service);
        require(nftId != 0, "nothing staked");
        require(getStakedNftId(entity, toNodeId, service) == 0, "target occupied");

        delete _entityServiceNodeToNftId[entity][service][fromNodeId];
        delete _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][service][fromNodeId];
        delete _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtTimestamp[entity][service][fromNodeId];

        if (_entityNodeToNftId[entity][fromNodeId] == nftId) {
            delete _entityNodeToNftId[entity][fromNodeId];
            delete _entityNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][fromNodeId];
        }

        _entityServiceNodeToNftId[entity][service][toNodeId] = nftId;
        _entityNodeToNftId[entity][toNodeId] = nftId;
        _entityNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][toNodeId] = block.number;
        _nftIdToNodeId[nftId] = toNodeId;
        _nodeIdToStakedAtBlock[toNodeId] = block.number;

        if (_serviceUsesTimestamp[service]) {
            _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtTimestamp[entity][service][toNodeId] = block.timestamp;
        } else {
            _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][service][toNodeId] = block.number;
        }

        uint256 marker = _currentMarker(service);
        emit UnstakedFromNode(entity, nftId, fromNodeId, marker, service);
        emit StakedToNode(entity, nftId, toNodeId, marker, service);
    }

    function getBonus(address entity, uint128 nodeId, uint256 amount, uint256 maxOut) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(_serviceContracts[msg.sender] || msg.sender == _cService, "wrong node");
        return _computeBonus(msg.sender, entity, nodeId, amount, 0, maxOut);
    }

    function getBonusValue(
        address entity,
        uint128 nodeId,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 minOut,
        uint256 maxOut
    ) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(_serviceContracts[msg.sender] || msg.sender == _cService, "wrong node");
        return _computeBonus(msg.sender, entity, nodeId, amount, minOut, maxOut);
    }

    function onERC1155Received(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) external pure returns (bytes4) {
        return this.onERC1155Received.selector;
    }

    function onERC1155BatchReceived(address, address, uint256[] calldata, uint256[] calldata, bytes calldata) external pure returns (bytes4) {
        return this.onERC1155BatchReceived.selector;
    }

    function _unstake(address entity, uint128 nodeId, address service, uint256 expectedNftId) internal {
        uint256 nftId = _entityServiceNodeToNftId[entity][service][nodeId];
        if (nftId == 0) nftId = _entityNodeToNftId[entity][nodeId];
        require(nftId != 0, "nothing staked");
        if (expectedNftId != 0) require(nftId == expectedNftId, "nft mismatch");

        delete _entityServiceNodeToNftId[entity][service][nodeId];
        delete _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][service][nodeId];
        delete _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtTimestamp[entity][service][nodeId];

        if (_entityNodeToNftId[entity][nodeId] == nftId) {
            delete _entityNodeToNftId[entity][nodeId];
            delete _entityNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][nodeId];
        }

        if (_nftIdToNodeId[nftId] == nodeId) {
            delete _nftIdToNodeId[nftId];
        }

        uint8 count = _nftIdToNodesCount[nftId];
        if (count > 0) {
            unchecked {
                _nftIdToNodesCount[nftId] = count - 1;
            }
        }

        if (_nftIdToNodesCount[nftId] == 0) {
            delete _nftIdToEntity[nftId];
            delete _nftIdToStakedAtBlock[nftId];
            _removeEntityNft(entity, nftId);
            _safeTransferOut(entity, nftId);
        }

        emit UnstakedFromNode(entity, nftId, nodeId, _currentMarker(service), service);
    }

    function _computeBonus(
        address service,
        address entity,
        uint128 nodeId,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 minOut,
        uint256 maxOut
    ) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 nftId = getStakedNftId(entity, nodeId, service);
        if (nftId == 0) return 0;

        string memory bonusName = _findBonusNameForNft(nftId);
        if (bytes(bonusName).length == 0) return 0;

        bytes32 key = _hash(bonusName);
        uint256 bonus = _resolveBonusValue(service, key);
        if (bonus == 0) return 0;

        uint256 out = amount + ((amount * bonus) / 1e4);
        if (minOut != 0 && out < minOut) out = minOut;
        if (maxOut != 0 && out > maxOut) out = maxOut;
        return out;
    }

    function _resolveBonusValue(address service, bytes32 key) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 serviceValue = _serviceBonusValue[service][key];
        if (serviceValue != 0) {
            uint256 eff = _serviceBonusEffectiveAt[service][key];
            if (eff == 0 || _currentMarker(service) >= eff) return serviceValue;
        }

        BonusConfig storage cfg = _bonusByNameHash[key];
        if (cfg.value == 0) return 0;
        if (cfg.effectiveBlock != 0 && block.number < cfg.effectiveBlock) return 0;
        return cfg.value;
    }

    function _findBonusNameForNft(uint256 nftId) internal view returns (string memory) {
        uint256 len = _bonusNames.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            string memory name = _bonusNames[i];
            BonusConfig storage cfg = _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)];
            if (nftId >= cfg.lowerBound) {
                if (cfg.upperBound == 0 || nftId <= cfg.upperBound) {
                    return name;
                }
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    function _hash(string memory s) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(bytes(s));
    }

    function _ensureBonusNameExists(string calldata name) internal {
        bytes32 key = _hash(name);
        uint256 len = _bonusNames.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (_hash(_bonusNames[i]) == key) return;
        }
        _bonusNames.push(name);
    }

    function _safeTransferIn(address from, uint256 nftId) internal {
        require(_cERC1155.code.length > 0, "CERC1155 not set");
        IERC1155Minimal(_cERC1155).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), nftId, 1, "");
    }

    function _safeTransferOut(address to, uint256 nftId) internal {
        require(_cERC1155.code.length > 0, "CERC1155 not set");
        IERC1155Minimal(_cERC1155).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, nftId, 1, "");
    }

    function _addEntityNft(address entity, uint256 nftId) internal {
        uint256[] storage arr = _entityStakedNftIds[entity];
        uint256 len = arr.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == nftId) return;
        }
        arr.push(nftId);
    }

    function _removeEntityNft(address entity, uint256 nftId) internal {
        uint256[] storage arr = _entityStakedNftIds[entity];
        uint256 len = arr.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == nftId) {
                arr[i] = arr[len - 1];
                arr.pop();
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    function _currentMarker(address service) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _serviceUsesTimestamp[service] ? block.timestamp : block.number;
    }

    function _tryStaticBool(address target, bytes memory payload) internal view returns (bool ok, bool value) {
        (ok, bytes memory ret) = target.staticcall(payload);
        if (!ok || ret.length < 32) return (false, false);
        value = abi.decode(ret, (bool));
    }

    function _serviceNodeExists(address service, address entity, uint128 nodeId) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (service == address(0)) return true;
        (bool ok, bool exists) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x26665562), entity, nodeId));
        if (ok) return exists;
        (ok, exists) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x9daf08c0), entity, uint256(nodeId)));
        if (ok) return exists;
        return true;
    }

    function _serviceNodeExpired(address service, address entity, uint128 nodeId) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (service == address(0)) return false;
        (bool ok, bool expired) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xf1febd07), entity, nodeId));
        if (ok) return expired;
        (ok, expired) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x6c52ec10), entity, nodeId));
        if (ok) return expired;
        (ok, expired) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xd1c25be3), entity, uint256(nodeId)));
        if (ok) return expired;
        return false;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IPriceOracle {
    function _cost() external view returns (uint256);
    function requestPrice(string calldata pair) external returns (uint256);

contract DomainHostRegistry {
    struct UserInfo {
        bool subscribed;
        uint256 subscribedUntil;
        uint256 credits;
        uint256 spent;
    }

    struct HostInfo {
        uint256 id;
        address wallet;
        uint256 staked;
        bool active;
        uint256 joinedAt;
        uint256 updatedAt;
        string meta;
    }

    struct Domain {
        bool exists;
        string name;
        string websiteBlob;
        address owner;
        uint256 createdAt;
        uint256 expiresAt;
        uint256 ttl;
        uint256 price;
        uint256 filesCount;
        uint256 updates;
        bytes32 websiteRoot;
    }

    struct SaleInfo {
        address seller;
        address buyer;
        uint256 price;
        uint256 startedAt;
        uint256 expiresAt;
        bool listed;
    }

    address private _owOwner;
    address private _tokenAddress_;
    address private _cmcAddress_;

    string private _symbol_;
    uint8 private _decimals_;

    uint256 private _tokenPrice_;
    uint256 private _domainCost_;
    uint256 private _publishCost_;
    uint256 private _hostRegistryCost_;
    uint256 private _userSurfingCost_;
    uint256 private _registryDuration_;
    uint256 private _stakeLockTime_;
    uint256 private _websiteSizeLimit_;
    uint256 private _websiteFilesLimit_;
    uint256 private _lastPriceUpdate_;

    uint256 private _websiteUpdatesCounter_;
    uint256 private _hostUpdatesCounter_;
    uint256 private _totalSubscriber_;
    uint256 private _totalDomains_;
    uint256 private _totalHosts_;
    uint256 private _totalBurned_;

    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _stakeBalances;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _stakesLockups_;
    mapping(address => UserInfo) private _users_;
    mapping(address => HostInfo) private _hosts_;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _hostAddressById;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _hostIdByAddress;
    mapping(uint256 => bytes32) private _hostConnectionById;
    mapping(bytes32 => bool) private _hostConnectionDB_;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _hostUpdates_; // numeric host update records
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _hostUpdateNotes_; // textual host update notes
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _websiteUpdates_;

    mapping(bytes32 => Domain) private _domains_;
    mapping(bytes32 => SaleInfo) private _domainSales;
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool)) private _domainAdmins;
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(bytes32 => bytes32)) private _domainFileHashes;

    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _poolBalance_;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _poolBalanceClaimed_;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _totalStakes_;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256))) private _hostStakes_;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256))) private _stakeTmpBalance_;

    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256))) private _hostTokenBuckets;
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256))) private _stakeTokenBuckets;

    modifier onlyOwOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owOwner, "OWNER_ONLY");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyTokenAddress() {
        require(msg.sender == _tokenAddress_, "TOKEN_ONLY");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyCmc() {
        require(msg.sender == _cmcAddress_, "CMC_ONLY");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _owOwner = msg.sender;
        _tokenAddress_ = msg.sender;
        _cmcAddress_ = msg.sender;

        _symbol_ = "WEB3D";
        _decimals_ = 18;

        _tokenPrice_ = 1e18;
        _domainCost_ = 1e18;
        _publishCost_ = 1e17;
        _hostRegistryCost_ = 5e17;
        _userSurfingCost_ = 1e16;
        _registryDuration_ = 30 days;
        _stakeLockTime_ = 7 days;
        _websiteSizeLimit_ = 24576;
        _websiteFilesLimit_ = 32;
        _lastPriceUpdate_ = block.timestamp;

        _balances[msg.sender] = 1_000_000 * 10 ** _decimals_;
    }

    function _domainKey(string memory domainName) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(bytes(domainName));
    }

    function _isDomainManager(bytes32 key, address who) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _domains_[key].owner == who || _domainAdmins[key][who];
    }

    function _moveBalance(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (bool) {
        require(to != address(0), "BAD_TO");
        require(_balances[from] >= amount, "NO_BALANCE");
        unchecked {
            _balances[from] -= amount;
            _balances[to] += amount;
        }
        return true;
    }

    function _registerDomainInternal(string memory domainName, address newOwner, uint256 duration) internal returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        Domain storage d = _domains_[key];
        uint256 dur = duration == 0 ? _registryDuration_ : duration;

        if (!d.exists) {
            d.exists = true;
            d.name = domainName;
            d.owner = newOwner;
            d.createdAt = block.timestamp;
            d.ttl = 1 days;
            _totalDomains_ += 1;
        } else {
            if (block.timestamp <= d.expiresAt) {
                require(d.owner == newOwner, "DOMAIN_TAKEN");
            } else {
                d.owner = newOwner;
            }
        }

        if (d.expiresAt < block.timestamp) {
            d.expiresAt = block.timestamp + dur;
        } else {
            d.expiresAt += dur;
        }

        d.price = _domainCost_;
        d.updates += 1;
        return true;
    }

    function publishWebsite(
        string calldata domainName,
        string calldata websiteBlob,
        bytes32 root,
        bytes32[] calldata fileKeys,
        bytes32[] calldata fileValues
    ) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        require(_isDomainManager(key, msg.sender), "NOT_DOMAIN_MANAGER");
        require(_domains_[key].exists, "NO_DOMAIN");
        require(fileKeys.length <= _websiteFilesLimit_, "FILES_LIMIT");
        require(bytes(websiteBlob).length <= _websiteSizeLimit_, "SIZE_LIMIT");

        if (_publishCost_ > 0) {
            require(_balances[msg.sender] >= _publishCost_, "NO_BALANCE");
            _balances[msg.sender] -= _publishCost_;
        }

        Domain storage d = _domains_[key];
        d.websiteBlob = websiteBlob;
        d.websiteRoot = root;
        d.filesCount = fileKeys.length;
        d.updates += 1;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < fileKeys.length; i++) {
            bytes32 v = i < fileValues.length ? fileValues[i] : root;
            _domainFileHashes[key][fileKeys[i]] = v;
        }

        _websiteUpdatesCounter_ += 1;
        _websiteUpdates_[_websiteUpdatesCounter_] = websiteBlob;
        return true;
    }

    function websiteSizeLimit() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _websiteSizeLimit_;
    }

    function _priceFetchingCost() external view returns (uint256) {
        if (_cmcAddress_ == address(0)) return 0;
        try IPriceOracle(_cmcAddress_)._cost() returns (uint256 c) {
            return c;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function __response(uint256 newPrice) external onlyCmc {
        _tokenPrice_ = newPrice;
        _lastPriceUpdate_ = block.timestamp;
    }

    function hostConnectionDB(bytes32 k) external view returns (bool) {
        return _hostConnectionDB_[k];
    }

    function claimHostTokens(uint256 a, uint256 b) external {
        uint256 amount = _hostTokenBuckets[msg.sender][a][b];
        if (amount == 0) {
            amount = _hostStakes_[a][b][msg.sender];
        }
        require(amount > 0, "NO_AMOUNT");

        _hostTokenBuckets[msg.sender][a][b] = 0;
        _hostStakes_[a][b][msg.sender] = 0;
        _poolBalanceClaimed_[a][b] += amount;
        _balances[msg.sender] += amount;

        if (_stakeBalances[msg.sender] >= amount) {
            _stakeBalances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        } else {
            _stakeBalances[msg.sender] = 0;
        }
    }

    function verifyDomainFileHash(string calldata domainName, bytes32 fileKey, bytes32 expected) external view returns (bool) {
        return _domainFileHashes[_domainKey(domainName)][fileKey] == expected;
    }

    function ow_owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owOwner;
    }

    function buyDomain(string calldata domainName) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        SaleInfo storage s = _domainSales[key];

        if (s.listed) {
            require(s.expiresAt == 0 || block.timestamp <= s.expiresAt, "SALE_EXPIRED");
            require(_balances[msg.sender] >= s.price, "NO_BALANCE");
            _balances[msg.sender] -= s.price;
            _balances[s.seller] += s.price;
            _domains_[key].owner = msg.sender;
            s.buyer = msg.sender;
            s.listed = false;
            return true;
        }

        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= _domainCost_, "NO_BALANCE");
        _balances[msg.sender] -= _domainCost_;
        return _registerDomainInternal(domainName, msg.sender, _registryDuration_);
    }

    function poolBalanceClaimed(uint256 a, uint256 b) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _poolBalanceClaimed_[a][b];
    }

    function stakeLockTime() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stakeLockTime_;
    }

    function websiteUpdatesCounter() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _websiteUpdatesCounter_;
    }

    function decimals() external view returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals_;
    }

    function addDomainAdmin(string calldata domainName, address admin) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        require(_domains_[key].owner == msg.sender, "NOT_OWNER");
        _domainAdmins[key][admin] = true;
        return true;
    }

    function internalTransfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        return _moveBalance(msg.sender, to, amount);
    }

    function getDomainMeta(string calldata domainName)
        external
        view
        returns (
            string memory name,
            string memory websiteBlob,
            address owner_,
            uint256 createdAt,
            uint256 expiresAt,
            uint256 ttl,
            uint256 price,
            uint256 filesCount,
            uint256 updates,
            bytes32 websiteRoot,
            string memory latestWebsiteUpdate,
            string memory latestHostUpdate
        )
    {
        Domain storage d = _domains_[_domainKey(domainName)];
        return (
            d.name,
            d.websiteBlob,
            d.owner,
            d.createdAt,
            d.expiresAt,
            d.ttl,
            d.price,
            d.filesCount,
            d.updates,
            d.websiteRoot,
            _websiteUpdates_[_websiteUpdatesCounter_],
            _hostUpdateNotes_[_hostUpdatesCounter_]
        );
    }

    function notifyBalance(address user, uint256 amount) external onlyTokenAddress {
        _balances[user] += amount;
    }

    function userSurfingCost() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _userSurfingCost_;
    }

    function burn() external {
        uint256 amount = _balances[msg.sender];
        require(amount > 0, "ZERO");
        _balances[msg.sender] = 0;
        _totalBurned_ += amount;
    }

    function registerHost(string calldata hostData) external returns (bool) {
        if (_hostRegistryCost_ > 0) {
            require(_balances[msg.sender] >= _hostRegistryCost_, "NO_BALANCE");
            _balances[msg.sender] -= _hostRegistryCost_;
        }

        HostInfo storage h = _hosts_[msg.sender];
        if (!h.active) {
            _totalHosts_ += 1;
            h.id = _totalHosts_;
            h.wallet = msg.sender;
            h.joinedAt = block.timestamp;
            _hostIdByAddress[msg.sender] = h.id;
            _hostAddressById[h.id] = msg.sender;
        }

        h.active = true;
        h.updatedAt = block.timestamp;
        h.meta = hostData;

        bytes32 c = keccak256(bytes(hostData));
        _hostConnectionById[h.id] = c;
        _hostConnectionDB_[c] = true;

        _hostUpdatesCounter_ += 1;
        _hostUpdates_[_hostUpdatesCounter_] = block.timestamp;
        _hostUpdateNotes_[_hostUpdatesCounter_] = hostData;
        return true;
    }

    function stakesLockups(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stakesLockups_[user];
    }

    function updateDomainTTL(string calldata domainName, uint256 ttl_) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        require(_isDomainManager(key, msg.sender), "NOT_MANAGER");
        _domains_[key].ttl = ttl_;
        return true;
    }

    function domain_sale(bytes32 key) external view returns (address, address, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        SaleInfo storage s = _domainSales[key];
        return (s.seller, s.buyer, s.price, s.startedAt, s.expiresAt);
    }

    function poolDonate(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 amount) external {
        if (_balances[msg.sender] >= amount) {
            _balances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        }
        _poolBalance_[a][b] += amount;
        _totalStakes_[a][b] += amount;
    }

    function getHostTokens(address host, uint256 a, uint256 b) external returns (uint256) {
        uint256 amount = _hostTokenBuckets[host][a][b];
        if (msg.sender == host && amount > 0) {
            _hostTokenBuckets[host][a][b] = 0;
            _balances[host] += amount;
        }
        return amount;
    }

    function stakeBalance(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stakeBalances[user];
    }

    function poolBalance(uint256 a, uint256 b) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _poolBalance_[a][b];
    }

    function hostUpdatesCounter() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hostUpdatesCounter_;
    }

    function hostAddress(uint256 id) external view returns (address) {
        return _hostAddressById[id];
    }

    function lastPriceUpdate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lastPriceUpdate_;
    }

    function hostConnection(uint256 id) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _hostConnectionById[id];
    }

    function balanceOf(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[user];
    }

    function stakeTmpBalance(uint256 a, uint256 b, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stakeTmpBalance_[a][b][user];
    }

    function stakeTokens(address host, uint256 amount) external {
        require(_hosts_[host].active, "HOST_INACTIVE");
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "NO_BALANCE");

        _balances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        _stakeBalances[msg.sender] += amount;
        _stakesLockups_[msg.sender] = block.timestamp + _stakeLockTime_;

        uint256 hostId = _hostIdByAddress[host];
        _hostStakes_[hostId][0][msg.sender] += amount;
        _totalStakes_[hostId][0] += amount;
        _stakeTmpBalance_[hostId][0][msg.sender] += amount / 10;
        _stakeTokenBuckets[msg.sender][hostId][0] += amount;
        _hostTokenBuckets[host][hostId][0] += amount / 20;
        _hosts_[host].staked += amount;
    }

    function totalStakes(uint256 a, uint256 b) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalStakes_[a][b];
    }

    function sellDomain(
        string calldata domainName,
        address seller,
        address buyer,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 expiresAt
    ) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        Domain storage d = _domains_[key];
        require(d.exists, "NO_DOMAIN");
        require(d.owner == msg.sender || _domainAdmins[key][msg.sender] || seller == msg.sender, "NOT_ALLOWED");

        _domainSales[key] = SaleInfo({
            seller: seller == address(0) ? d.owner : seller,
            buyer: buyer,
            price: price,
            startedAt: block.timestamp,
            expiresAt: expiresAt,
            listed: true
        });
        return true;
    }

    function tokenPrice() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _tokenPrice_;
    }

    function updateHost(string calldata hostData) external returns (bool) {
        HostInfo storage h = _hosts_[msg.sender];
        require(h.active, "NOT_HOST");

        h.updatedAt = block.timestamp;
        h.meta = hostData;

        bytes32 c = keccak256(bytes(hostData));
        _hostConnectionById[h.id] = c;
        _hostConnectionDB_[c] = true;

        _hostUpdatesCounter_ += 1;
        _hostUpdates_[_hostUpdatesCounter_] = block.timestamp;
        _hostUpdateNotes_[_hostUpdatesCounter_] = hostData;
        return true;
    }

    function getDomainFileHash(string calldata domainName, bytes32 fileKey) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _domainFileHashes[_domainKey(domainName)][fileKey];
    }

    function setOwOwner(address newOwner) external onlyOwOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "BAD_OWNER");
        _owOwner = newOwner;
    }

    function registerDomain(string calldata domainName, uint256 duration) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        if (!_domains_[key].exists || block.timestamp > _domains_[key].expiresAt) {
            require(_balances[msg.sender] >= _domainCost_, "NO_BALANCE");
            _balances[msg.sender] -= _domainCost_;
        }
        return _registerDomainInternal(domainName, msg.sender, duration);
    }

    function hostStakes(uint256 a, uint256 b, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hostStakes_[a][b][user];
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol_;
    }

    function publishCost() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _publishCost_;
    }

    function claimStakeTokens(uint256 a, uint256 b) external {
        uint256 amount = _stakeTmpBalance_[a][b][msg.sender];
        require(amount > 0, "NO_AMOUNT");
        _stakeTmpBalance_[a][b][msg.sender] = 0;
        _poolBalanceClaimed_[a][b] += amount;
        _balances[msg.sender] += amount;
    }

    function tokenAddress() external view returns (address) {
        return _tokenAddress_;
    }

    function users(address user) external view returns (bool, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        UserInfo storage u = _users_[user];
        return (u.subscribed, u.subscribedUntil, u.credits, u.spent);
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        return _moveBalance(msg.sender, to, amount);
    }

    function websiteUpdates(uint256 id) external view returns (string memory) {
        return _websiteUpdates_[id];
    }

    function hostUpdates(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hostUpdates_[id];
    }

    function hosts(address host) external view returns (uint256, address, uint256, bool, uint256, uint256) {
        HostInfo storage h = _hosts_[host];
        return (h.id, h.wallet, h.staked, h.active, h.joinedAt, h.updatedAt);
    }

    function fetchTokenPrice() external payable {
        require(block.timestamp >= _lastPriceUpdate_ + 1 days, "TOO_EARLY");
        _lastPriceUpdate_ = block.timestamp;

        if (_cmcAddress_ != address(0)) {
            try IPriceOracle(_cmcAddress_).requestPrice(_symbol_) returns (uint256 p) {
                if (p > 0) _tokenPrice_ = p;
            } catch {}
        }
    }

    function totalSubscriber() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSubscriber_;
    }

    function domains(bytes32 key)
        external
        view
        returns (
            string memory name,
            string memory websiteBlob,
            address owner_,
            uint256 createdAt,
            uint256 expiresAt,
            uint256 ttl,
            uint256 price,
            uint256 filesCount,
            uint256 updates,
            bytes32 websiteRoot
        )
    {
        Domain storage d = _domains_[key];
        return (d.name, d.websiteBlob, d.owner, d.createdAt, d.expiresAt, d.ttl, d.price, d.filesCount, d.updates, d.websiteRoot);
    }

    function burnPoolTokens(uint256 a, uint256 b) external onlyOwOwner {
        uint256 bal = _poolBalance_[a][b];
        uint256 burnAmount = bal / 2;
        _poolBalance_[a][b] = bal - burnAmount;
        _totalBurned_ += burnAmount;
    }

    function totalDomains() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalDomains_;
    }

    function cmcAddress() external view returns (address) {
        return _cmcAddress_;
    }

    function registryDuration() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _registryDuration_;
    }

    function removeDomainAdmin(string calldata domainName, address admin) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        require(_domains_[key].owner == msg.sender, "NOT_OWNER");
        _domainAdmins[key][admin] = false;
        return true;
    }

    function cancelSellDomain(string calldata domainName) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        SaleInfo storage s = _domainSales[key];
        require(s.listed, "NOT_LISTED");
        require(msg.sender == s.seller || msg.sender == _domains_[key].owner, "NOT_ALLOWED");
        s.listed = false;
        return true;
    }

    function domainCost() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _domainCost_;
    }

    function userSubscribe(uint256 period) external {
        UserInfo storage u = _users_[msg.sender];
        if (!u.subscribed) {
            u.subscribed = true;
            _totalSubscriber_ += 1;
        }

        uint256 start = u.subscribedUntil > block.timestamp ? u.subscribedUntil : block.timestamp;
        u.subscribedUntil = start + period;
        u.credits += period;

        uint256 denom = _registryDuration_ == 0 ? 1 : _registryDuration_;
        uint256 cost = (period * _userSurfingCost_) / denom;
        if (cost > 0) {
            require(_balances[msg.sender] >= cost, "NO_BALANCE");
            _balances[msg.sender] -= cost;
            u.spent += cost;
        }
    }

    function getStakeTokens(address user, uint256 a, uint256 b) external returns (uint256) {
        uint256 amount = _stakeTokenBuckets[user][a][b];
        if (msg.sender == user && amount > 0) {
            _stakeTokenBuckets[user][a][b] = 0;
            _balances[user] += amount;
        }
        return amount;
    }

    function hostRegistryCost() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hostRegistryCost_;
    }

    function websiteFilesLimit() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _websiteFilesLimit_;
    }

    function renewDomain(string calldata domainName) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        require(_isDomainManager(key, msg.sender), "NOT_MANAGER");
        return _registerDomainInternal(domainName, _domains_[key].owner, _registryDuration_);
    }

    function totalHosts() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalHosts_;
    }

    function _currentPrice(uint256 baseAmount) external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 basis = _tokenPrice_ == 0 ? baseAmount : (baseAmount * _tokenPrice_) / 1e18;
        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp > _lastPriceUpdate_ ? (block.timestamp - _lastPriceUpdate_) : 0;
        uint256 premium = (basis * elapsed) / 86400 / 100;
        return basis + premium;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
    fallback() external payable {}
}
