pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC20Minimal {
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);
    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);
}

contract ReferralInvestmentGame {
    struct Order {
        uint256 amount;
        uint256 principal;
        uint256 startAt;
        uint256 unlockAt;
        uint256 claimedStatic;
    }

    struct User {
        uint256 id;
        address referrer;
        string inviteCode;
        string myCode;
        uint256 totalInvest;
        uint256 totalStaticClaimed;
        uint256 totalDynamicClaimed;
        uint256 totalWithdrawn;
        uint256 teamInvest;
        uint256 directCount;
        uint256 latestUnlockAmount;
        uint256 joinTime;
        uint256 round;
        Order[] orders;
    }

    struct OrderView {
        uint256 amount;
        uint256 principal;
        uint256 startAt;
        uint256 unlockAt;
        uint256 claimedStatic;
    }

    event WhitelistAdminAdded(address indexed account);
    event WhitelistAdminRemoved(address indexed account);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    event LogInvestIn(
        address indexed user,
        uint256 indexed amount,
        uint256 time,
        uint256 round,
        string inviteCode,
        string myCode,
        uint256 coefficientValue
    );

    event LogWithdrawProfit(
        address indexed user,
        uint256 indexed amount,
        uint256 staticProfit,
        uint256 dynamicProfit
    );

    event LogRedeem(
        address indexed user,
        uint256 indexed amount,
        uint256 time,
        uint256 round
    );

    address private _owner;
    mapping(address => bool) private _whitelistAdmins;

    IERC20Minimal public payToken;
    IERC20Minimal public feeToken;

    uint256 public baseAmount;
    uint256 public coefficient;      // per-mille per day
    uint256 public gameDeadline;     // active while block.timestamp < gameDeadline

    uint256 public totalStaticPaid;
    uint256 public totalDynamicPaid;

    uint256 public userCount;
    uint256 public currentRound;
    uint256 public lastRoundMarker;

    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public roundStaticPool;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public roundDynamicPool;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public roundWithdrawn;

    mapping(bytes32 => address) private _codeToUser;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _indexMapping;
    mapping(address => User) private _users;
    mapping(uint256 => address[]) private _specialUsers;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyAdminOrOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner || _whitelistAdmins[msg.sender], "Roles: caller does not have role");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyHuman() {
        require(msg.sender == tx.origin && msg.sender.code.length == 0, "sorry, humans only");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address token_, address feeToken_, uint256 unitAmount_) {
        require(token_ != address(0), "zero token");
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);

        _whitelistAdmins[msg.sender] = true;
        emit WhitelistAdminAdded(msg.sender);

        payToken = IERC20Minimal(token_);
        feeToken = IERC20Minimal(feeToken_ == address(0) ? token_ : feeToken_);
        baseAmount = unitAmount_ == 0 ? 1 ether : unitAmount_;
        coefficient = 10;
        currentRound = 1;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function isOwner() external view returns (bool) {
        return msg.sender == _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function isWhitelistAdmin(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelistAdmins[account];
    }

    function addWhitelistAdmin(address account) external onlyAdminOrOwner {
        require(account != address(0), "Roles: account is the zero address");
        require(!_whitelistAdmins[account], "Roles: account already has role");
        _whitelistAdmins[account] = true;
        emit WhitelistAdminAdded(account);
    }

    function removeWhitelistAdmin(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(_whitelistAdmins[account], "Roles: account does not have role");
        _whitelistAdmins[account] = false;
        emit WhitelistAdminRemoved(account);
    }

    function renounceWhitelistAdmin() external {
        require(_whitelistAdmins[msg.sender], "Roles: account does not have role");
        _whitelistAdmins[msg.sender] = false;
        emit WhitelistAdminRemoved(msg.sender);
    }

    function setCoefficient(uint256 value) external onlyAdminOrOwner {
        require(value > 0, "invalid coeff");
        coefficient = value;
    }

    function activeGame(uint256 deadline) external onlyAdminOrOwner {
        require(deadline >= block.timestamp, "invalid game start time");
        gameDeadline = deadline;
    }

    function endRound() external onlyOwner {
        currentRound += 1;
        lastRoundMarker = lastRoundMarker == 0 ? (block.timestamp + 1 days) : (lastRoundMarker + 1 days);
        gameDeadline = lastRoundMarker;
        coefficient = 10;
    }

    function getGameInfo()
        external
        view
        onlyHuman
        returns (
            uint256 round,
            uint256 users,
            uint256 deadline,
            uint256 staticPaid,
            uint256 dynamicPaid,
            uint256 roundStatic,
            uint256 roundDynamic,
            uint256 coeff,
            uint256 withdrawnInRound,
            uint256 roundMarker
        )
    {
        return (
            currentRound,
            userCount,
            gameDeadline,
            totalStaticPaid,
            totalDynamicPaid,
            roundStaticPool[currentRound],
            roundDynamicPool[currentRound],
            coefficient,
            roundWithdrawn[currentRound],
            lastRoundMarker
        );
    }

    function investIn(string calldata myCode, string calldata refCode, uint256 amount) external onlyHuman {
        _requireGameActive();
        _invest(msg.sender, myCode, refCode, amount, false);
    }

    function reInvestIn() external {
        _requireGameActive();
        User storage u = _users[msg.sender];
        require(u.id != 0, "user not exist");

        uint256 staticPart = _collectStatic(msg.sender);
        uint256 dynamicPart = u.latestUnlockAmount;
        uint256 amount = staticPart + dynamicPart;
        require(amount > 0, "no profit");

        u.latestUnlockAmount = 0;
        u.totalStaticClaimed += staticPart;
        u.totalDynamicClaimed += dynamicPart;
        totalStaticPaid += staticPart;
        totalDynamicPaid += dynamicPart;

        _createOrderAndDistribute(msg.sender, amount);
        emit LogInvestIn(msg.sender, amount, block.timestamp, currentRound, u.inviteCode, u.myCode, coefficient);
    }

    function withdrawProfit() external onlyHuman {
        _requireGameActive();
        User storage u = _users[msg.sender];
        require(u.id != 0, "user not exist");

        uint256 staticPart = _collectStatic(msg.sender);
        uint256 dynamicPart = u.latestUnlockAmount;
        uint256 amount = staticPart + dynamicPart;
        require(amount > 0, "no profit");

        u.latestUnlockAmount = 0;
        u.totalStaticClaimed += staticPart;
        u.totalDynamicClaimed += dynamicPart;
        u.totalWithdrawn += amount;

        totalStaticPaid += staticPart;
        totalDynamicPaid += dynamicPart;
        roundWithdrawn[currentRound] += amount;

        _safeTransfer(address(payToken), msg.sender, amount);
        emit LogWithdrawProfit(msg.sender, amount, staticPart, dynamicPart);
    }

    function redeem() external onlyHuman {
        _requireGameActive();
        User storage u = _users[msg.sender];
        require(u.id != 0, "user not exist");

        uint256 amount = _collectRedeemablePrincipal(msg.sender);
        require(amount > 0, "no redeemable");

        u.totalWithdrawn += amount;
        roundWithdrawn[currentRound] += amount;

        _safeTransfer(address(payToken), msg.sender, amount);
        emit LogRedeem(msg.sender, amount, block.timestamp, currentRound);
    }

    function calDynamicProfit(uint256 amount, uint256 level) external view onlyAdminOrOwner returns (uint256) {
        uint256 rate = _dynamicRate(level, 1);
        return (amount * rate) / 1000;
    }

    function calStaticProfit(address account) external view onlyAdminOrOwner returns (uint256) {
        return _pendingStatic(account);
    }

    function getLatestUnlockAmount(address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _users[account].latestUnlockAmount + _pendingStatic(account);
    }

    function registerUserInfo(address account, string calldata myCode, string calldata refCode) external onlyOwner {
        require(account != address(0), "zero user");
        User storage u = _users[account];

        if (u.id == 0) {
            address ref = address(0);
            if (bytes(refCode).length > 0) {
                ref = _codeToUser[_stringKey(refCode)];
                require(ref != address(0), "referrer not exist");
                require(ref != account, "referrer can't be self");
            }
            _createUser(account, ref, myCode, refCode);
        } else {
            if (bytes(myCode).length > 0) {
                bytes32 key = _stringKey(myCode);
                address existing = _codeToUser[key];
                require(existing == address(0) || existing == account, "invite code is used");
                _codeToUser[key] = account;
                u.myCode = myCode;
            }

            if (bytes(refCode).length > 0 && u.referrer == address(0)) {
                address ref2 = _codeToUser[_stringKey(refCode)];
                require(ref2 != address(0), "referrer not exist");
                require(ref2 != account, "referrer can't be self");
                u.referrer = ref2;
                u.inviteCode = refCode;
                _users[ref2].directCount += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    function getUserAddressByCode(string calldata code) external view returns (address) {
        return _codeToUser[_stringKey(code)];
    }

    function isUsed(string calldata code) external view returns (bool) {
        return _codeToUser[_stringKey(code)] != address(0);
    }

    function indexMapping(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return _indexMapping[index];
    }

    function getSpecialUser(uint256 round, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        require(index < _specialUsers[round].length, "index overflow");
        return _specialUsers[round][index];
    }

    function getUserInfo(address account, uint256 start, uint256 size)
        external
        view
        onlyHuman
        returns (
            address referrer,
            string memory inviteCode,
            string memory myCode,
            uint256 totalInvest,
            uint256 totalStaticClaimed,
            uint256 totalDynamicClaimed,
            uint256 totalWithdrawn,
            uint256 teamInvest,
            uint256 directCount,
            uint256 latestUnlockAmount,
            uint256 joinTime,
            uint256 round,
            uint256 totalOrders,
            OrderView[] memory orders
        )
    {
        if (account == address(0)) {
            account = msg.sender;
        }

        User storage u = _users[account];
        referrer = u.referrer;
        inviteCode = u.inviteCode;
        myCode = u.myCode;
        totalInvest = u.totalInvest;
        totalStaticClaimed = u.totalStaticClaimed;
        totalDynamicClaimed = u.totalDynamicClaimed;
        totalWithdrawn = u.totalWithdrawn;
        teamInvest = u.teamInvest;
        directCount = u.directCount;
        latestUnlockAmount = u.latestUnlockAmount;
        joinTime = u.joinTime;
        round = u.round;
        totalOrders = u.orders.length;

        if (start > totalOrders) start = totalOrders;
        uint256 end = start + size;
        if (end > totalOrders) end = totalOrders;

        orders = new OrderView[](end - start);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < orders.length; ) {
            Order storage o = u.orders[start + i];
            orders[i] = OrderView({
                amount: o.amount,
                principal: o.principal,
                startAt: o.startAt,
                unlockAt: o.unlockAt,
                claimedStatic: o.claimedStatic
            });
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function _invest(address account, string memory myCode, string memory refCode, uint256 amount, bool isReinvest) internal {
        require(amount >= baseAmount && amount <= baseAmount * 2000, "between 1 and 2000");

        User storage u = _users[account];
        if (u.id == 0) {
            require(bytes(myCode).length > 0, "empty invite code");
            bytes32 myKey = _stringKey(myCode);
            require(_codeToUser[myKey] == address(0), "invite code is used");

            address ref = _codeToUser[_stringKey(refCode)];
            require(ref != address(0), "referrer not exist");
            require(ref != account, "referrer can't be self");
            _createUser(account, ref, myCode, refCode);
        }

        if (!isReinvest) {
            _safeTransferFrom(address(payToken), account, address(this), amount);
            if (address(feeToken) != address(0) && address(feeToken) != address(payToken)) {
                _safeTransferFrom(address(feeToken), account, address(this), amount);
            }
        }

        _createOrderAndDistribute(account, amount);
        User storage u2 = _users[account];
        emit LogInvestIn(account, amount, block.timestamp, currentRound, u2.inviteCode, u2.myCode, coefficient);
    }

    function _createUser(address account, address referrer, string memory myCode, string memory refCode) internal {
        User storage u = _users[account];
        if (u.id == 0) {
            userCount += 1;
            u.id = userCount;
            _indexMapping[userCount] = account;
            u.joinTime = block.timestamp;
            u.round = currentRound;
        }

        if (bytes(myCode).length > 0) {
            bytes32 codeKey = _stringKey(myCode);
            address existing = _codeToUser[codeKey];
            require(existing == address(0) || existing == account, "invite code is used");
            _codeToUser[codeKey] = account;
            u.myCode = myCode;
        }

        if (u.referrer == address(0) && referrer != address(0)) {
            require(referrer != account, "referrer can't be self");
            u.referrer = referrer;
            u.inviteCode = refCode;
            _users[referrer].directCount += 1;
        }
    }

    function _createOrderAndDistribute(address account, uint256 amount) internal {
        User storage u = _users[account];
        require(u.id != 0, "user not exist");
        require(u.totalInvest + amount <= baseAmount * 2000, "can not beyond 2000 eth");

        u.totalInvest += amount;
        u.round = currentRound;
        u.orders.push(
            Order({
                amount: amount,
                principal: amount,
                startAt: block.timestamp,
                unlockAt: block.timestamp + 30 days,
                claimedStatic: 0
            })
        );

        roundStaticPool[currentRound] += (amount * coefficient) / 1000;
        _specialUsers[currentRound].push(account);

        address up = u.referrer;
        uint256 depth = 1;
        while (up != address(0) && depth <= 20) {
            User storage ru = _users[up];
            ru.teamInvest += amount;

            uint256 stage = _stageOf(ru.totalInvest);
            uint256 rate = _dynamicRate(stage, depth);
            if (rate > 0) {
                uint256 reward = (amount * rate) / 1000;
                ru.latestUnlockAmount += reward;
                roundDynamicPool[currentRound] += reward;
            }

            up = ru.referrer;
            unchecked {
                ++depth;
            }
        }
    }

    function _pendingStatic(address account) internal view returns (uint256 pending) {
        User storage u = _users[account];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < u.orders.length; ) {
            Order storage o = u.orders[i];
            uint256 elapsedDays = block.timestamp > o.startAt ? (block.timestamp - o.startAt) / 1 days : 0;
            if (elapsedDays > 30) elapsedDays = 30;

            uint256 gross = (o.amount * coefficient * elapsedDays) / 1000;
            if (gross > o.claimedStatic) {
                pending += (gross - o.claimedStatic);
            }
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function _collectStatic(address account) internal returns (uint256 collected) {
        User storage u = _users[account];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < u.orders.length; ) {
            Order storage o = u.orders[i];
            uint256 elapsedDays = block.timestamp > o.startAt ? (block.timestamp - o.startAt) / 1 days : 0;
            if (elapsedDays > 30) elapsedDays = 30;

            uint256 gross = (o.amount * coefficient * elapsedDays) / 1000;
            if (gross > o.claimedStatic) {
                uint256 delta = gross - o.claimedStatic;
                o.claimedStatic = gross;
                collected += delta;
            }
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function _collectRedeemablePrincipal(address account) internal returns (uint256 amount) {
        User storage u = _users[account];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < u.orders.length; ) {
            Order storage o = u.orders[i];
            if (o.principal > 0 && block.timestamp >= o.unlockAt) {
                amount += o.principal;
                o.principal = 0;
            }
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function _stageOf(uint256 invested) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (invested < baseAmount) return 0;
        if (invested <= baseAmount * 500) return 1;
        if (invested <= baseAmount * 1000) return 2;
        return 3;
    }

    function _dynamicRate(uint256 stage, uint256 depth) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (stage == 1) {
            if (depth == 1) return 50;
            return 0;
        }
        if (stage == 2) {
            if (depth == 1) return 70;
            if (depth == 2) return 50;
            return 0;
        }
        if (stage == 3) {
            if (depth == 1) return 100;
            if (depth == 2) return 70;
            if (depth == 3) return 50;
            if (depth <= 10) return 10;
            if (depth <= 20) return 5;
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    function _requireGameActive() internal view {
        require(gameDeadline != 0 && gameDeadline > block.timestamp, "game not start");
    }

    function _stringKey(string memory value) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(bytes(value));
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token != address(0), "token not set");
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x23b872dd, from, to, value));
        require(_callResult(ok, data), "transferFrom failed");
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token != address(0), "token not set");
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0xa9059cbb, to, value));
        require(_callResult(ok, data), "transfer failed");
    }

    function _callResult(bool ok, bytes memory data) internal pure returns (bool) {
        if (!ok) return false;
        if (data.length == 0) return true;
        if (data.length >= 32) return abi.decode(data, (bool));
        return false;
    }
}

        if (_saleAuction != address(0)) IAuctionLike(_saleAuction).withdrawBalance();
        if (_siringAuction != address(0)) IAuctionLike(_siringAuction).withdrawBalance();
    }

    function withdrawBalance() external onlyCFO {
        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;
        uint256 reserved = (_pregnantPuppies + 1) * _autoBirthFee;
        if (balance > reserved) {
            (bool ok,) = payable(_cfoAddress).call{value: balance - reserved}("");
            if (!ok) revert InvalidState();
        }
    }

    function _checkHook(address target, bytes4 selector) internal view {
        if (target == address(0) || target.code.length == 0) revert InvalidAddress();
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = target.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(selector));
        if (!ok || ret.length < 32 || !abi.decode(ret, (bool))) revert InvalidAddress();
    }

    function _exists(uint256 _tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _tokenId > 0 && _tokenId < _puppies.length && _puppyIndexToOwner[_tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _owns(address _claimant, uint256 _tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _puppyIndexToOwner[_tokenId] == _claimant;
    }

    function _approvedFor(address _claimant, uint256 _tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _puppyIndexToApproved[_tokenId] == _claimant;
    }

    function _approve(address _to, uint256 _tokenId) internal {
        _puppyIndexToApproved[_tokenId] = _to;
        emit Approval(_puppyIndexToOwner[_tokenId], _to, _tokenId);
    }

    function _transfer(address _from, address _to, uint256 _tokenId) internal {
        _ownershipTokenCount[_to] += 1;
        _puppyIndexToOwner[_tokenId] = _to;

        if (_from != address(0)) {
            _ownershipTokenCount[_from] -= 1;
            delete _sireAllowedToAddress[_tokenId];
            delete _puppyIndexToApproved[_tokenId];
        }

        emit Transfer(_from, _to, _tokenId);
    }

    function _createPuppy(
        uint256 _matronId,
        uint256 _sireId,
        uint16 _generation,
        uint256 _genes,
        address _owner,
        uint16[5] memory attrs
    ) internal returns (uint256) {
        uint16 cooldownIndex = _generation / 2;
        if (cooldownIndex > 13) cooldownIndex = 13;

        Puppy memory p = Puppy({
            genes: _genes,
            birthTime: uint64(block.timestamp),
            cooldownEndBlock: 0,
            matronId: uint32(_matronId),
            sireId: uint32(_sireId),
            siringWithId: 0,
            cooldownIndex: cooldownIndex,
            generation: _generation,
            attrs: attrs
        });

        _puppies.push(p);
        uint256 newPuppyId = _puppies.length - 1;

        emit Birth(_owner, newPuppyId, _matronId, _sireId, _genes);
        _transfer(address(0), _owner, newPuppyId);

        return newPuppyId;
    }

    function _isSiringPermitted(uint256 _sireId, address _matronOwner) internal view returns (bool) {
        address sireOwner = _puppyIndexToOwner[_sireId];
        return (_matronOwner == sireOwner || _sireAllowedToAddress[_sireId] == _matronOwner);
    }

    function _triggerCooldown(Puppy storage _pup) internal {
        uint256 duration = _cooldownDurations[_pup.cooldownIndex];
        uint256 blocksToWait = duration / _secondsPerBlock;
        if (duration % _secondsPerBlock != 0) blocksToWait += 1;
        _pup.cooldownEndBlock = uint64(block.number + blocksToWait);

        if (_pup.cooldownIndex < 13) {
            _pup.cooldownIndex += 1;
        }
    }

    function _breedWith(uint256 _matronId, uint256 _sireId) internal {
        if (_childCount[_matronId] >= _maxChildCount || _childCount[_sireId] >= _maxChildCount) revert InvalidState();

        Puppy storage matron = _puppies[_matronId];
        Puppy storage sire = _puppies[_sireId];

        matron.siringWithId = uint32(_sireId);

        _triggerCooldown(matron);
        _triggerCooldown(sire);

        _childCount[_matronId] += 1;
        _childCount[_sireId] += 1;

        delete _sireAllowedToAddress[_matronId];
        _pregnantPuppies += 1;

        emit Pregnant(_puppyIndexToOwner[_matronId], _matronId, _sireId, matron.cooldownEndBlock);
    }

    function _computeNextGen0Price() internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_saleAuction == address(0)) return _GEN0_STARTING_PRICE;
        uint256 avg = _GEN0_STARTING_PRICE;

        try IAuctionLike(_saleAuction).averageGen0SalePrice() returns (uint256 v) {
            avg = v;
        } catch {
            return _GEN0_STARTING_PRICE;
        }

        uint256 next = avg + (avg / 2);
        if (next < _GEN0_MINIMAL_PRICE) next = _GEN0_MINIMAL_PRICE;
        if (next > _GEN0_STARTING_PRICE) next = _GEN0_STARTING_PRICE;
        return next;
    }

    function _mixGenes(uint256 g1, uint256 g2, uint256 targetBlock) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_geneScience != address(0)) {
            try IGeneScience(_geneScience).mixGenes(g1, g2, targetBlock) returns (uint256 mixed) {
                return mixed;
            } catch {}
        }
        return uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(g1, g2, targetBlock, block.prevrandao)));
    }

    function _mixAttributes(Puppy storage m, Puppy storage s, uint256 seed) internal view returns (uint16[5] memory out) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            uint256 r = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(seed, i, block.timestamp, block.prevrandao)));
            out[i] = (r & 1) == 0 ? m.attrs[i] : s.attrs[i];
        }
    }

    function _rand(uint256 seed, uint256 modulus) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 h = uint256(
            keccak256(
                abi.encodePacked(
                    blockhash(block.number - 1),
                    block.coinbase,
                    block.prevrandao,
                    seed,
                    address(this),
                    msg.sender
                )
            )
        );
        if (modulus == 0) return h;
        return h % modulus;
    }

    function _bytes32ArrayToString(bytes32[4] memory buffer, uint256 count) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (count == 0) return "";
        if (count > 128) count = 128;

        bytes memory packed = abi.encodePacked(buffer[0], buffer[1], buffer[2], buffer[3]);
        bytes memory out = new bytes(count);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            out[i] = packed[i];
        }

        return string(out);
    }

    function _acceptAuctionCallback() internal view {
        if (msg.sender != _saleAuction && msg.sender != _siringAuction) revert NotAuthorized();
    }

    receive() external payable {
        _acceptAuctionCallback();
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        _acceptAuctionCallback();
    }
}

        require(b <= a, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");

    }

    function USDC() external view returns (address) {

    }

    function USDT() external view returns (address) {
        return _USDT;
    }

    function buoy() external view returns (address) {
        return _buoy;
    }

        return _buoy;
    }

        return 6;

    function DAI_DECIMALS() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 18;
    }

    function USDC_DECIMALS() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 6;
    }

    function USDT_DECIMALS() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 6;
    }

    function PERCENTAGE_DECIMAL_FACTOR() external pure returns (uint256) {

        return 1e18;
    }

    function ctrlPaused() external view returns (bool) {
        require(controller != address(0), "controller: not set");
        (bool p, bool ok) = _tryStaticBool(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x5c975abb)));
        require(ok, "controller: paused call failed");
        return p;
    }

    function totalAssets() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _stableToLp(_assetSnapshot(), true);

    function totalAssetsUsd() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lpToUsd(totalAssets());
    }

    function availableLP() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _stableToLp(_tokenBalances(), false);
    }

    function availableUsd() external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 lp = _lpBalance().add(availableLP());
        return _lpToUsd(lp);
    }

    function investToCurveVaultTrigger() external view returns (bool) {
        if (investToCurveThreshold == 0) return false;
        return availableLP() >= investToCurveThreshold;
    }

    function setController(address newController) external onlyOwner {
        require(newController != address(0), "new controller is zero");
        emit ChangeController(controller, newController);
        controller = newController;
    }

    function setDependencies() external onlyOwner {
        require(controller != address(0), "controller not set");

        address oldWithdraw = withdrawHandler;
        address oldDeposit = depositHandler;

        (address w, bool wok) = _tryStaticAddress(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x083473ef)));
        if (wok) withdrawHandler = w;

        (address d, bool dok) = _tryStaticAddress(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x9c8b2cfb)));
        if (dok) depositHandler = d;

        (address ins, bool iok) = _tryStaticAddress(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x89cf3204)));
        if (iok) insurance = ins;

        (address b, bool bok) = _tryStaticAddress(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xb1cbf3ad)));
        if (!bok) (b, bok) = _tryStaticAddress(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa456b702)));
        if (bok) _buoy = b;

        address cv = _curveVaultAddress();
        if (cv != address(0)) {
            (address lp, bool lkok) = _tryStaticAddress(cv, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xfc0c546a)));
            if (lkok) _lpToken = lp;
        }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < N_COINS_CONST; i++) {
            address token = _tokenByIndex(i);
            if (token == address(0)) continue;

            if (oldWithdraw != address(0)) _safeApprove(token, oldWithdraw, 0, false);
            if (withdrawHandler != address(0)) _safeApprove(token, withdrawHandler, uint256(-1), false);

            if (oldDeposit != address(0)) _safeApprove(token, oldDeposit, 0, false);
            if (depositHandler != address(0)) _safeApprove(token, depositHandler, uint256(-1), false);
        }

        for (uint256 j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            _approveVault(j);
        }
    }

    function addToWhitelist(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(account != address(0), "zero address");
        whitelist[account] = true;
        emit LogAddToWhitelist(account);
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(account != address(0), "zero address");
        whitelist[account] = false;
        emit LogRemoveFromWhitelist(account);
    }

    function approveVaults(uint256 vaultIndex) external onlyOwner {
        _approveVault(vaultIndex);
    }

    function setInvestToCurveThreshold(uint256 threshold) external onlyOwner {
        investToCurveThreshold = threshold;
        emit LogNewCurveThreshold(threshold);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function deposit() external onlyDepositHandler returns (uint256) {
        uint256 minted = _depositStableInternal(false, true);
        if (investToCurveThreshold > 0 && availableLP() >= investToCurveThreshold) {
            uint256 lp = _lpBalance();
            if (lp > 0) _depositToCurveVault(lp);
        }
        return minted;
    }

    function depositStable(bool investNow) external onlyInsuranceOrWithdrawHandler returns (uint256) {
        return _depositStableInternal(investNow, true);
    }

    function investToCurveVault() external {
        require(whitelist[msg.sender], "investToCurveVault: !whitelist");
        _depositStableInternal(false, false);
        uint256 lp = _lpBalance();
        if (lp > 0) _depositToCurveVault(lp);
    }

    function invest(uint256 lpAmount, uint256[3] calldata minAmounts) external onlyInsuranceOrDepositHandler returns (uint256) {
        uint256 amount = lpAmount == 1 ? _lpBalance() : lpAmount;
        if (amount > 0) _depositToCurveVault(amount);

        uint256[3] memory inA = _copyArray(minAmounts);
        uint256[3] memory outA = _tokenBalances();
        emit LogNewInvest(amount, inA, outA, _lpToUsd(amount), false);
        return amount;
    }

    function investSingle(uint256[3] calldata amounts, uint256 fromIndex, uint256 toIndex) external onlyDepositHandler returns (uint256) {
        require(fromIndex < N_COINS_CONST && toIndex < N_COINS_CONST, "index out of range");
        uint256[3] memory inA = _copyArray(amounts);

        if (fromIndex != toIndex && inA[fromIndex] > 0 && _crv3pool != address(0)) {
            _functionCall(
                _crv3pool,
                abi.encodeWithSelector(
                    bytes4(0x3df02124),
                    int128(int256(fromIndex)),
                    int128(int256(toIndex)),
                    inA[fromIndex],
                    uint256(0)
                )
            );
        }

        return _stableToUsd(inA, true);
    }

    function distributeCurveVault(uint256 lpAmount, uint256[3] calldata portions)
        external
        onlyController
        returns (uint256[3] memory outAmounts)
    {
        _withdrawFromCurveVault(lpAmount);
        outAmounts = _copyArray(portions);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < N_COINS_CONST; i++) {
            assets[i] = outAmounts[i];
        }
    }

    function withdrawSingleByLiquidity(uint256 lpAmount, uint256 coinIndex, address recipient)
        external
        onlyWithdrawHandler
        returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 usdOut)
    {
        return _withdrawSingle(lpAmount, coinIndex, recipient, false);
    }

    function withdrawSingleByExchange(uint256 lpAmount, uint256 coinIndex, address recipient)
        external
        onlyWithdrawHandler
        returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 usdOut)
    {
        return _withdrawSingle(lpAmount, coinIndex, recipient, true);
    }

    function _withdrawSingle(
        uint256 lpAmount,
        uint256 coinIndex,
        address recipient,
        bool /*viaExchange*/
    ) internal returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 usdOut) {
        require(coinIndex < N_COINS_CONST, "coin index");
        address token = _tokenByIndex(coinIndex);
        require(token != address(0), "coin token not set");

        uint256 beforeBal = _erc20Balance(token);
        _withdrawFromCurveVault(lpAmount);

        if (_crv3pool != address(0)) {
            _functionCall(
                _crv3pool,
                abi.encodeWithSelector(
                    bytes4(0x1a4d01d2),
                    lpAmount,
                    int128(int256(coinIndex)),
                    uint256(0)
                )
            );
        }

        uint256 afterBal = _erc20Balance(token);
        amountOut = afterBal.sub(beforeBal);

        if (amountOut > 0 && recipient != address(0)) {
            _safeTransfer(token, recipient, amountOut);
        }

        usdOut = _singleStableToUsd(amountOut, coinIndex);
    }

    function _depositStableInternal(bool investNow, bool emitEvent_) internal returns (uint256 minted) {
        uint256[3] memory amounts = _tokenBalances();

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < N_COINS_CONST; i++) {
            assets[i] = amounts[i];
        }

        uint256 beforeLp = _lpBalance();
        if (_crv3pool != address(0) && (amounts[0] > 0 || amounts[1] > 0 || amounts[2] > 0)) {
            _functionCall(_crv3pool, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x4515cef3), amounts, uint256(0)));
        }
        uint256 afterLp = _lpBalance();

        if (afterLp > beforeLp) {
            minted = afterLp.sub(beforeLp);
        }

        if (emitEvent_) {
            emit LogNewStableDeposit(amounts, minted, investNow);
        }

        if (investNow && minted > 0) {
            _depositToCurveVault(minted);
        }
    }

    function _approveVault(uint256 vaultIndex) internal {
        if (controller == address(0)) return;

        address vault;
        if (vaultIndex < N_COINS_CONST) {
            (vault, ) = _tryStaticAddress(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xab3ec003), vaultIndex));
        } else {
            (vault, ) = _tryStaticAddress(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xbbcb15c2)));
        }
        if (vault == address(0)) return;

        (address token, bool ok) = _tryStaticAddress(vault, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xfc0c546a)));
        if (!ok || token == address(0)) return;

        _safeApprove(token, vault, 0, false);
        _safeApprove(token, vault, uint256(-1), true);
    }

    function _depositToCurveVault(uint256 amount) internal {
        address cv = _curveVaultAddress();
        if (cv == address(0) || amount == 0) return;

        address lp = _resolvedLpToken();
        if (lp != address(0)) {
            _safeApprove(lp, cv, 0, false);
            _safeApprove(lp, cv, amount, false);
        }

        _functionCall(cv, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xb6b55f25), amount));
        _functionCall(cv, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xe8b5e51f)));
    }

    function _withdrawFromCurveVault(uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount == 0) return;
        address cv = _curveVaultAddress();
        if (cv == address(0)) return;
        _functionCall(cv, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x2e1a7d4d), amount));
    }

    function _curveVaultAddress() internal view returns (address cv) {
        (cv, ) = _tryStaticAddress(controller, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xbbcb15c2)));
    }

    function _resolvedLpToken() internal view returns (address) {
        if (_lpToken != address(0)) return _lpToken;

        address cv = _curveVaultAddress();
        if (cv == address(0)) return address(0);

        (address t, bool ok) = _tryStaticAddress(cv, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xfc0c546a)));
        return ok ? t : address(0);
    }

    function _stableToLp(uint256[3] memory amounts, bool flag) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_buoy == address(0)) return 0;
        (uint256 v, bool ok) = _tryStaticUint(_buoy, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x66c2bdcf), amounts, flag));
        return ok ? v : 0;
    }

    function _stableToUsd(uint256[3] memory amounts, bool flag) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_buoy == address(0)) return 0;
        (uint256 v, bool ok) = _tryStaticUint(_buoy, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x538ef7e1), amounts, flag));
        return ok ? v : 0;
    }

    function _lpToUsd(uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_buoy == address(0)) return 0;
        (uint256 v, bool ok) = _tryStaticUint(_buoy, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x03e6f5cc), amount));
        return ok ? v : 0;
    }

    function _singleStableToUsd(uint256 amount, uint256 coinIndex) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_buoy == address(0)) return 0;
        (uint256 v, bool ok) = _tryStaticUint(_buoy, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x884d9812), amount, coinIndex));
        if (!ok) {
            (v, ok) = _tryStaticUint(_buoy, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x884d9812), coinIndex, amount));
        }
        return ok ? v : 0;
    }

    function _tokenByIndex(uint256 i) internal view returns (address) {
        if (i == 0) return _DAI;
        if (i == 1) return _USDC;
        if (i == 2) return _USDT;
        return address(0);
    }

    function _assetSnapshot() internal view returns (uint256[3] memory arr) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < N_COINS_CONST; i++) {
            arr[i] = assets[i];
        }
    }

    function _tokenBalances() internal view returns (uint256[3] memory arr) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < N_COINS_CONST; i++) {
            arr[i] = _erc20Balance(_tokenByIndex(i));
        }
    }

    function _lpBalance() internal view returns (uint256) {
        address lp = _resolvedLpToken();
        if (lp == address(0)) return 0;
        (uint256 v, bool ok) = _tryStaticUint(lp, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x70a08231), address(this)));
        return ok ? v : 0;
    }

    function _erc20Balance(address token) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (token == address(0)) return 0;
        (uint256 v, bool ok) = _tryStaticUint(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x70a08231), address(this)));
        return ok ? v : 0;
    }

    function _copyArray(uint256[3] calldata src) internal pure returns (uint256[3] memory dst) {
        dst[0] = src[0];
        dst[1] = src[1];
        dst[2] = src[2];
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20(token).transfer.selector, to, value));
    }

    function _safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 value, bool checkAllowanceZero) internal {
        if (token == address(0) || spender == address(0)) return;

        if (checkAllowanceZero && value != 0) {
            (uint256 currentAllowance, bool ok) = _tryStaticUint(
                token,
                abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xdd62ed3e), address(this), spender)
            );
            if (ok) {
                require(currentAllowance == 0, "SafeERC20: approve from non-zero to non-zero allowance");
            }
        }

        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20(token).approve.selector, spender, value));
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data) internal {
        bytes memory ret = _functionCall(token, data);
        if (ret.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }

    function _functionCall(address target, bytes memory data) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        require(target != address(0), "Address: call to the zero address");
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call(data);
        if (!success) {
            if (returndata.length > 0) {
                assembly {
                    revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
                }
            }
            revert("Address: low-level call failed");
        }
        return returndata;
    }

    function _tryStaticAddress(address target, bytes memory data) internal view returns (address value, bool ok) {
        if (target == address(0)) return (address(0), false);
        (ok, data) = target.staticcall(data);
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) {
            value = abi.decode(data, (address));
        } else {
            ok = false;
        }
    }

    function _tryStaticUint(address target, bytes memory data) internal view returns (uint256 value, bool ok) {
        if (target == address(0)) return (0, false);
        (ok, data) = target.staticcall(data);
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) {
            value = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
        } else {
            ok = false;
        }
    }

    function _tryStaticBool(address target, bytes memory data) internal view returns (bool value, bool ok) {
        if (target == address(0)) return (false, false);
        (ok, data) = target.staticcall(data);
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) {
            value = abi.decode(data, (bool));
        } else {
            ok = false;
        }
    }
}

        InversePricing storage inv = inversePricing[currencyKey];
        require(inv.entryPoint != 0, "Cannot freeze non-inverse rate");
        require(!inv.frozenAtUpperLimit && !inv.frozenAtLowerLimit, "The rate is already frozen");

        uint256 rawRate = _rawRateForCurrency(currencyKey);
        uint256 candidate = _inverseCandidate(inv.entryPoint, rawRate);
        require(candidate >= inv.upperLimit || candidate <= inv.lowerLimit, "Rate within bounds");

        if (candidate >= inv.upperLimit) {
            inv.frozenAtUpperLimit = true;
            _frozenRateByKey[currencyKey] = inv.upperLimit;
            emit InversePriceFrozen(currencyKey, inv.upperLimit, candidate, msg.sender);
            _trySetLastExchangeRateForPynth(currencyKey, inv.upperLimit);
        } else {
            inv.frozenAtLowerLimit = true;
            _frozenRateByKey[currencyKey] = inv.lowerLimit;
            emit InversePriceFrozen(currencyKey, inv.lowerLimit, candidate, msg.sender);
            _trySetLastExchangeRateForPynth(currencyKey, inv.lowerLimit);
        }
    }

    function deleteRate(bytes32 currencyKey) external onlyOracle {
        require(rateForCurrency(currencyKey) > 0, "Rate is zero");

        delete _rates[currencyKey];
        delete _lastRateUpdateTimes[currencyKey];

        uint256 nextRound = currentRoundForRate[currencyKey] + 1;
        currentRoundForRate[currencyKey] = nextRound;
        _roundRates[currencyKey][nextRound] = 0;
        _roundTimes[currencyKey][nextRound] = block.timestamp;

        emit RateDeleted(currencyKey);
    }

    function updateRates(bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys, uint256[] calldata newRates, uint256 timeSent) external onlyOracle {
        require(currencyKeys.length == newRates.length, "Currency key array length must match rates array length");
        require(timeSent <= block.timestamp + ORACLE_FUTURE_LIMIT, "Time is too far into the future");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            bytes32 key = currencyKeys[i];
            uint256 nextRate = newRates[i];

            require(nextRate > 0, "Zero is not a valid rate");
            require(key != PUSD, "Rate of pUSD cannot be updated");

            if (timeSent < _lastRateUpdateTimes[key]) {
                continue;
            }

            _rates[key] = nextRate;
            _lastRateUpdateTimes[key] = timeSent;

            uint256 nextRound = currentRoundForRate[key] + 1;
            currentRoundForRate[key] = nextRound;
            _roundRates[key][nextRound] = nextRate;
            _roundTimes[key][nextRound] = timeSent;

            _maybeFreezeInverse(key, nextRate);
        }

        emit RatesUpdated(currencyKeys, newRates);
    }

    function rateForCurrency(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 rate, ) = _rateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
        return rate;
    }

    function rateAndUpdatedTime(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (uint256 rate, uint256 time) {
        return _rateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
    }

    function rateAndTimestampAtRound(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 roundId) external view returns (uint256 rate, uint256 time) {
        return _rateAndTimestampAtRound(currencyKey, roundId);
    }

    function getCurrentRoundId(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint256) {
        address aggregator = aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (aggregator != address(0)) {
            return _safeLatestRound(aggregator);
        }
        return currentRoundForRate[currencyKey];
    }

    function getLastRoundIdBeforeElapsedSecs(
        bytes32 currencyKey,
        uint256 startingRoundId,
        uint256 startingTimestamp,
        uint256 timediff
    ) external view returns (uint256) {
        if (startingRoundId == 0) return 0;
        uint256 target = startingTimestamp > timediff ? startingTimestamp - timediff : 0;

        for (uint256 i = startingRoundId; i > 0; i--) {
            (, uint256 ts) = _rateAndTimestampAtRound(currencyKey, i);
            if (ts != 0 && ts <= target) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    function ratesAndUpdatedTimeForCurrencyLastNRounds(
        bytes32 currencyKey,
        uint256 numRounds
    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory rates, uint256[] memory times) {
        rates = new uint256[](numRounds);
        times = new uint256[](numRounds);

        uint256 currentRound = getCurrentRoundId(currencyKey);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < numRounds; i++) {
            if (currentRound <= i) break;
            (rates[i], times[i]) = _rateAndTimestampAtRound(currencyKey, currentRound - i);
        }
    }

    function ratesForCurrencies(bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys) external view returns (uint256[] memory results) {
        results = new uint256[](currencyKeys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            results[i] = rateForCurrency(currencyKeys[i]);
        }
    }

    function lastRateUpdateTimes(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint256) {
        (, uint256 t) = _rateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
        return t;
    }

    function lastRateUpdateTimesForCurrencies(bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys) external view returns (uint256[] memory times) {
        times = new uint256[](currencyKeys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            times[i] = lastRateUpdateTimes(currencyKeys[i]);
        }
    }

    function rateAndInvalid(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint256 rate, bool invalid) {
        uint256 updated;
        (rate, updated) = _rateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
        invalid = _isInvalid(currencyKey, rate, updated);
    }

    function rateIsInvalid(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (bool) {
        (, bool invalid) = rateAndInvalid(currencyKey);
        return invalid;
    }

    function anyRateIsInvalid(bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys) external view returns (bool) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            if (rateIsInvalid(currencyKeys[i])) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    function ratesAndInvalidForCurrencies(
        bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys
    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory rates, bool anyInvalid) {
        rates = new uint256[](currencyKeys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            (rates[i], anyInvalid) = _accumulateInvalid(currencyKeys[i], anyInvalid);
        }
    }

    function rateIsFlagged(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (bool) {
        address flags = aggregatorWarningFlags();
        if (flags == address(0)) return false;

        address aggregator = aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (aggregator == address(0)) return false;

        try IAggregatorWarningFlags(flags).getFlag(aggregator) returns (bool f) {
            return f;
        } catch {
            return false;
        }
    }

    function rateIsFrozen(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (bool) {
        InversePricing memory inv = inversePricing[currencyKey];
        return inv.frozenAtUpperLimit || inv.frozenAtLowerLimit;
    }

    function roundFrozen(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _frozenRateByKey[currencyKey];
    }

    function currencyKeyDecimals(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint8) {
        if (currencyKey == PUSD) return 18;

        address aggregator = aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (aggregator == address(0)) return 18;

        uint8 stored = _decimalsByKey[currencyKey];
        if (stored != 0) return stored;

        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).decimals() returns (uint8 d) {
            return d;
        } catch {
            return 18;
        }
    }

    function effectiveValue(bytes32 sourceKey, uint256 sourceAmount, bytes32 destinationKey) external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 sourceRate = rateForCurrency(sourceKey);
        uint256 destinationRate = rateForCurrency(destinationKey);
        require(destinationRate > 0, "Rate is zero");
        return (sourceAmount * sourceRate) / destinationRate;
    }

    function effectiveValueAndRates(
        bytes32 sourceKey,
        uint256 sourceAmount,
        bytes32 destinationKey
    ) external view returns (uint256 value, uint256 sourceRate, uint256 destinationRate) {
        sourceRate = rateForCurrency(sourceKey);
        destinationRate = rateForCurrency(destinationKey);
        require(destinationRate > 0, "Rate is zero");
        value = (sourceAmount * sourceRate) / destinationRate;
    }

    function effectiveValueAtRound(
        bytes32 sourceKey,
        uint256 sourceAmount,
        bytes32 destinationKey,
        uint256 sourceRoundId,
        uint256 destinationRoundId
    ) external view returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 sourceRate, ) = _rateAndTimestampAtRound(sourceKey, sourceRoundId);
        (uint256 destinationRate, ) = _rateAndTimestampAtRound(destinationKey, destinationRoundId);
        require(destinationRate > 0, "Rate is zero");
        return (sourceAmount * sourceRate) / destinationRate;
    }

    function currenciesUsingAggregator(address aggregator) external view returns (bytes32[] memory keys) {
        uint256 count = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < aggregatorKeys.length; i++) {
            if (aggregators[aggregatorKeys[i]] == aggregator) count++;
        }

        keys = new bytes32[](count);
        uint256 j = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < aggregatorKeys.length; i++) {
            bytes32 key = aggregatorKeys[i];
            if (aggregators[key] == aggregator) {
                keys[j++] = key;
            }
        }
    }

    function resolverAddressesRequired() public pure returns (bytes32[] memory requiredAddresses) {
        requiredAddresses = new bytes32[](2);
        requiredAddresses[0] = CONTRACT_FLEXIBLESTORAGE;
        requiredAddresses[1] = CONTRACT_EXCHANGER;
    }

    function rebuildCache() external {
        require(resolver != address(0), "Resolver not set");
        bytes32[] memory requiredAddresses = resolverAddressesRequired();

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requiredAddresses.length; i++) {
            address destination = IAddressResolver(resolver).requireAndGetAddress(
                requiredAddresses[i],
                "Resolver missing target: "
            );
            addressCache[requiredAddresses[i]] = destination;
            emit CacheUpdated(requiredAddresses[i], destination);
        }
    }

    function isResolverCached() external view returns (bool) {
        if (resolver == address(0)) return false;

        bytes32[] memory requiredAddresses = resolverAddressesRequired();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requiredAddresses.length; i++) {
            address cached = addressCache[requiredAddresses[i]];
            if (cached == address(0)) return false;

            try IAddressResolver(resolver).getAddress(requiredAddresses[i]) returns (address destination) {
                if (destination != cached) return false;
            } catch {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    function rateStalePeriod() public view returns (uint256) {
        address flex = _flexibleStorage();
        if (flex != address(0)) {
            try IFlexibleStorage(flex).getUIntValue(CONTRACT_SYSTEMSETTINGS, SETTING_RATE_STALE_PERIOD) returns (uint256 p) {
                if (p > 0) return p;
            } catch {}
        }
        return DEFAULT_RATE_STALE_PERIOD;
    }

    function aggregatorWarningFlags() public view returns (address) {
        address flex = _flexibleStorage();
        if (flex != address(0)) {
            try IFlexibleStorage(flex).getAddressValue(CONTRACT_SYSTEMSETTINGS, SETTING_AGGREGATOR_WARNING_FLAGS) returns (address flags) {
                return flags;
            } catch {}
        }
        return address(0);
    }

    function rateIsStale(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (bool) {
        return _rateIsStale(currencyKey);
    }

    function _accumulateInvalid(bytes32 currencyKey, bool alreadyInvalid) internal view returns (uint256 rate, bool invalid) {
        uint256 updated;
        (rate, updated) = _rateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
        invalid = alreadyInvalid || _isInvalid(currencyKey, rate, updated);
    }

    function _isInvalid(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rate, uint256 updateTime) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (currencyKey == PUSD) return false;
        if (rate == 0) return true;
        if (_isRateStaleTime(updateTime)) return true;
        if (rateIsFlagged(currencyKey)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    function _rateIsStale(bytes32 currencyKey) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (currencyKey == PUSD) return false;
        return _isRateStaleTime(lastRateUpdateTimes(currencyKey));
    }

    function _isRateStaleTime(uint256 time) internal view returns (bool) {
        return time + rateStalePeriod() < block.timestamp;
    }

    function _rateAndUpdatedTime(bytes32 currencyKey) internal view returns (uint256 rate, uint256 updatedTime) {
        (uint256 rawRate, uint256 rawTime) = _rawRateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
        return (_applyInversePricingView(currencyKey, rawRate), rawTime);
    }

    function _rawRateAndUpdatedTime(bytes32 currencyKey) internal view returns (uint256 rate, uint256 updatedTime) {
        if (currencyKey == PUSD) {
            return (UNIT, block.timestamp);
        }

        if (currencyByExternal[currencyKey]) {
            require(externalRateAggregator != address(0), "External price aggregator is not set yet");
            return IExternalRateAggregator(externalRateAggregator).getRateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
        }

        address aggregator = aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (aggregator != address(0)) {
            uint256 latestRound = _safeLatestRound(aggregator);
            if (latestRound == 0) return (0, 0);
            return _readAggregatorRound(currencyKey, aggregator, latestRound);
        }

        return (_rates[currencyKey], _lastRateUpdateTimes[currencyKey]);
    }

    function _rateAndTimestampAtRound(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 roundId) internal view returns (uint256 rate, uint256 updatedTime) {
        if (currencyKey == PUSD) return (UNIT, block.timestamp);
        if (roundId == 0) return (0, 0);

        if (currencyByExternal[currencyKey]) {
            return _rateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
        }

        address aggregator = aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (aggregator != address(0)) {
            (uint256 rawRate, uint256 ts) = _readAggregatorRound(currencyKey, aggregator, roundId);
            return (_applyInversePricingView(currencyKey, rawRate), ts);
        }

        uint256 raw = _roundRates[currencyKey][roundId];
        uint256 ts2 = _roundTimes[currencyKey][roundId];
        if (ts2 == 0 && roundId == currentRoundForRate[currencyKey]) {
            raw = _rates[currencyKey];
            ts2 = _lastRateUpdateTimes[currencyKey];
        }

        return (_applyInversePricingView(currencyKey, raw), ts2);
    }

    function _applyInversePricingView(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rate) internal view returns (uint256) {
        InversePricing memory inv = inversePricing[currencyKey];
        if (inv.entryPoint == 0) return rate;
        if (inv.frozenAtUpperLimit) return inv.upperLimit;
        if (inv.frozenAtLowerLimit) return inv.lowerLimit;

        uint256 candidate = _inverseCandidate(inv.entryPoint, rate);
        if (candidate >= inv.upperLimit) return inv.upperLimit;
        if (candidate <= inv.lowerLimit) return inv.lowerLimit;
        return candidate;
    }

    function _maybeFreezeInverse(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rawRate) internal {
        InversePricing storage inv = inversePricing[currencyKey];
        if (inv.entryPoint == 0 || inv.frozenAtUpperLimit || inv.frozenAtLowerLimit) return;

        uint256 candidate = _inverseCandidate(inv.entryPoint, rawRate);
        if (candidate >= inv.upperLimit) {
            inv.frozenAtUpperLimit = true;
            _frozenRateByKey[currencyKey] = inv.upperLimit;
            emit InversePriceFrozen(currencyKey, inv.upperLimit, candidate, msg.sender);
            _trySetLastExchangeRateForPynth(currencyKey, inv.upperLimit);
        } else if (candidate <= inv.lowerLimit) {
            inv.frozenAtLowerLimit = true;
            _frozenRateByKey[currencyKey] = inv.lowerLimit;
            emit InversePriceFrozen(currencyKey, inv.lowerLimit, candidate, msg.sender);
            _trySetLastExchangeRateForPynth(currencyKey, inv.lowerLimit);
        }
    }

    function _rawRateForCurrency(bytes32 currencyKey) internal view returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 raw, ) = _rawRateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
        return raw;
    }

    function _readAggregatorRound(
        bytes32 currencyKey,
        address aggregator,
        uint256 roundId
    ) internal view returns (uint256 rate, uint256 updatedTime) {
        uint8 dec = currencyKeyDecimals(currencyKey);

        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).getRoundData(uint80(roundId)) returns (
            uint80,
            int256 answer,
            uint256,
            uint256 updateTime,
            uint80
        ) {
            updatedTime = updateTime;
            if (answer > 0) {
                rate = _scaleTo18(uint256(answer), dec);
            }
        } catch {
            uint256 latest = _safeLatestRound(aggregator);
            if (roundId == latest) {
                int256 ans;
                uint256 ts;
                try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).latestAnswer() returns (int256 a) {
                    ans = a;
                } catch {}
                try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).latestTimestamp() returns (uint256 t) {
                    ts = t;
                } catch {}
                if (ans > 0) {
                    rate = _scaleTo18(uint256(ans), dec);
                }
                updatedTime = ts;
            }
        }
    }

    function _safeLatestRound(address aggregator) internal view returns (uint256) {
        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).latestRound() returns (uint256 r) {
            return r;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _validateAggregator(address aggregator) internal view returns (uint8 dec) {
        bool okRound;
        uint256 latest;
        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).latestRound() returns (uint256 r) {
            latest = r;
            okRound = true;
        } catch {}
        require(okRound && latest > 0, "Given Aggregator is invalid");

        bool okDecimals;
        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).decimals() returns (uint8 d) {
            dec = d;
            okDecimals = true;
        } catch {}
        require(okDecimals, "Given Aggregator is invalid");
        require(dec <= 18, "Aggregator decimals should be lower or equal to 18");
    }

    function _scaleTo18(uint256 value, uint8 decimals_) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (decimals_ == 18) return value;
        if (decimals_ < 18) return value * (10 ** (18 - decimals_));
        uint8 diff = decimals_ - 18;
        if (diff >= 78) return 0;
        return value / (10 ** diff);
    }

    function _inverseCandidate(uint256 entryPoint, uint256 rawRate) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 doubleEntry = entryPoint * 2;
        return doubleEntry > rawRate ? doubleEntry - rawRate : 0;
    }

    function _removeFromArray(bytes32[] storage array, bytes32 value) internal returns (bool) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
            if (array[i] == value) {
                array[i] = array[array.length - 1];
                array.pop();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    function _flexibleStorage() internal view returns (address fs) {
        fs = addressCache[CONTRACT_FLEXIBLESTORAGE];
        if (fs == address(0) && resolver != address(0)) {
            try IAddressResolver(resolver).getAddress(CONTRACT_FLEXIBLESTORAGE) returns (address found) {
                fs = found;
            } catch {}
        }
    }

    function _trySetLastExchangeRateForPynth(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rate) internal {
        address exchanger = addressCache[CONTRACT_EXCHANGER];
        if (exchanger == address(0) && resolver != address(0)) {
            try IAddressResolver(resolver).getAddress(CONTRACT_EXCHANGER) returns (address found) {
                exchanger = found;
            } catch {}
        }

        if (exchanger != address(0)) {
            try IExchanger(exchanger).setLastExchangeRateForPynth(currencyKey, rate) {} catch {}
        }
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.6.12;
pragma experimental ABIEncoderV2;

library BoringMath {
    function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256 c) {
        c = a + b;
        require(c >= a, "BoringMath: Add Overflow");
    }

    function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256 c) {
        require(b <= a, "BoringMath: Underflow");
        c = a - b;
    }

    function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256 c) {
        if (a == 0) return 0;
        c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b, "BoringMath: Mul Overflow");
    }

    function to128(uint256 a) internal pure returns (uint128 c) {
        require(a <= uint128(-1), "BoringMath: uint128 Overflow");
        c = uint128(a);
    }
}

interface IERC20 {}

interface IOracle {
    function get(bytes calldata data) external returns (bool success, uint256 rate);
}

interface IBentoBox {
    function owner() external view returns (address);
    function toShare(address token, uint256 amount, bool roundUp) external view returns (uint256 share);
    function toAmount(address token, uint256 share, bool roundUp) external view returns (uint256 amount);
    function transfer(address token, address from, address to, uint256 share) external;
    function withdraw(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount, uint256 share) external returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut);
    function deposit(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount, uint256 share) external returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut);
    function balanceOf(address token, address user) external view returns (uint256);
    function setMasterContractApproval(address user, address masterContract, bool approved, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external;
}

contract Cauldron {
    using BoringMath for uint256;

    struct Rebase {
        uint128 elastic;
        uint128 base;
    }

    struct AccrueInfoData {
        uint64 lastAccrued;
        uint128 feesEarned;
        uint64 INTEREST_PER_SECOND;
    }

    struct BorrowLimitData {
        uint128 total;
        uint128 borrowPartPerAddress;
    }

    struct InitData {
        address bentoBox;
        address masterContract;
        address magicInternetMoney;
        address collateral;
        address oracle;
        bytes oracleData;
        uint64 interestPerSecond;
        uint256 liquidationMultiplier;
        uint256 collaterizationRate;
        uint256 borrowOpeningFee;
    }

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event LogExchangeRate(uint256 rate);
    event LogInterestChange(uint64 oldInterestRate, uint64 newInterestRate);
    event LogAddCollateral(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 share);
    event LogRemoveCollateral(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 share);
    event LogBorrow(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint256 part);
    event LogRepay(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint256 part);
    event LogLiquidation(address indexed liquidator, address indexed user, address indexed to, uint256 borrowPart, uint256 borrowAmount, uint256 collateralShare);
    event LogWithdrawFees(address indexed feeTo, uint256 feesEarned);
    event LogFeeTo(address indexed newFeeTo);
    event LogAccrue(uint128 extraAmount);
    event LogChangeBorrowLimit(uint128 total, uint128 borrowPartPerAddress);

    address public owner;
    address public pendingOwner;
    address public feeTo;

    address public bentoBox;
    address public masterContract;
    address public magicInternetMoney;

    IERC20 public collateral;
    IOracle public oracle;
    bytes public oracleData;

    uint256 public exchangeRate;
    uint256 public totalCollateralShare;

    mapping(address => uint256) public userCollateralShare;
    mapping(address => uint256) public userBorrowPart;

    uint256 public LIQUIDATION_MULTIPLIER;
    uint256 public COLLATERIZATION_RATE;
    uint256 public BORROW_OPENING_FEE;

    Rebase private _totalBorrow;
    AccrueInfoData private _accrueInfo;
    BorrowLimitData private _borrowLimit;
    uint64 public lastInterestUpdate;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor() public {
        owner = msg.sender;
        feeTo = msg.sender;
        LIQUIDATION_MULTIPLIER = 112000;
        COLLATERIZATION_RATE = 75000;
        BORROW_OPENING_FEE = 50;
        lastInterestUpdate = uint64(block.timestamp);
        _accrueInfo.lastAccrued = uint64(block.timestamp);
        _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND = 317097920;
    }

    function _bento() internal view returns (IBentoBox) {
        return IBentoBox(bentoBox);
    }

    function _requireBentoOwner() internal view {
        if (bentoBox == address(0)) {
            require(msg.sender == owner, "Caller is not the owner");
        } else {
            require(_bento().owner() == msg.sender, "Caller is not the owner");
        }
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner, bool direct, bool renounce) external onlyOwner {
        if (direct) {
            require(newOwner != address(0) || renounce, "Ownable: zero address");
            emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
            owner = newOwner;
            pendingOwner = address(0);
        } else {
            pendingOwner = newOwner;
        }
    }

    function claimOwnership() external {
        require(msg.sender == pendingOwner, "Ownable: caller != pending owner");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, pendingOwner);
        owner = pendingOwner;
        pendingOwner = address(0);
    }

    function setFeeTo(address newFeeTo) external onlyOwner {
        feeTo = newFeeTo;
        emit LogFeeTo(newFeeTo);
    }

    function init(bytes calldata data) external payable {
        require(address(collateral) == address(0), "Cauldron: already initialized");
        InitData memory x = abi.decode(data, (InitData));

        bentoBox = x.bentoBox;
        masterContract = x.masterContract;
        magicInternetMoney = x.magicInternetMoney;

        collateral = IERC20(x.collateral);
        oracle = IOracle(x.oracle);
        oracleData = x.oracleData;

        _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND = x.interestPerSecond;
        _accrueInfo.lastAccrued = uint64(block.timestamp);
        lastInterestUpdate = uint64(block.timestamp);

        LIQUIDATION_MULTIPLIER = x.liquidationMultiplier;
        COLLATERIZATION_RATE = x.collaterizationRate;
        BORROW_OPENING_FEE = x.borrowOpeningFee;
    }

    function totalBorrow() external view returns (uint128 elastic, uint128 base) {
        elastic = _totalBorrow.elastic;
        base = _totalBorrow.base;
    }

    function accrueInfo() external view returns (uint64 lastAccrued, uint128 feesEarned, uint64 INTEREST_PER_SECOND_) {
        lastAccrued = _accrueInfo.lastAccrued;
        feesEarned = _accrueInfo.feesEarned;
        INTEREST_PER_SECOND_ = _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND;
    }

    function borrowLimit() external view returns (uint128 total, uint128 borrowPartPerAddress) {
        total = _borrowLimit.total;
        borrowPartPerAddress = _borrowLimit.borrowPartPerAddress;
    }

    function _toShare(address token, uint256 amount, bool roundUp) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (bentoBox == address(0)) return amount;
        return _bento().toShare(token, amount, roundUp);
    }

    function _toAmount(address token, uint256 share, bool roundUp) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (bentoBox == address(0)) return share;
        return _bento().toAmount(token, share, roundUp);
    }

    function _amountToPart(uint256 amount, bool roundUp) internal view returns (uint256 part) {
        uint256 elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic);
        uint256 base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base);
        if (elastic == 0) {
            part = amount;
        } else {
            part = amount.mul(base) / elastic;
            if (roundUp && part.mul(elastic) / base < amount) {
                part = part.add(1);
            }
        }
    }

    function _partToAmount(uint256 part, bool roundUp) internal view returns (uint256 amount) {
        uint256 elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic);
        uint256 base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base);
        if (base == 0) {
            amount = part;
        } else {
            amount = part.mul(elastic) / base;
            if (roundUp && amount.mul(base) / elastic < part) {
                amount = amount.add(1);
            }
        }
    }

    function updateExchangeRate() public returns (bool updated, uint256 rate) {
        if (address(oracle) == address(0)) {
            return (false, exchangeRate);
        }

        (updated, rate) = oracle.get(oracleData);
        if (updated) {
            exchangeRate = rate;
            emit LogExchangeRate(rate);
        } else {
            rate = exchangeRate;
        }
    }

    function accrue() public {
        AccrueInfoData memory info = _accrueInfo;
        if (info.lastAccrued == 0) {
            info.lastAccrued = uint64(block.timestamp);
            _accrueInfo = info;
            return;
        }

        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp.sub(uint256(info.lastAccrued));
        if (elapsed == 0) return;

        info.lastAccrued = uint64(block.timestamp);

        if (_totalBorrow.base > 0 && info.INTEREST_PER_SECOND > 0) {
            uint256 extraAmount = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).mul(uint256(info.INTEREST_PER_SECOND)).mul(elapsed) / 1e18;
            if (extraAmount > 0) {
                uint128 extraAmount128 = extraAmount.to128();
                _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).add(extraAmount).to128();
                info.feesEarned = uint256(info.feesEarned).add(extraAmount).to128();
                emit LogAccrue(extraAmount128);
            }
        }

        _accrueInfo = info;
    }

    function _isSolvent(address user, uint256 rate) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 part = userBorrowPart[user];
        if (part == 0) return true;
        if (rate == 0) return false;

        uint256 borrowAmount = _partToAmount(part, false);
        uint256 cShare = userCollateralShare[user];
        uint256 cAmount = _toAmount(address(collateral), cShare, false);

        uint256 collateralValue = cAmount.mul(COLLATERIZATION_RATE).mul(1e18).div(1e5).div(rate);
        return collateralValue >= borrowAmount;
    }
