        if (share == 0) return;

        if (!skim && bentoBox != address(0)) {
            _bento().transfer(address(collateral), msg.sender, address(this), share);
        }

        userCollateralShare[to] = userCollateralShare[to].add(share);
        totalCollateralShare = totalCollateralShare.add(share);

        emit LogAddCollateral(skim ? address(this) : msg.sender, to, share);
    }

    function removeCollateral(address to, uint256 share) public {
        accrue();

        userCollateralShare[msg.sender] = userCollateralShare[msg.sender].sub(share);
        totalCollateralShare = totalCollateralShare.sub(share);

        uint256 rate = exchangeRate;
        if (rate == 0) {
            (, rate) = updateExchangeRate();
        }
        require(_isSolvent(msg.sender, rate), "Cauldron: user insolvent");

        if (bentoBox != address(0)) {
            _bento().transfer(address(collateral), address(this), to, share);
        }

        emit LogRemoveCollateral(msg.sender, to, share);
    }

    function borrow(address to, uint256 amount) public returns (uint256 part, uint256 share) {
        accrue();

        uint256 feeAmount = amount.mul(BORROW_OPENING_FEE).div(1e5);
        uint256 totalAmount = amount.add(feeAmount);

        part = _amountToPart(totalAmount, true);

        if (_borrowLimit.total > 0) {
            require(uint256(_totalBorrow.base).add(part) <= uint256(_borrowLimit.total), "Cauldron: borrow limit reached");
        }
        if (_borrowLimit.borrowPartPerAddress > 0) {
            require(userBorrowPart[msg.sender].add(part) <= uint256(_borrowLimit.borrowPartPerAddress), "Cauldron: borrow limit reached");
        }

        userBorrowPart[msg.sender] = userBorrowPart[msg.sender].add(part);
        _totalBorrow.base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base).add(part).to128();
        _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).add(totalAmount).to128();
        _accrueInfo.feesEarned = uint256(_accrueInfo.feesEarned).add(feeAmount).to128();

        uint256 rate = exchangeRate;
        if (rate == 0) {
            (, rate) = updateExchangeRate();
        }
        require(rate > 0, "Cauldron: rate not ok");
        require(_isSolvent(msg.sender, rate), "Cauldron: user insolvent");

        if (bentoBox != address(0) && magicInternetMoney != address(0)) {
            share = _toShare(magicInternetMoney, amount, false);
            _bento().transfer(magicInternetMoney, address(this), to, share);
        } else {
            share = amount;
        }

        emit LogBorrow(msg.sender, to, amount, part);
    }

    function repay(address to, bool skim, uint256 part) public returns (uint256 amount) {
        accrue();

        if (part == 0) {
            part = userBorrowPart[to];
        }

        amount = _partToAmount(part, false);

        if (!skim && bentoBox != address(0) && magicInternetMoney != address(0)) {
            uint256 share = _toShare(magicInternetMoney, amount, true);
            _bento().transfer(magicInternetMoney, msg.sender, address(this), share);
        }

        userBorrowPart[to] = userBorrowPart[to].sub(part);
        _totalBorrow.base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base).sub(part).to128();
        _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).sub(amount).to128();

        emit LogRepay(skim ? address(this) : msg.sender, to, amount, part);
    }

    function liquidate(address[] calldata users, uint256[] calldata maxBorrowParts, address to, address swapper) external {
        swapper;
        require(users.length == maxBorrowParts.length, "Cauldron: bad len");

        accrue();

        uint256 rate = exchangeRate;
        if (rate == 0) {
            (, rate) = updateExchangeRate();
        }
        require(rate > 0, "Cauldron: rate not ok");

        bool allSolvent = true;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < users.length; i++) {
            address user = users[i];
            if (_isSolvent(user, rate)) continue;

            allSolvent = false;

            uint256 userPart = userBorrowPart[user];
            uint256 part = maxBorrowParts[i] > userPart ? userPart : maxBorrowParts[i];
            if (part == 0) continue;

            uint256 amount = _partToAmount(part, false);
            uint256 collateralAmount = amount.mul(LIQUIDATION_MULTIPLIER).mul(rate).div(1e23);
            uint256 collateralShare = _toShare(address(collateral), collateralAmount, false);

            uint256 uShare = userCollateralShare[user];
            if (collateralShare > uShare) collateralShare = uShare;

            userBorrowPart[user] = userPart.sub(part);
            _totalBorrow.base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base).sub(part).to128();
            _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).sub(amount).to128();

            userCollateralShare[user] = uShare.sub(collateralShare);
            totalCollateralShare = totalCollateralShare.sub(collateralShare);

            if (bentoBox != address(0)) {
                _bento().transfer(address(collateral), address(this), to, collateralShare);
            }

            emit LogLiquidation(msg.sender, user, to, part, amount, collateralShare);
        }

        require(!allSolvent, "Cauldron: all are solvent");
    }

    function withdrawFees() external {
        _requireBentoOwner();
        accrue();

        uint256 feesEarned = uint256(_accrueInfo.feesEarned);
        _accrueInfo.feesEarned = 0;

        if (feesEarned > 0 && bentoBox != address(0) && magicInternetMoney != address(0) && feeTo != address(0)) {
            uint256 share = _toShare(magicInternetMoney, feesEarned, false);
            _bento().transfer(magicInternetMoney, address(this), feeTo, share);
        }

        emit LogWithdrawFees(feeTo, feesEarned);
    }

    function reduceSupply(uint256 amount) external {
        _requireBentoOwner();
        accrue();

        if (amount > uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic)) {
            amount = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic);
        }

        _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).sub(amount).to128();
        if (_totalBorrow.base > _totalBorrow.elastic) {
            _totalBorrow.base = _totalBorrow.elastic;
        }
    }

    function changeBorrowLimit(uint128 total, uint128 borrowPartPerAddress) external {
        _requireBentoOwner();
        _borrowLimit.total = total;
        _borrowLimit.borrowPartPerAddress = borrowPartPerAddress;
        emit LogChangeBorrowLimit(total, borrowPartPerAddress);
    }

    function changeInterestRate(uint64 newInterestPerSecond) external {
        _requireBentoOwner();

        uint64 oldRate = _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND;
        if (oldRate > 0) {
            require(uint256(newInterestPerSecond) <= uint256(oldRate).add(uint256(oldRate).mul(75).div(100)), "Interest rate increase > 75%");
        }

        require(block.timestamp >= uint256(lastInterestUpdate).add(3 days), "Update only every 3 days");

        accrue();
        lastInterestUpdate = uint64(block.timestamp);
        _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND = newInterestPerSecond;

        emit LogInterestChange(oldRate, newInterestPerSecond);
    }

    function cook(uint8[] calldata actions, uint256[] calldata values, bytes[] calldata datas) external payable returns (uint256 value1, uint256 value2) {
        require(actions.length == values.length && actions.length == datas.length, "Cauldron: invalid cook length");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actions.length; i++) {
            uint8 action = actions[i];

            if (action == 2) {
                (address to, bool skim, uint256 part) = abi.decode(datas[i], (address, bool, uint256));
                value1 = repay(to, skim, part);
            } else if (action == 4) {
                (address to, uint256 share) = abi.decode(datas[i], (address, uint256));
                removeCollateral(to, share);
            } else if (action == 5) {
                (address to, uint256 amount) = abi.decode(datas[i], (address, uint256));
                (value1, value2) = borrow(to, amount);
            } else if (action == 6) {
                (address to, bool skim, uint256 share) = abi.decode(datas[i], (address, bool, uint256));
                addCollateral(to, skim, share);
            } else if (action == 10) {
                (bool updated, uint256 rate) = updateExchangeRate();
                value1 = updated ? 1 : 0;
                value2 = rate;
            } else if (action == 24) {
                (address user, address master, bool approved, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) =
                    abi.decode(datas[i], (address, address, bool, uint8, bytes32, bytes32));
                if (bentoBox != address(0)) {
                    _bento().setMasterContractApproval(user, master, approved, v, r, s);
                }
            } else {
                bytes memory callData = datas[i];
                (bool ok, bytes memory result) = address(this).delegatecall(callData);
                require(ok, "Cauldron: cook failed");

                if (result.length >= 64) {
                    (value1, value2) = abi.decode(result, (uint256, uint256));
                } else if (result.length >= 32) {
                    value1 = abi.decode(result, (uint256));
                }
            }

            values[i];
        }

        uint256 rateCheck = exchangeRate;
        if (rateCheck == 0) {
            (, rateCheck) = updateExchangeRate();
        }
        if (rateCheck > 0) {
            require(_isSolvent(msg.sender, rateCheck), "Cauldron: user insolvent");
        }
    }
}

interface IERC165 {
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external view returns (bool);
}

interface IERC721Receiver {
    function onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
}

interface ILandBalanceToken {
    function balanceOf(address user) external view returns (uint256);
    function destroyTokens(address user, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function generateTokens(address user, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
}

interface IEstateRegistry {
    function ownerOf(uint256 estateId) external view returns (address);
    function mint(address to, string calldata metadata) external returns (uint256);
}

interface IMetadataProvider {
    function getMetadata(uint256 assetId) external view returns (string memory);
}

contract LANDRegistry is IERC165 {
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);

    event UpdateManager(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, address indexed caller, bool approved);

    event DeployAuthorized(address indexed account, address indexed caller);
    event DeployForbidden(address indexed account, address indexed caller);

    event EstateRegistrySet(address indexed estateRegistry);
    event SetLandBalanceToken(address indexed previousLandBalance, address indexed newLandBalance);

    bytes4 private constant _ERC165_ID = 0x01ffc9a7;
    bytes4 private constant _ERC721_ID = 0x80ac58cd;
    bytes4 private constant _LAND_ID = 0x7c0633c6;
    bytes4 private constant _METADATA_SELECTOR = 0xa574cea4;
    bytes4 private constant _ERC721_RECEIVED = 0x150b7a02;

    int256 private constant _COORD_LIMIT = 1_000_000;

    address private _currentContract;
    address private _proxyOwner;
    address private _owner;

    string private _nameValue;
    string private _symbolValue;
    string private _descriptionValue;

    uint256 private _totalSupplyValue;

    mapping(address => uint256[]) private _ownedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex;

    mapping(uint256 => string) private _tokenData;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _updateManagers;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _updateOperators;

    address private _landBalanceToken;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _latestPing;
    address private _estateRegistry;

    mapping(address => bool) private _authorizedDeploy;
    mapping(address => bool) private _registeredBalance;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "unauthorized");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyProxyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _proxyOwner, "unauthorized");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _proxyOwner = msg.sender;
        _owner = msg.sender;
        _currentContract = address(this);

        _nameValue = "Decentraland LAND";
        _symbolValue = "LAND";
        _descriptionValue = "Contract that stores the Decentraland LAND registry";
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure override returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == _ERC165_ID || interfaceId == _ERC721_ID || interfaceId == _LAND_ID;
    }

    function initialize(bytes calldata data) external {
        require(msg.sender == _owner || msg.sender == _proxyOwner, "Unauthorized user");
        if (data.length >= 20) {
            address target;
            assembly {
                target := shr(96, calldataload(data.offset))
            }
            if (target != address(0)) {
                _currentContract = target;
            }
        }
    }

    function currentContract() external view returns (address) {
        return _currentContract;
    }

    function proxyOwner() external view returns (address) {
        return _proxyOwner;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "invalid address");
        require(newOwner != _owner, "Cannot transfer to yourself");
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _nameValue;
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbolValue;
    }

    function description() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _descriptionValue;
    }

    function decimals() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 0;
    }

    function GET_METADATA() external pure returns (bytes4) {
        return _METADATA_SELECTOR;
    }

    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSupplyValue;
    }

    function balanceOf(address holder) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(holder != address(0), "invalid address");
        return _ownedTokens[holder].length;
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address holder = _owners[tokenId];
        require(holder != address(0), "token does not exist");
        return holder;
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address holder, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _ownedTokens[holder].length, "index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[holder][index];
    }

    function tokensOf(address holder) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _ownedTokens[holder];
    }

    function landOf(address holder) external view returns (int256[] memory xs, int256[] memory ys) {
        uint256[] storage ids = _ownedTokens[holder];
        xs = new int256[](ids.length);
        ys = new int256[](ids.length);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            (xs[i], ys[i]) = decodeTokenId(ids[i]);
        }
    }

    function exists(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function exists(int256 x, int256 y) external view returns (bool) {
        return exists(encodeTokenId(x, y));
    }

    function encodeTokenId(int256 x, int256 y) public pure returns (uint256) {
        _requireInBounds(x, y);
        return (uint256(uint128(int128(x))) << 128) | uint256(uint128(int128(y)));
    }

    function decodeTokenId(uint256 tokenId) public pure returns (int256 x, int256 y) {
        x = int256(int128(uint128(tokenId >> 128)));
        y = int256(int128(uint128(tokenId)));
    }

    function ownerOfLand(int256 x, int256 y) external view returns (address) {
        return ownerOf(encodeTokenId(x, y));
    }

    function ownerOfLandMany(int256[] calldata xs, int256[] calldata ys) external view returns (address[] memory owners_) {
        _requireCoordinatesInput(xs.length, ys.length);
        owners_ = new address[](xs.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            owners_[i] = _owners[encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i])];
        }
    }

    function approve(address approved, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address holder = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(msg.sender == holder || _operatorApprovals[holder][msg.sender], "unauthorized user");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = approved;
        emit Approval(holder, approved, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        require(exists(tokenId), "token does not exist");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function getApprovedAddress(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        return getApproved(tokenId);
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "operator should be different from owner");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address holder, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[holder][operator];
    }

    function isAuthorized(address operator, uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isApprovedOrOwner(operator, tokenId);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        _authorizedTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        _safeAuthorizedTransfer(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external {
        _safeAuthorizedTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function updateManager(address holder, address operator) external view returns (bool) {
        return _updateManagers[holder][operator];
    }

    function setUpdateManager(address holder, address operator, bool approved) external {
        bool canSet = (msg.sender == holder) || _operatorApprovals[holder][msg.sender];
        require(canSet, "Unauthorized user");
        _updateManagers[holder][operator] = approved;
        emit UpdateManager(holder, operator, msg.sender, approved);
    }

    function updateOperator(uint256 assetId) external view returns (address) {
        return _updateOperators[assetId];
    }

    function setUpdateOperator(uint256 assetId, address operator) public {
        address holder = ownerOf(assetId);
        bool allowed = msg.sender == holder || _operatorApprovals[holder][msg.sender] || _updateManagers[holder][msg.sender];
        require(allowed, "unauthorized user");
        _updateOperators[assetId] = operator;
        emit UpdateOperator(assetId, operator);
    }

    function setManyUpdateOperator(uint256[] calldata assetIds, address operator) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assetIds.length; i++) {
            setUpdateOperator(assetIds[i], operator);
        }
    }

    function isUpdateAuthorized(address operator, uint256 assetId) public view returns (bool) {
        address holder = _owners[assetId];
        if (holder == address(0)) return false;
        return operator == holder
            || _tokenApprovals[assetId] == operator
            || _operatorApprovals[holder][operator]
            || _updateManagers[holder][operator]
            || _updateOperators[assetId] == operator;
    }

    function landData(int256 x, int256 y) external view returns (string memory) {
        return _tokenData[encodeTokenId(x, y)];
    }

    function updateLandData(int256 x, int256 y, string calldata data) external {
        uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(x, y);
        require(_owners[assetId] != address(0), "token does not exist");
        require(isUpdateAuthorized(msg.sender, assetId), "msg.sender is not authorized to update");
        _tokenData[assetId] = data;
        emit Update(assetId, _owners[assetId], msg.sender, data);
    }

    function updateManyLandData(int256[] calldata xs, int256[] calldata ys, string calldata data) external {
        _requireCoordinatesInput(xs.length, ys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i]);
            require(_owners[assetId] != address(0), "token does not exist");
            require(isUpdateAuthorized(msg.sender, assetId), "msg.sender is not authorized to update");
            _tokenData[assetId] = data;
            emit Update(assetId, _owners[assetId], msg.sender, data);
        }
    }

    function tokenMetadata(uint256 assetId) public view returns (string memory) {
        if (_currentContract != address(0) && _currentContract != address(this)) {
            try IERC165(_currentContract).supportsInterface(_METADATA_SELECTOR) returns (bool ok) {
                if (ok) {
                    try IMetadataProvider(_currentContract).getMetadata(assetId) returns (string memory data) {
                        return data;
                    } catch {}
                }
            } catch {}
        }
        return _tokenData[assetId];
    }

    function getMetadata(uint256 assetId) external view returns (string memory) {
        return tokenMetadata(assetId);
    }

    function transferLand(int256 x, int256 y, address to) external {
        uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(x, y);
        _authorizedTransfer(ownerOf(assetId), to, assetId);
    }

    function transferManyLand(int256[] calldata xs, int256[] calldata ys, address to) external {
        _requireCoordinatesInput(xs.length, ys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i]);
            _authorizedTransfer(ownerOf(assetId), to, assetId);
        }
    }

    function assignNewParcel(int256 x, int256 y, address beneficiary) external {
        require(_isDeployAuthorized(msg.sender), "can only be called by an authorized deployer");
        _assignNewParcel(x, y, beneficiary);
    }

    function assignMultipleParcels(int256[] calldata xs, int256[] calldata ys, address beneficiary) external {
        require(_isDeployAuthorized(msg.sender), "can only be called by an authorized deployer");
        _requireCoordinatesInput(xs.length, ys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            _assignNewParcel(xs[i], ys[i], beneficiary);
        }
    }

    function createEstate(int256[] calldata xs, int256[] calldata ys, address beneficiary) external returns (uint256 estateId) {
        estateId = _createEstate(xs, ys, beneficiary, "");
    }

        int256[] calldata xs,
        int256[] calldata ys,
        address beneficiary,
        string calldata metadata
    ) external returns (uint256 estateId) {
        estateId = _createEstate(xs, ys, beneficiary, metadata);
    }

    function transferLandToEstate(int256 x, int256 y, uint256 estateId) external {
        require(_estateRegistry != address(0), "The Estate registry should be set");
        require(IEstateRegistry(_estateRegistry).ownerOf(estateId) == msg.sender, "You must own the Estate you want to transfer to");

        uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(x, y);
        _safeAuthorizedTransfer(ownerOf(assetId), _estateRegistry, assetId, abi.encode(estateId));
    }

    function transferManyLandToEstate(int256[] calldata xs, int256[] calldata ys, uint256 estateId) external {
        require(_estateRegistry != address(0), "The Estate registry should be set");
        require(IEstateRegistry(_estateRegistry).ownerOf(estateId) == msg.sender, "You must own the Estate you want to transfer to");
        _requireCoordinatesInput(xs.length, ys.length);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i]);
            _safeAuthorizedTransfer(ownerOf(assetId), _estateRegistry, assetId, abi.encode(estateId));
        }
    }

    function authorizedDeploy(address who) external view returns (bool) {
        return _authorizedDeploy[who];
    }

    function authorizeDeploy(address who) external onlyProxyOwner {
        require(who != address(0), "invalid address");
        require(!_authorizedDeploy[who], "address is already authorized");
        _authorizedDeploy[who] = true;
        emit DeployAuthorized(who, msg.sender);

        return _registeredBalance[user];

        require(!_registeredBalance[msg.sender], "Register Balance::The user is already registered");
        require(_landBalanceToken != address(0), "land balance token not set");

        uint256 amount = ILandBalanceToken(_landBalanceToken).balanceOf(msg.sender);
        if (amount > 0) {

        uint256 amount = ILandBalanceToken(_landBalanceToken).balanceOf(msg.sender);

    }

        return _latestPing[user];
    }

        require(allowed, "Unauthorized user");
        _latestPing[user] = block.timestamp;
    }

    function ping() external {
        _latestPing[msg.sender] = block.timestamp;
    }

    function _createEstate(
        int256[] calldata xs,
        int256[] calldata ys,

    ) internal returns (uint256 estateId) {

        _requireCoordinatesInput(xs.length, ys.length);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {

            _safeAuthorizedTransfer(ownerOf(assetId), _estateRegistry, assetId, abi.encode(estateId));

    }

    function _safeAuthorizedTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _authorizedTransfer(from, to, tokenId);

        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            bytes4 retval = IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data);
            require(retval == _ERC721_RECEIVED, "receiver rejected ERC721");
        }
    }

    function _transferToken(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        delete _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
        delete _updateOperators[tokenId];

        _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);

        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        _syncLandBalanceOnTransfer(from, to);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "invalid address");
        require(_owners[tokenId] == address(0), "already minted");

        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        _totalSupplyValue += 1;

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        _syncLandBalanceOnTransfer(address(0), to);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address operator, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address holder = _owners[tokenId];
        if (holder == address(0)) return false;
        return operator == holder || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == operator || _operatorApprovals[holder][operator];
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
        _ownedTokens[to].push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 lastIndex = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        _ownedTokens[from].pop();
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _syncLandBalanceOnTransfer(address from, address to) internal {
        if (_landBalanceToken == address(0)) return;

        if (from != address(0) && _registeredBalance[from]) {
            require(ILandBalanceToken(_landBalanceToken).destroyTokens(from, 1), "Could not destroy tokens");
        }

        if (to != address(0) && _registeredBalance[to]) {
            require(ILandBalanceToken(_landBalanceToken).generateTokens(to, 1), "Could not generate tokens");
        }
    }

    function _isDeployAuthorized(address who) internal view returns (bool) {
        return who == _proxyOwner || _authorizedDeploy[who];
    }

    function _requireCoordinatesInput(uint256 lenX, uint256 lenY) internal pure {
        require(lenX > 0, "You should supply at least one coordinate");
        require(lenX == lenY, "The coordinate should have the same length");
    }

    function _requireInBounds(int256 x, int256 y) internal pure {
        require(
            x > -_COORD_LIMIT && x < _COORD_LIMIT && y > -_COORD_LIMIT && y < _COORD_LIMIT,
            "The coordinates should be inside bounds"
        );
    }
}

        if (!okWeth || wethData.length < 32) return;
        address weth = abi.decode(wethData, (address));

        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = weth;

        uint256 beforeEth = address(this).balance;

        (bool okSwap, ) = _uniswapV2RouterAddr.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(
                0x791ac947,
                tokenAmount,
                0,
                path,
                address(this),
                block.timestamp
            )
        );

        if (!okSwap) return;

        uint256 received = address(this).balance - beforeEth;
        _feesTokensSwapped += tokenAmount;
        _feesEthSwapped += received;

        if (received > 0) {
            address target = _marketingAddr == address(0) ? _owner : _marketingAddr;
            bool sent = _sendETHSilently(target, received);
            emit SendDividends(tokenAmount, received, sent);
        }
    }

    function _syncDividendBalances(address from, address to) internal {
        if (_dividendTrackerAddr == address(0)) return;

        _callNoReturn(_dividendTrackerAddr, abi.encodeWithSelector(0xe30443bc, from, _balances[from]));
        _callNoReturn(_dividendTrackerAddr, abi.encodeWithSelector(0xe30443bc, to, _balances[to]));

        if (!_swapping) {
            _callNoReturn(_dividendTrackerAddr, abi.encodeWithSelector(0xffb2c479, uint256(300000)));
        }
    }

    function _approve(address holder, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(holder != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowances[holder][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(holder, spender, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal {
        _totalTokenSupply += amount;
        _balances[account] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), account, amount);
    }

    function _callNoReturn(address target, bytes memory callData) internal {
        if (target == address(0)) return;
        (bool ok, ) = target.call(callData);
        ok;
    }

    function _staticUint(address target, bytes memory callData) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (target == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = target.staticcall(callData);
        if (!ok || ret.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(ret, (uint256));
    }

    function _staticAddress(address target, bytes memory callData) internal view returns (address) {
        if (target == address(0)) return address(0);
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = target.staticcall(callData);
        if (!ok || ret.length < 32) return address(0);
        return abi.decode(ret, (address));
    }

    function _accountInfoByAddress(address account)
        internal
        view
        returns (address, int256, int256, uint256, uint256, uint256)
    {
        if (_dividendTrackerAddr == address(0)) {
            return (account, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        }

        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = _dividendTrackerAddr.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(0xfbcbc0f1, account)
        );
        if (!ok || ret.length < 192) return (account, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);

        return abi.decode(ret, (address, int256, int256, uint256, uint256, uint256));
    }

    function _accountInfoByIndex(uint256 index)
        internal
        view
        returns (address, int256, int256, uint256, uint256, uint256)
    {
        if (_dividendTrackerAddr == address(0)) {
            return (address(0), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        }

        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = _dividendTrackerAddr.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(0x5183d6fd, index)
        );
        if (!ok || ret.length < 192) return (address(0), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);

        return abi.decode(ret, (address, int256, int256, uint256, uint256, uint256));
    }

    function _ownerSendETH(address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {
        uint256 sendAmount = amount;
        uint256 bal = address(this).balance;
        if (sendAmount > bal) sendAmount = bal;
        (bool success, ) = payable(to).call{value: sendAmount}("");
        require(success, "ETH transfer failed");
        return sendAmount;
    }

    function _sendETHSilently(address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (bool) {
        (bool success, ) = payable(to).call{value: amount}("");
        return success;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC721Receiver {
    function onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
}

library Strings {
    bytes16 private constant _HEX_SYMBOLS = "0123456789abcdef";

    function toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits--;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

    function toHexString(uint256 value, uint256 length) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(2 * length + 2);
        buffer[0] = "0";
        buffer[1] = "x";
        for (uint256 i = 2 * length + 1; i > 1; --i) {
            buffer[i] = _HEX_SYMBOLS[value & 0xf];
            value >>= 4;
        }
        require(value == 0, "Strings: hex length insufficient");
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

library ECDSA {
    bytes32 internal constant _MALLEABILITY_THRESHOLD =
        0x7fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff5d576e7357a4501ddfe92f46681b20a0;

    function recover(bytes32 hash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal pure returns (address) {
        if (uint256(s) > uint256(_MALLEABILITY_THRESHOLD)) {
            revert("ECDSA: invalid signature 's' value");
        }
        if (v != 27 && v != 28) {
            revert("ECDSA: invalid signature 'v' value");
        }
        address signer = ecrecover(hash, v, r, s);
        if (signer == address(0)) {
            revert("ECDSA: invalid signature");
        }
        return signer;
    }

    function toTypedDataHash(bytes32 domainSeparator, bytes32 structHash) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}

contract SoulboundERC721Votes {
    using Strings for uint256;

    // ==================== ERC165 interface ids ====================
    bytes4 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC165 = 0x01ffc9a7;
    bytes4 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721 = 0x80ac58cd;
    bytes4 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721_METADATA = 0x5b5e139f;
    bytes4 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721_ENUMERABLE = 0x780e9d63;
    bytes4 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ACCESS_CONTROL = 0x7965db0b;
    bytes4 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ACCESS_CONTROL_ENUMERABLE = 0x5a05180f;

    // ==================== AccessControl ====================
    bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;
    bytes32 public constant MINTER_ROLE = 0x9f2df0fed2c77648de5860a4cc508cd0818c85b8b8a1ab4ceeef8d981c8956a6;
    bytes32 public constant MANAGER_ROLE = 0x241ecf16d79d0f8dbfb92cbc07fe17840425976cf0667f022fe9877caa831b08;

    struct RoleData {
        mapping(address => bool) members;
        bytes32 adminRole;
        address[] memberList;
        mapping(address => uint256) memberIndexPlusOne;
    }

    mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) private _roles;

    event RoleAdminChanged(bytes32 indexed role, bytes32 indexed previousAdminRole, bytes32 indexed newAdminRole);
    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);

    // ==================== ERC721 ====================
    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;
    string private _baseTokenURI;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;

    // ==================== ERC721Enumerable ====================
    uint256[] private _allTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _allTokensIndex;
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _ownedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex;

    // ==================== Votes ====================
    struct Checkpoint {
        uint32 fromBlock;
        uint224 votes;
    }

    mapping(address => address) private _delegates;
    mapping(address => Checkpoint[]) private _delegateCheckpoints;
    Checkpoint[] private _totalSupplyCheckpoints;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _nonces;

    bytes32 private immutable _HASHED_NAME;
    bytes32 private constant _HASHED_VERSION = keccak256("1");
    bytes32 private constant _EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH =
        keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)");
    bytes32 private constant _DELEGATION_TYPEHASH =
        0xe48329057bfd03d55e49b547132e39cffd9c1820ad7b9d4c5307691425d15adf;

    event DelegateChanged(address indexed delegator, address indexed fromDelegate, address indexed toDelegate);
    event DelegateVotesChanged(address indexed delegate, uint256 previousBalance, uint256 newBalance);

    // ==================== ERC721 events ====================
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);

    modifier onlyRole(bytes32 role) {
        _checkRole(role, msg.sender);
        _;
    }

    constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_) {
        _name = name_;
        _symbol = symbol_;
        _HASHED_NAME = keccak256(bytes(name_));

        _roles[DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE].adminRole = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
        _roles[MINTER_ROLE].adminRole = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
        _roles[MANAGER_ROLE].adminRole = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;

        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(MANAGER_ROLE, msg.sender);
    }

    // ==================== ERC165 ====================
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC165 ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721 ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721_METADATA ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721_ENUMERABLE ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ACCESS_CONTROL ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ACCESS_CONTROL_ENUMERABLE;
    }

    // ==================== AccessControl ====================
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members[account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roles[role].adminRole;
    }

    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return _roles[role].memberList[index];
    }

    function getRoleMemberCount(bytes32 role) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _roles[role].memberList.length;
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) external onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) external onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            revert(
                string(
                    abi.encodePacked(
                        "AccessControl: account ",
                        Strings.toHexString(uint256(uint160(account)), 20),
                        " is missing role ",
                        Strings.toHexString(uint256(role), 32)
                    )
                )
            );
        }
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) return;

        _roles[role].members[account] = true;
        _roles[role].memberList.push(account);
        _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account] = _roles[role].memberList.length;

        emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) return;

        _roles[role].members[account] = false;

        uint256 idxPlusOne = _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account];
        if (idxPlusOne != 0) {
            uint256 idx = idxPlusOne - 1;
            uint256 lastIdx = _roles[role].memberList.length - 1;
            if (idx != lastIdx) {
                address last = _roles[role].memberList[lastIdx];
                _roles[role].memberList[idx] = last;
                _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[last] = idx + 1;
            }
            _roles[role].memberList.pop();
            delete _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account];
        }

        emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    // ==================== ERC721 Metadata ====================
    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function baseURI() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseTokenURI;
    }

    function setBaseURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external onlyRole(MANAGER_ROLE) {
        _baseTokenURI = newBaseURI;
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        if (bytes(_baseTokenURI).length == 0) {
            return "";
        }
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_baseTokenURI, tokenId.toString()));
    }

    // ==================== ERC721 Core ====================
    function balanceOf(address owner) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC721: address zero is not a valid owner");
        return _balances[owner];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address owner = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return owner;
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address owner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != owner, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(
            msg.sender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, msg.sender),
            "ERC721: approve caller is not token owner nor approved for all"
        );
        _approve(to, tokenId, owner);
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner][operator];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner nor approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function burn(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner nor approved");
        _burn(tokenId);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) external onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) {
        _safeMint(to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function batchMint(address to, uint256[] calldata tokenIds) external onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            _safeMint(to, tokenIds[i], "");
        }
    }

    // ==================== ERC721Enumerable ====================
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < balanceOf(owner), "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[owner][index];
    }

    // ==================== Votes ====================
    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _domainSeparatorV4();
    }

    function delegates(address account) external view returns (address) {
        return _delegates[account];
    }

    function nonces(address owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _nonces[owner];
    }

    function delegate(address delegatee) external {
        _delegate(msg.sender, delegatee);

    function delegateBySig(
        address delegatee,
        uint256 nonce,
        uint256 expiry,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s

        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(_DELEGATION_TYPEHASH, delegatee, nonce, expiry));
        bytes32 digest = ECDSA.toTypedDataHash(_domainSeparatorV4(), structHash);
        address signer = ECDSA.recover(digest, v, r, s);

        require(from == address(0) || to == address(0), "SBT: you can only mint or burn");

        if (from == address(0)) {
            _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        }

        if (to == address(0)) {
            _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (to != from) {
            _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _afterTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256) internal {
        _transferVotingUnits(from, to, 1);
    }

        uint256 length = _balances[to];
        _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _balances[from] - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastTokenIndex];

        _allTokens[tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
        _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;

        delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        _allTokens.pop();
    }

    // ==================== Votes internals ====================
    function _domainSeparatorV4() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encode(_EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH, _HASHED_NAME, _HASHED_VERSION, block.chainid, address(this)));
    }

    function _useNonce(address owner) internal returns (uint256 current) {
        current = _nonces[owner];
        _nonces[owner] = current + 1;
    }

    function _delegate(address account, address delegatee) internal {
        address oldDelegate = _delegates[account];
        _delegates[account] = delegatee;

        emit DelegateChanged(account, oldDelegate, delegatee);

        _moveDelegateVotes(oldDelegate, delegatee, _balances[account]);
    }

    function _transferVotingUnits(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _writeCheckpoint(_totalSupplyCheckpoints, true, amount);
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            _writeCheckpoint(_totalSupplyCheckpoints, false, amount);
        }
        _moveDelegateVotes(_delegates[from], _delegates[to], amount);
    }

    function _moveDelegateVotes(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (from == to || amount == 0) return;

        if (from != address(0)) {
            (uint256 oldVal, uint256 newVal) = _writeCheckpoint(_delegateCheckpoints[from], false, amount);
            emit DelegateVotesChanged(from, oldVal, newVal);
        }

        if (to != address(0)) {
            (uint256 oldVal, uint256 newVal) = _writeCheckpoint(_delegateCheckpoints[to], true, amount);
            emit DelegateVotesChanged(to, oldVal, newVal);
        }
    }

    function _writeCheckpoint(
        Checkpoint[] storage ckpts,
        bool increase,
        uint256 delta
    ) internal returns (uint256 oldValue, uint256 newValue) {
        oldValue = _latestCheckpoint(ckpts);
        newValue = increase ? oldValue + delta : oldValue - delta;

        uint32 blk = _safeCastTo32(block.number);
        uint256 pos = ckpts.length;

        if (pos > 0 && ckpts[pos - 1].fromBlock == blk) {
            ckpts[pos - 1].votes = _safeCastTo224(newValue);
        } else {
            ckpts.push(Checkpoint({fromBlock: blk, votes: _safeCastTo224(newValue)}));
        }
    }

    function _latestCheckpoint(Checkpoint[] storage ckpts) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 pos = ckpts.length;
        return pos == 0 ? 0 : ckpts[pos - 1].votes;
    }

    function _checkpointsLookup(Checkpoint[] storage ckpts, uint256 blockNumber) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 low = 0;
        uint256 high = ckpts.length;

        while (low < high) {
            uint256 mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (ckpts[mid].fromBlock > blockNumber) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }

        return high == 0 ? 0 : ckpts[high - 1].votes;
    }

    function _safeCastTo224(uint256 value) internal pure returns (uint224) {
        require(value <= type(uint224).max, "SafeCast: value doesn't fit in 224 bits");
        return uint224(value);
    }

    function _safeCastTo32(uint256 value) internal pure returns (uint32) {
        require(value <= type(uint32).max, "SafeCast: value doesn't fit in 32 bits");
        return uint32(value);
    }
}

        require(uint256(mould.minted) + uint256(amount) <= uint256(mould.maxBoxes), "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");

        uint256 totalPrice = mould.price * uint256(amount);
        require(msg.value == totalPrice, "NFTBoxes: Wrong total price.");

        mould.minted += amount;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _nextTokenId++;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId);
            _boxToMould[tokenId] = mouldId;
            _boxSeed[tokenId] = _newSeed(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(tokenId, msg.sender, block.number)));

        require(!mould.distributed, "NFTBoxes: cannot distribute shares");
        mould.distributed = true;

        uint256 bal = address(this).balance;
        if (bal == 0) return;

        uint256 paid;
        uint256 artistLen = mould.artists.length;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < artistLen; i++) {
            uint256 amount = (bal * mould.artistShares[i]) / TOTAL_SHARES;
            if (amount > 0 && mould.artists[i] != address(0)) {

            }
        }

        uint256 remainder = bal - paid;
        address sink = _teamAddress == address(0) ? _owner : _teamAddress;
        if (remainder > 0 && sink != address(0)) {

            uint256 n = amounts[i];
            if (n > recipients[i].length) n = recipients[i].length;

            for (uint256 j = 0; j < n; j++) {

        }

        out.uri4 = mould.uri4;

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, ""), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        _balances[to] += 1;

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == tokenOwner || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender || _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][spender]);
    }

    function _approve(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = spender;
        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), spender, tokenId);
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
            _allTokens.push(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            uint256 lastTokenIndex = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
            uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

            if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
                uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
                _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
                _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
            }

            _ownedTokens[from].pop();
        }

        if (to == address(0)) {
            uint256 lastGlobalIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
            uint256 tokenGlobalIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
            uint256 lastTokenIdGlobal = _allTokens[lastGlobalIndex];

            _allTokens[tokenGlobalIndex] = lastTokenIdGlobal;
            _allTokensIndex[lastTokenIdGlobal] = tokenGlobalIndex;

            _allTokens.pop();
            delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        } else if (to != from) {
            _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
            _ownedTokens[to].push(tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;

        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) {
                revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            }
            assembly {
                revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
            }
        }
    }

    function _newSeed(bytes32 seed) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(seed, block.timestamp, block.prevrandao, msg.sender, address(this)));
    }

    function _requireMould(uint256 mouldId) internal view {
        require(mouldId < boxMouldCount && _boxMoulds[mouldId].exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");
    }

    function _copyAddressArray(address[] storage src) internal view returns (address[] memory out) {
        out = new address[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            out[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _copyUintArray(uint256[] storage src) internal view returns (uint256[] memory out) {
        out = new uint256[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            out[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        uint256 ptr = digits;
        temp = value;
        while (temp != 0) {
            ptr--;
            buffer[ptr] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(temp % 10)));
            temp /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

    function sample(address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, uint256 points, uint256 window)
        public

        require(points > 0 && window > 0, "bad params");

        uint256 len = observations.length;
        uint256 span = points * window;
        require(len > span, "not enough observations");

        out = new uint256[](points);
        uint256 idx = len - 1 - span;

        for (uint256 i; i < points; ++i) {
            Observation memory o0 = observations[idx];
            Observation memory o1 = observations[idx + window];
            uint256 elapsed = o1.timestamp - o0.timestamp;

            if (elapsed == 0) {
                out[i] = _getAmountOut(amountIn, tokenIn, reserve0, reserve1);
            } else {
                uint256 r0 = (o1.reserve0Cumulative - o0.reserve0Cumulative) / elapsed;
                uint256 r1 = (o1.reserve1Cumulative - o0.reserve1Cumulative) / elapsed;
                out[i] = _getAmountOut(amountIn, tokenIn, r0, r1);

        }
    }

    function quote(address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, uint256 granularity) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(tokenIn == token0 || tokenIn == token1, "IT");
        if (granularity == 0) return 0;
        if (observations.length <= granularity) {
            return _getAmountOut(amountIn, tokenIn, reserve0, reserve1);
        }

        uint256[] memory arr = sample(tokenIn, amountIn, granularity, 1);
        uint256 s;
        for (uint256 i; i < arr.length; ++i) s += arr[i];
        return s / arr.length;
    }

    function getAmountOut(uint256 amountIn, address tokenIn) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(tokenIn == token0 || tokenIn == token1, "IT");
        return _getAmountOut(amountIn, tokenIn, reserve0, reserve1);
    }

    function _update(uint256 balance0_, uint256 balance1_, uint256 _reserve0, uint256 _reserve1) internal {
        uint256 ts = block.timestamp;
        uint256 elapsed = ts - blockTimestampLast;

        if (elapsed > 0 && _reserve0 != 0 && _reserve1 != 0) {
            reserve0CumulativeLast += _reserve0 * elapsed;
            reserve1CumulativeLast += _reserve1 * elapsed;
        }

        if (observations.length == 0) {
            observations.push(Observation(ts, reserve0CumulativeLast, reserve1CumulativeLast));
        } else {
            Observation memory last = observations[observations.length - 1];
            if (ts - last.timestamp > PERIOD_SIZE) {
                observations.push(Observation(ts, reserve0CumulativeLast, reserve1CumulativeLast));
            }
        }

        reserve0 = balance0_;
        reserve1 = balance1_;
        blockTimestampLast = ts;
        emit Sync(balance0_, balance1_);
    }

    function _update0(uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount == 0 || fees == address(0)) return;
        _safeTransfer(token0, fees, amount);
        emit Fees(msg.sender, amount, 0);
    }

    function _update1(uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount == 0 || fees == address(0)) return;
        _safeTransfer(token1, fees, amount);
        emit Fees(msg.sender, 0, amount);
    }

    function _transferTokens(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        balanceOf[from] -= value;
        balanceOf[to] += value;
        emit Transfer(from, to, value);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 value) internal {
        totalSupply += value;
        balanceOf[to] += value;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, value);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 value) internal {
        balanceOf[from] -= value;
        totalSupply -= value;
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), value);
    }

    function _getAmountOut(uint256 amountIn, address tokenIn, uint256 r0, uint256 r1) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (amountIn == 0) return 0;
        if (r0 == 0 || r1 == 0) return 0;

        uint256 amountInAfterFee = amountIn - ((amountIn * feeRatio) / FEE_DENOMINATOR);

        if (!stable) {
            (uint256 reserveIn, uint256 reserveOut) = tokenIn == token0 ? (r0, r1) : (r1, r0);
            return (amountInAfterFee * reserveOut) / (reserveIn + amountInAfterFee);
        }

        uint256 xy = _k(r0, r1);
        uint256 _r0 = (r0 * 1e18) / _decimals0;
        uint256 _r1 = (r1 * 1e18) / _decimals1;

        (uint256 reserveA, uint256 reserveB) = tokenIn == token0 ? (_r0, _r1) : (_r1, _r0);

        amountInAfterFee = tokenIn == token0
            ? (amountInAfterFee * 1e18) / _decimals0
            : (amountInAfterFee * 1e18) / _decimals1;

        uint256 y = reserveB - _getY(amountInAfterFee + reserveA, xy, reserveB);
        return (y * (tokenIn == token0 ? _decimals1 : _decimals0)) / 1e18;
    }

    function _k(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (!stable) return x * y;
        uint256 _x = (x * 1e18) / _decimals0;
        uint256 _y = (y * 1e18) / _decimals1;
        uint256 a = (_x * _y) / 1e18;
        uint256 b = ((_x * _x) / 1e18) + ((_y * _y) / 1e18);
        return (a * b) / 1e18;
    }

    function _f(uint256 x0, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 a = (x0 * y) / 1e18;
        uint256 b = ((x0 * x0) / 1e18) + ((y * y) / 1e18);
        return (a * b) / 1e18;
    }

    function _d(uint256 x0, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return (3 * x0 * ((y * y) / 1e18)) / 1e18 + ((((x0 * x0) / 1e18) * x0) / 1e18);
    }

    function _getY(uint256 x0, uint256 xy, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        for (uint256 i; i < 255; ++i) {
            uint256 yPrev = y;
            uint256 k = _f(x0, y);

            if (k < xy) {
                uint256 dy = ((xy - k) * 1e18) / _d(x0, y);
                y = y + dy;
            } else {
                uint256 dy = ((k - xy) * 1e18) / _d(x0, y);
                y = y - dy;
            }

            if (y > yPrev ? y - yPrev <= 1 : yPrev - y <= 1) {
                return y;
            }
        }
        return y;
    }

    function _isPaused() internal view returns (bool paused) {
        try IFactoryLike(factoryAddress).isPaused() returns (bool p) {
            paused = p;
        } catch {
            paused = false;
        }
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
            token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa9059cbb), to, value));
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "SafeERC20: safeTransfer low-level call failed");
    }

    function _domainSeparator() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,
                keccak256(bytes(name)),
                keccak256(bytes("1")),
                block.chainid,
                address(this)
            )
        );
    }

    function _safeDecimals(address t) internal view returns (uint8) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = t.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x313ce567)));
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) {
            uint256 d = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
            if (d <= 255) return uint8(d);
        }
        return 18;
    }

    function _safeSymbol(address t) internal view returns (string memory) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = t.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x95d89b41)));
        if (!ok) return "TOKEN";

        if (data.length >= 64) {
            return abi.decode(data, (string));
        } else if (data.length == 32) {
            bytes32 raw = abi.decode(data, (bytes32));
            return _bytes32ToString(raw);
        }
        return "TOKEN";
    }

    function _bytes32ToString(bytes32 x) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        uint8 len = 0;
        while (len < 32 && x[len] != 0) {
            len++;
        }
        bytes memory out = new bytes(len);
        for (uint8 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            out[i] = x[i];
        }
        return string(out);
    }

    function _pow10(uint8 d) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (d > 77) return 1e18;
        uint256 p = 1;
        for (uint8 i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
            p *= 10;
        }
        return p;
    }

    function _sqrt(uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        if (y == 0) return 0;
        if (y <= 3) return 1;
        z = y;
        uint256 x = y / 2 + 1;
        while (x < z) {
            z = x;
            x = (y / x + x) / 2;
        }
    }

    function _min(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a < b ? a : b;
    }
}

    }

    function _createLockInternal(
        address account,
        address payer,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 start,
        uint256 end,
        uint8 lockType,
        bool pullFromPayer
    ) internal {
        if (pullFromPayer) {
            _safeTransferFrom(_lockedTokenValue, payer, address(this), amount);
        }

        uint256 lockId = ++_lastLockIdValue;
        LockData storage l = _locks[lockId];
        l.amount = amount;
        l.start = start;
        l.end = end;
        l.owner = account;
        l.lockType = lockType;

        _userLockIds[account].push(lockId);
        _lockIndexPlusOne[lockId] = _userLockIds[account].length;
        _allLockIds.push(lockId);

        _totalLockedValue += amount;
        _eventNonceValue += 1;

        emit LockCreated(lockId, account, amount, start, end, lockType);
    }

    function _withdrawInternal(uint256 lockId, address receiver, bool enforceOwner) internal {
        LockData storage l = _locks[lockId];
        if (l.owner == address(0) || l.amount == 0) revert LockNotFound();
        if (enforceOwner && l.owner != receiver) revert NotLockOwner();
        if (block.timestamp < l.end) revert LockNotExpired();

        uint256 amount = l.amount;
        address owner = l.owner;

        l.amount = 0;
        l.withdrawn += amount;
        l.owner = address(0);

        if (_totalLockedValue >= amount) {
            _totalLockedValue -= amount;
        } else {
            _totalLockedValue = 0;
        }

        _removeUserLock(owner, lockId);
        _eventNonceValue += 1;

        _safeTransfer(_lockedTokenValue, receiver, amount);
        emit Withdraw(lockId, receiver, amount, block.timestamp);
    }

    function _removeUserLock(address owner, uint256 lockId) internal {
        uint256 idxPlus = _lockIndexPlusOne[lockId];
        if (idxPlus == 0) return;

        uint256 idx = idxPlus - 1;
        uint256[] storage ids = _userLockIds[owner];
        uint256 last = ids[ids.length - 1];

        ids[idx] = last;
        _lockIndexPlusOne[last] = idx + 1;

        ids.pop();
        delete _lockIndexPlusOne[lockId];
    }

    function _writeCheckpoint(address account) internal {
        uint256 ue = _userPointEpochValue[account] + 1;
        _userPointEpochValue[account] = ue;

        uint256 ub = _balanceOfAt(account, block.timestamp);
        _userPoints[account][ue] = Point({bias: ub, slope: block.timestamp});
        _userPointTimestampValue[account][ue] = block.timestamp;

        uint256 ge = _currentEpochValue + 1;
        _currentEpochValue = ge;

        uint256 ts = totalSupplyAt(block.timestamp);
        _supplyAtEpochValue[ge] = ts;
        _globalPoints[ge] = Point({bias: ts, slope: block.timestamp});
    }

    function _balanceOfAt(address account, uint256 t) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256[] storage ids = _userLockIds[account];
        uint256 acc = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            LockData storage l = _locks[ids[i]];
            acc += _lockPowerAt(l, t);
        }
        return acc;
    }

    function _lockPowerAt(LockData storage l, uint256 t) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (l.amount == 0 || l.owner == address(0)) return 0;
        if (t >= l.end || l.end <= l.start) return 0;

        uint256 effective = t < l.start ? l.start : t;
        if (effective >= l.end) return 0;

        uint256 duration = l.end - l.start;
        uint256 remaining = l.end - effective;
        uint256 raw = (l.amount * remaining) / duration;

        uint256 lc = _linearCoeff[l.lockType];
        uint256 bc = _boostCoeff[l.lockType];
        if (lc == 0) lc = ONE;
        if (bc == 0) bc = ONE;

        uint256 weighted = (raw * lc) / ONE;
        weighted = (weighted * bc) / ONE;
        return weighted;
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) revert AccessDenied(account, role);
    }

    function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal {
        bytes32 prev = _roles[role].adminRole;
        _roles[role].adminRole = adminRole;
        emit RoleAdminChanged(role, prev, adminRole);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _notZero(address a) internal pure {
        if (a == address(0)) revert AddressZero();
    }

    function _validatePreset(uint8 lockType) internal pure {
        if (lockType == 0 || lockType > 5) revert InvalidLockType();
    }

    function _validateIndex(uint8 idx) internal pure {
        if (idx > 5) revert InvalidLockType();
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =
            token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transfer.selector, to, amount));
        if (!ok) revert TokenCallFailed();
        if (ret.length > 0 && !abi.decode(ret, (bool))) revert TokenCallFailed();
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =
            token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount));
        if (!ok) revert TokenCallFailed();
        if (ret.length > 0 && !abi.decode(ret, (bool))) revert TokenCallFailed();
    }
}

        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory out = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            out[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(out);
    }
