        emit PoolStatsChanged();
    }

    function setOfferedCurrencyRate(address currency, uint256 newRate) external onlyOwner {
        require(newRate > 0, "POOL::RATE_INVALID");
        CurrencyInfo storage c = _offeredCurrencies[currency];
        c.rate = newRate;
        if (c.enabled == 0) c.enabled = 1;
        emit PoolStatsChanged();
    }

    function setOfferedCurrencyDecimals(address currency, uint256 newDecimals) external onlyOwner {
        require(newDecimals <= 77, "POOL::INVALID_WEI_AMOUNT");
        CurrencyInfo storage c = _offeredCurrencies[currency];
        c.decimals = newDecimals;
        if (c.enabled == 0) c.enabled = 1;
        emit PoolStatsChanged();
    }

    function setOfferedCurrencyRateAndDecimals(address currency, uint256 newRate, uint256 newDecimals) external onlyOwner {
        require(newRate > 0, "POOL::RATE_INVALID");
        require(newDecimals <= 77, "POOL::INVALID_WEI_AMOUNT");
        _offeredCurrencies[currency] = CurrencyInfo({rate: newRate, decimals: newDecimals, enabled: 1});
        emit PoolStatsChanged();
    }

    function pause() external onlyOwner {
        require(!_paused, "CONTRACT_PAUSED");
        _paused = true;
        emit Pause();
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner {
        require(_paused, "CONTRACT_NOT_PAUSED");
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpause();
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "POOL::INVALID_OWNER");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function getAvailableTokensForSale() external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 bal = IERC20(_token).balanceOf(address(this));
        if (bal <= _totalUnclaimed) return 0;
        return bal.sub(_totalUnclaimed);
    }

    function buyTokenByEtherWithPermission(
        address candidate,
        address beneficiary,
        uint256 minAmount,
        uint256 nonce,
        bytes calldata signature
    ) external payable whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
        require(candidate == msg.sender, "POOL::WRONG_CANDIDATE");
        require(_isSaleOpened(), "POOL::NOT_OPEN");
        require(msg.value > 0, "POOL::INVALID_PURCHASE_AMOUNT");

        if (_useWhitelist) {
            require(verify(candidate, beneficiary, minAmount, nonce, signature), "POOL::INVALID_SIGNATURE");
        }

        uint256 tokenAmount = _quoteAmount(address(0), msg.value);
        require(tokenAmount >= minAmount, "POOL::MIN_AMOUNT_UNREACHED");

        _accountPurchase(beneficiary, address(0), msg.value, tokenAmount);

        (bool sent,) = _fundingWallet.call{value: msg.value}("");
        require(sent, "POOL::WALLET_TRANSFER_FAILED");

        emit TokenPurchaseByEther(candidate, beneficiary, msg.value, tokenAmount);
    }

    function buyTokenByTokenWithPermission(
        address candidate,
        address beneficiary,
        uint256 paymentAmount,
        address currency,
        uint256 minAmount,
        uint256 nonce,
        bytes calldata signature
    ) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
        require(candidate == msg.sender, "POOL::WRONG_CANDIDATE");
        require(_isSaleOpened(), "POOL::NOT_OPEN");
        require(paymentAmount > 0, "POOL::INVALID_PURCHASE_AMOUNT");

        if (_useWhitelist) {
            require(verify(candidate, beneficiary, minAmount, nonce, signature), "POOL::INVALID_SIGNATURE");
        }

        uint256 tokenAmount = _quoteAmount(currency, paymentAmount);
        require(tokenAmount >= minAmount, "POOL::MIN_AMOUNT_UNREACHED");

        _safeTransferFrom(currency, candidate, _fundingWallet, paymentAmount);
        _accountPurchase(beneficiary, currency, paymentAmount, tokenAmount);

        emit TokenPurchaseByToken(candidate, beneficiary, currency, paymentAmount, tokenAmount);
    }

    function claimTokens(address beneficiary, uint256 amount, bytes calldata signature) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
        require(isFinalized(), "POOL::NOT_FINALIZED");
        require(amount > 0, "POOL::ZERO_AMOUNT");

        if (_useWhitelist) {
            require(verifyClaimToken(msg.sender, beneficiary, amount, signature), "POOL::INVALID_SIGNATURE");
        }

        uint256 purchased = _userPurchased[beneficiary];
        uint256 claimed = _userClaimed[beneficiary];
        uint256 available = purchased.sub(claimed, "POOL::NOT_ALLOW_TO_CLAIM");
        require(amount <= available, "POOL::NOT_ALLOW_TO_CLAIM");

        _userClaimed[beneficiary] = claimed.add(amount);
        _totalUnclaimed = _totalUnclaimed.sub(amount);
        _safeTransfer(_token, beneficiary, amount);

        emit TokenClaimed(beneficiary, amount);
    }

    function refundRemainingTokens(address beneficiary) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(isFinalized(), "POOL::ICO_NOT_ENDED");
        require(beneficiary != address(0), "POOL::INVALID_BENEFICIARY");

        uint256 bal = IERC20(_token).balanceOf(address(this));
        require(bal > _totalUnclaimed, "POOL::EMPTY_BALANCE");

        uint256 amount = bal.sub(_totalUnclaimed);
        _safeTransfer(_token, beneficiary, amount);
        emit RefundedIcoToken(beneficiary, amount);
    }

    function getMessageHash(address candidate, uint256 amount, uint256 nonce) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(candidate, amount, nonce, address(this)));
    }

    function getClaimMessageHash(address beneficiary, uint256 amount) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(beneficiary, amount, address(this)));
    }

    function getEthSignedMessageHash(bytes32 messageHash) public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32", messageHash));
    }

    function splitSignature(bytes memory sig) public pure returns (bytes32 r, bytes32 s, uint8 v) {
        return _splitSignature(sig);
    }

    function getSignerAddress(bytes32 hash, bytes memory signature) public pure returns (address) {
        (bytes32 r, bytes32 s, uint8 v) = _splitSignature(signature);
        return ecrecover(getEthSignedMessageHash(hash), v, r, s);
    }

    function verify(
        address candidate,
        address,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 nonce,
        bytes memory signature
    ) public view returns (bool) {
        if (candidate != msg.sender) return false;
        return getSignerAddress(getMessageHash(candidate, amount, nonce), signature) == _signer;
    }

    function verifyClaimToken(
        address candidate,
        address beneficiary,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes memory signature
    ) public view returns (bool) {
        if (candidate != msg.sender) return false;
        return getSignerAddress(getClaimMessageHash(beneficiary, amount), signature) == _signer;
    }

    function _isSaleOpened() internal view returns (bool) {
        return block.timestamp >= _openTime && block.timestamp <= _closeTime;
    }

    function _quoteAmount(address currency, uint256 amountIn) internal view returns (uint256) {
        CurrencyInfo storage c = _offeredCurrencies[currency];
        require(c.enabled == 1 && c.rate > 0, "POOL::RATE_INVALID");
        require(c.decimals <= 77, "POOL::INVALID_WEI_AMOUNT");
        return amountIn.mul(c.rate).div(10 ** c.decimals);
    }

    function _accountPurchase(address beneficiary, address currency, uint256 paymentAmount, uint256 tokenAmount) internal {
        _userPurchased[beneficiary] = _userPurchased[beneficiary].add(tokenAmount);
        _investedAmountOf[beneficiary][currency] = _investedAmountOf[beneficiary][currency].add(paymentAmount);

        _tokenSold = _tokenSold.add(tokenAmount);
        _totalUnclaimed = _totalUnclaimed.add(tokenAmount);

        if (currency == address(0)) {
            _weiRaised = _weiRaised.add(paymentAmount);
        }

        emit PoolStatsChanged();
    }

    function _splitSignature(bytes memory sig) internal pure returns (bytes32 r, bytes32 s, uint8 v) {
        require(sig.length == 65, "ECDSA: invalid signature length");

        assembly {
            r := mload(add(sig, 32))
            s := mload(add(sig, 64))
            v := byte(0, mload(add(sig, 96)))
        }

        require(
            uint256(s) <= 0x7fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff5d576e7357a4501ddfe92f46681b20a0,
            "ECDSA: invalid signature 's' value"
        );
        require(v == 27 || v == 28, "ECDSA: invalid signature 'v' value");
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token_, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(token_ != address(0), "POOL::INVALID_TOKEN");
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token_.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, amount));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "TransferHelper::transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token_, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(token_ != address(0), "POOL::INVALID_TOKEN");
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token_.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "TransferHelper::transferFrom failed");
    }
}

contract ICOFactory {
    event Pause();
    event Unpause();
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event PresalePoolCreated(address indexed token, address indexed pool, address indexed creator, uint256 index);

    address private _owner;
    bool private _paused;
    bool private _initialized;

    address[] private _allPools;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => address[])) private _createdPoolsByToken; // token => account => pools

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "UNAUTHORIZED");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!_paused, "CONTRACT_PAUSED");
        _;
    }

    function initialize() external {
        require(!_initialized, "Initializable: contract is already initialized");
        _initialized = true;
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function allPools(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return _allPools[index];
    }

    function allPoolsLength() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _allPools.length;
    }

    function getPools(address token_, address account_, uint256 index_) external view returns (address) {
        return _createdPoolsByToken[token_][account_][index_];
    }

    function getCreatedPoolsLengthByToken(address token_, address account_) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _createdPoolsByToken[token_][account_].length;
    }

    function getCreatedPoolsByToken(address token_, address account_) external view returns (address[] memory) {
        address[] storage s = _createdPoolsByToken[token_][account_];
        address[] memory out = new address[](s.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            out[i] = s[i];
        }
        return out;
    }

    function pause() external onlyOwner {
        require(!_paused, "CONTRACT_PAUSED");
        _paused = true;
        emit Pause();
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner {
        require(_paused, "CONTRACT_NOT_PAUSED");
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpause();
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "ZERO_ADDRESS");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function registerPool(
        address token_,
        uint256 openTime_,
        uint256 closeTime_,
        address fundingWallet_,
        uint256 offeredRate_,
        uint256 offeredDecimals_,
        address offeredCurrency_,
        address signer_
    ) external whenNotPaused returns (address) {
        require(token_ != address(0), "ICOFactory::ZERO_ADDRESS");
        require(fundingWallet_ != address(0), "ICOFactory::ZERO_ADDRESS");
        require(signer_ != address(0), "ICOFactory::ZERO_ADDRESS");
        require(closeTime_ > openTime_, "ICOFactory::ZERO_DURATION");
        require(offeredRate_ > 0, "ICOFactory::ZERO_OFFERED_RATE");

        bytes32 salt = keccak256(
            abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, token_, fundingWallet_, openTime_, closeTime_, _allPools.length)
        );

        PresalePool pool = new PresalePool{salt: salt}();
        pool.initialize(
            token_,
            openTime_,
            closeTime_,
            fundingWallet_,
            offeredRate_,
            offeredDecimals_,
            offeredCurrency_,
            signer_
        );

        address poolAddress = address(pool);

        _allPools.push(poolAddress);
        _createdPoolsByToken[token_][msg.sender].push(poolAddress);
        _createdPoolsByToken[token_][fundingWallet_].push(poolAddress);

        emit PresalePoolCreated(token_, poolAddress, msg.sender, _allPools.length - 1);
        return poolAddress;
    }
}

    ) external payable returns (MessagingReceipt memory msgReceipt, OFTReceipt memory oftReceipt) {
        if (peers[sendParam.dstEid] == bytes32(0)) revert NoPeer(sendParam.dstEid);
        if (msg.value < fee.nativeFee) revert SlippageExceeded(msg.value, fee.nativeFee);

        (uint256 sentLD, uint256 receivedLD) = _debit(msg.sender, sendParam.amountLD, sendParam.minAmountLD);

        uint64 nonce = _nextNonce[sendParam.dstEid][sendParam.to] + 1;
        _nextNonce[sendParam.dstEid][sendParam.to] = nonce;

        bytes32 guid = keccak256(
            abi.encodePacked(
                block.chainid,
                address(this),
                msg.sender,
                sendParam.dstEid,
                sendParam.to,
                nonce,
                sendParam.amountLD,
                sendParam.minAmountLD
            )
        );

        emit OFTSent(guid, sendParam.dstEid, msg.sender, sentLD, receivedLD);

        MessagingFee memory memFee = MessagingFee(fee.nativeFee, fee.lzTokenFee);
        msgReceipt = MessagingReceipt(guid, nonce, memFee);
        oftReceipt = OFTReceipt(sentLD, receivedLD);

        if (msg.value > fee.nativeFee && refundAddress != address(0)) {
            (bool ok,) = payable(refundAddress).call{value: msg.value - fee.nativeFee}("");
            ok;
        }
    }

    function lzReceive(
        Origin calldata origin,
        bytes32 guid,
        bytes calldata message,
        address,
        bytes calldata extraData
    ) external payable {
        _checkEndpoint(msg.sender);
        if (!_allowInitializePath(origin)) revert NoPeer(origin.srcEid);

        if (_msgInspector != address(0)) {
            (bool ok,) = _msgInspector.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x043a78eb, message, extraData));
            if (!ok) revert SafeERC20FailedOperation(_msgInspector);
        }

        (address to, uint256 amountLD) = abi.decode(message, (address, uint256));
        _credit(to, amountLD);
        _nextNonce[origin.srcEid][origin.sender] = origin.nonce + 1;

        emit OFTReceived(guid, origin.srcEid, to, amountLD);
    }

    function lzReceiveSimulate(
        Origin calldata origin,
        bytes32 guid,
        bytes calldata message,
        address executor,
        bytes calldata extraData
    ) external payable {
        if (msg.sender != address(this)) revert OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(msg.sender);
        this.lzReceive(origin, guid, message, executor, extraData);
    }

    function lzReceiveAndRevert(InboundPacket[] calldata packets) external payable {
        bytes memory aggregate;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < packets.length; i++) {
            try this.lzReceiveSimulate(
                packets[i].origin,
                packets[i].guid,
                packets[i].message,
                packets[i].executor,
                packets[i].extraData
            ) {} catch (bytes memory reason) {
                aggregate = bytes.concat(aggregate, reason);
            }
        }
        revert SimulationResult(aggregate);
    }

        return abi.encodePacked("SIMULATION");
    }

        if (_msgInspector == address(0)) return options;

            abi.encodeWithSelector(0x043a78eb, message, options)
        );
        if (!ok) revert SafeERC20FailedOperation(_msgInspector);
        return ret;
    }

    function _allowInitializePath(Origin calldata origin) internal view returns (bool) {
        return peers[origin.srcEid] != bytes32(0) && peers[origin.srcEid] == origin.sender;
    }

    function _checkEndpoint(address caller) internal view {
        if (_endpoint != address(0) && caller != _endpoint && caller != address(this)) {
            revert OnlyEndpoint(caller);
        }
    }

    function _debit(address from, uint256 amountLD, uint256 minAmountLD) internal returns (uint256 sentLD, uint256 receivedLD) {
        sentLD = amountLD;
        receivedLD = amountLD;
        if (receivedLD < minAmountLD) revert SlippageExceeded(receivedLD, minAmountLD);

        if (_underlyingToken == address(this)) {
            _burn(from, sentLD);
        } else {
            _safeTransferFrom(_underlyingToken, from, address(this), sentLD);
        }
    }

    function _credit(address to, uint256 amountLD) internal {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidReceiver(to);

        if (_underlyingToken == address(this)) {
            _mint(to, amountLD);
        } else {
            _safeTransfer(_underlyingToken, to, amountLD);
        }
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token_, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory ret) = token_.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value)
        );
        if (!success || (ret.length > 0 && !abi.decode(ret, (bool)))) {
            revert SafeERC20FailedOperation(token_);
        }
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token_, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory ret) = token_.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transfer.selector, to, value)
        );
        if (!success || (ret.length > 0 && !abi.decode(ret, (bool)))) {
            revert SafeERC20FailedOperation(token_);
        }
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            revert AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(account, role);
        }
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (account == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
        if (!_roles[role][account]) {
            _roles[role][account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role][account]) {
            _roles[role][account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _applyPendingDelay() internal {
        if (_pendingDefaultAdminDelaySchedule != 0 && block.timestamp >= _pendingDefaultAdminDelaySchedule) {
            _defaultAdminDelay = _pendingDefaultAdminDelayValue;
            _pendingDefaultAdminDelayValue = 0;
            _pendingDefaultAdminDelaySchedule = 0;
        }
    }

    function _approve(address holder, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (holder == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidApprover(holder);
        if (spender == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidSpender(spender);
        _allowances[holder][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(holder, spender, amount);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidSender(from);
        if (to == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidReceiver(to);

        uint256 fromBal = _balances[from];
        if (fromBal < amount) revert ERC20InsufficientBalance(from, fromBal, amount);

        unchecked {
            _balances[from] = fromBal - amount;
        }
        _balances[to] += amount;

        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidReceiver(to);
        _totalSupply += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidSender(from);
        uint256 fromBal = _balances[from];
        if (fromBal < amount) revert ERC20InsufficientBalance(from, fromBal, amount);

        unchecked {
            _balances[from] = fromBal - amount;
        }
        _totalSupply -= amount;

        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        if (msg.sig == bytes4(0x1084b343)) {
            if (msg.value != 0) revert();
            bytes32 role = _TOKEN_ADMIN_ROLE;
            assembly {
                mstore(0x00, role)
                return(0x00, 0x20)
            }
        }

        if (msg.sig == bytes4(0x207a6c5e)) {
            if (msg.value != 0) revert();
            if (msg.data.length < 36) revert();
            address newHolder = abi.decode(msg.data[4:], (address));
            _checkRole(_TOKEN_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
            if (newHolder == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
            _grantRole(_TOKEN_ADMIN_ROLE, newHolder);
            _revokeRole(_TOKEN_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
            return;
        }

        revert();
    }
}

        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);

    }

        return msg.sender == _owner;
    }

    }

        if (account == address(0)) {

        return checkEnabled(a) && checkEnabled(b) && checkEnabled(c);

        _enabled[account] = false;
        emit WalletDisabled(account);
    }

    function enableWalletList(address[] memory accounts) public onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            enableWallet(accounts[i]);
        }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {

        }
    }

        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;

        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    }

        emit OwnershipTransferred(previous, newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        address previous = _owner;
        _owner = address(0);
        emit OwnershipTransferred(previous, address(0));
    }

    function _lookupReserve() internal view returns (address) {
        if (_reserveRegistry == address(0)) return address(0);
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = _reserveRegistry.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xf5e3542b)) // lookup()
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return address(0);
        return abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _creditBalanceWithAccrual(address user, address controlledToken) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 credit = _creditBalances[user][controlledToken];
        CreditPlan memory p = _creditPlans[controlledToken];
        uint256 last = _creditTimestamps[user][controlledToken];

        if (last == 0 || p.creditRateMantissa == 0) {
            return credit;
        }

        uint256 dt = block.timestamp - last;
        if (dt == 0) return credit;

        uint256 principal = _balanceOf(controlledToken, user);
        uint256 accrued = (principal * uint256(p.creditRateMantissa) * dt) / 1e18;
        uint256 newCredit = credit + accrued;

        uint256 limit = (principal * uint256(p.creditLimitMantissa)) / 1e18;
        if (newCredit > limit) {
            newCredit = limit;
        }

        return newCredit;
    }

    function _accrueCredit(address user, address controlledToken) internal {
        uint256 oldCredit = _creditBalances[user][controlledToken];
        uint256 newCredit = _creditBalanceWithAccrual(user, controlledToken);

        if (newCredit > oldCredit) {
            emit CreditMinted(user, controlledToken, newCredit - oldCredit);
        } else if (oldCredit > newCredit) {
            emit CreditBurned(user, controlledToken, oldCredit - newCredit);
        }

        _creditBalances[user][controlledToken] = newCredit;
        _creditTimestamps[user][controlledToken] = block.timestamp;
    }

    function _burnCredit(address user, address controlledToken, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {
        _accrueCredit(user, controlledToken);
        uint256 current = _creditBalances[user][controlledToken];
        uint256 burned = current < amount ? current : amount;
        if (burned > 0) {
            _creditBalances[user][controlledToken] = current - burned;
            emit CreditBurned(user, controlledToken, burned);
        }
        return burned;
    }

    function _requireWithdrawAuthorization(
        address from,
        address controlledToken,
        uint256 amount
    ) internal view {
        if (msg.sender == from) return;
        uint256 allowed = IERC20Like(controlledToken).allowance(from, msg.sender);
        require(allowed >= amount, "PrizePool/insuff-allowance");
    }

    function _supply(uint256 amount, address from) internal {
        require(_yieldSource != address(0), "PrizePool/yield-source-not-set");
        address t = token();
        require(t != address(0), "PrizePool/unknown-token");

        _safeTransferFrom(t, from, address(this), amount);
        _safeApprove(t, _yieldSource, 0);
        _safeApprove(t, _yieldSource, amount);

        (bool ok, ) = _yieldSource.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x87a6eeef), amount, address(this)) // supplyTokenTo(uint256,address)
        );
        require(ok, "PrizePool/supply-failed");
    }

    function _redeemAndTransfer(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount == 0) return;

        if (_yieldSource != address(0)) {
            (bool ok, ) = _yieldSource.call(
                abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x013054c2), amount) // redeemToken(uint256)
            );
            require(ok, "PrizePool/redeem-failed");
        }

        address t = token();
        if (t != address(0)) {
            _safeTransfer(t, to, amount);
        }
    }

    function _controllerMint(address controlledToken, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = controlledToken.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x5d7b0758), to, amount)
        );
        require(ok, "PrizePool/controller-mint-failed");
        if (data.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(data, (bool)), "PrizePool/controller-mint-failed");
        }
    }

    function _controllerBurnFrom(address controlledToken, address operator, address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = controlledToken.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x631b5dfb), operator, from, amount)
        );
        require(ok, "PrizePool/controller-burn-failed");
        if (data.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(data, (bool)), "PrizePool/controller-burn-failed");
        }
    }

    function _balanceOf(address token_, address user) internal view returns (uint256) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token_.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x70a08231), user)
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _totalSupplyOf(address token_) internal view returns (uint256) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token_.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x18160ddd))
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token_, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token_, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa9059cbb), to, amount));
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token_, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token_, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x23b872dd), from, to, amount));
    }

    function _safeApprove(address token_, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token_, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x095ea7b3), spender, amount));
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token_, bytes memory data) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = token_.call(data);
        require(success, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), "SafeERC20: operation failed");
        }
    }

    function _isContract(address a) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly {
            size := extcodesize(a)
        }
        return size > 0;
    }
}

    uint256 public feeGrowthGlobal1X128;
    ProtocolFees public protocolFees;
    uint128 public liquidity;

    mapping(int24 => TickInfo) public ticks;
    mapping(int16 => uint256) public tickBitmap;
    mapping(bytes32 => Position) public positions;
    mapping(uint256 => Observation) public observations;

    event Initialize(uint160 sqrtPriceX96, int24 tick);
    event Mint(
        address sender,

        int24 tickLower,
        int24 tickUpper,
        uint128 amount,
        uint256 amount0,
        uint256 amount1

    event Collect(

        address recipient,
        int24 tickLower,
        int24 tickUpper,
        uint128 amount0,
        uint128 amount1
    );
    event Burn(

        int24 tickLower,
        int24 tickUpper,

        address _token0,
        address _token1,
        uint24 _fee,
        int24 _tickSpacing,
        uint128 _maxLiquidityPerTick

        require(_token0 != address(0) && _token1 != address(0) && _token0 != _token1, "T0");

        require(_tickSpacing > 0, "TS");

        if (slot0.observationCardinalityNext == 0) {

            secondsPerLiquidityCumulativeX128: 0,

        Position storage p = positions[key];

        uint256 newPosL = uint256(p.liquidity) + uint256(amount);
        require(newPosL <= uint256(uint128(-1)), "PL");
        p.liquidity = uint128(newPosL);

        uint256 newL = uint256(liquidity) + uint256(amount);

        _updateTickOnMint(tickLower, amount, true);
        _updateTickOnMint(tickUpper, amount, false);

        amount1 = uint256(amount);

        uint256 balance0Before = _balance(token0);
        uint256 balance1Before = _balance(token1);

        require(_balance(token0) >= balance0Before + amount0, "M0");
        require(_balance(token1) >= balance1Before + amount1, "M1");

        _writeObservation();

        emit Mint(msg.sender, recipient, tickLower, tickUpper, amount, amount0, amount1);

        if (amount1 > 0) {

            _safeTransfer(token1, recipient, uint256(amount1));

        emit Collect(msg.sender, recipient, tickLower, tickUpper, amount0, amount1);
    }

    ) external noDelegateCall lock returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {

        p.tokensOwed1 = uint128(owed1);

        emit Burn(msg.sender, tickLower, tickUpper, amount, amount0, amount1);
    }

        address recipient,
        bool zeroForOne,
        int256 amountSpecified,

        bytes calldata data

        );

    }

    }

        require(x <= uint128(0x7fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff), "I128");
        y = int128(x);
    }

    function getPhaseCondition(uint256 phaseId) external view returns (PhaseCondition memory) {
        require(phaseId < _phases.length, "Invalid phase id");
        return _phases[phaseId];

    // 65203f57
    function setPhaseCondition(bytes calldata conditionData, bytes calldata adminAuth)
        external
        onlyOwner
        nonReentrant
    {
        require(!_started, "Already started");
        PhaseConditionInput memory cfg = abi.decode(conditionData, (PhaseConditionInput));
        _validatePhaseInput(cfg, adminAuth);

        PhaseCondition storage p = _phases.push();
        _writePhase(p, cfg, true);

        totalQuantity += cfg.maxPhaseSupply;
        _recomputeWindow();

        emit PhaseConditionSet(_phases.length - 1);
    }

    // c5f262ec
    function updatePhaseCondition(
        uint256 phaseId,
        bytes calldata conditionData,
        bytes calldata adminAuth
    ) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(!_started, "Already started");
        require(phaseId < _phases.length, "Invalid phase id");

        PhaseConditionInput memory cfg = abi.decode(conditionData, (PhaseConditionInput));
        _validatePhaseInput(cfg, adminAuth);

        PhaseCondition storage p = _phases[phaseId];
        require(!p.removed, "Already removed");
        require(cfg.maxPhaseSupply >= p.totalClaimed, "Exceeds max phase");

        uint256 oldMax = p.maxPhaseSupply;
        _writePhase(p, cfg, false);

        if (cfg.maxPhaseSupply >= oldMax) {
            totalQuantity += (cfg.maxPhaseSupply - oldMax);
        } else {
            totalQuantity -= (oldMax - cfg.maxPhaseSupply);
        }

        _recomputeWindow();
        emit PhaseConditionUpdated(phaseId);
    }

    // b0291adb
    function deletePhaseCondition(uint256 phaseId) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(!_started, "Already started");
        require(phaseId < _phases.length, "Invalid phase id");

        PhaseCondition storage p = _phases[phaseId];
        require(!p.removed, "Already removed");
        p.removed = true;

        uint256 reclaimable = p.maxPhaseSupply > p.totalClaimed
            ? (p.maxPhaseSupply - p.totalClaimed)
            : 0;
        if (reclaimable > 0) {
            totalQuantity -= reclaimable;
        }

        _recomputeWindow();
        emit PhaseConditionDeleted(phaseId);
    }

    function kickoff(uint256 quantity) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(quantity > 0, "Invalid total quantity");
        require(fundedQuantity + quantity <= totalQuantity, "Invalid total quantity");

        _started = true;
        _activePhaseId = uint32(_phases.length);

        if (tokenAddress != address(0)) {
            _safeTransferFrom(tokenAddress, msg.sender, address(this), quantity);
        }

        emit Kickoff(quantity);

    function invest(

    function claim() external nonReentrant {

        require(tokenAddress != address(0), "Not supported");

        AccountInfo storage a = _accounts[msg.sender];
        require(a.purchased > a.claimed, "No investment");

        uint256 pending = a.purchased - a.claimed;
        a.claimed = a.purchased;

        require(claimedOut + pending <= fundedQuantity, "Transfer failed");
        claimedOut += pending;

        _safeTransfer(tokenAddress, msg.sender, pending);
        emit Claimed(msg.sender, pending);

    function withdraw(address currency, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(block.timestamp >= _endTime, "Not ended");
        require(msg.sender == _owner || msg.sender == saleRecipient, "Not allowed");

        if (currency == address(0)) {
            _sendETH(payable(msg.sender), amount);
        } else {
            _safeTransfer(currency, msg.sender, amount);
        }

        emit Withdrawn(currency, msg.sender, amount);

    function finalize() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        _withdrawRemainingTokens(msg.sender);
    }

    function withdrawRemaining() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        _withdrawRemainingTokens(msg.sender);

    function totalPhaseSpent() external view returns (uint256 sum) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _phases.length; i++) {
            sum += _phases[i].totalClaimed;
        }
    }

    function phaseSpent(uint256 phaseId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(phaseId < _phases.length, "Invalid phase id");
        return _phases[phaseId].totalClaimed;

        require(phaseId < _phases.length, "Invalid phase id");
        return _walletByPhase[phaseId][wallet];
    }

            sum += _phases[phaseIds[i]].totalClaimed;
        }
    }

    function walletTotalSpent(address wallet) external view returns (uint256) {

    function _buy(
        address payer,
        address receiver,
        address currency,
        uint256 phaseId,
        uint256 quantity,
        uint256 maxPayment,
        bytes calldata authData
    ) internal {
        require(_started, "Not started");
        require(phaseId < _phases.length, "Invalid phase");
        require(quantity > 0, "Invalid amount");

        PhaseCondition storage p = _phases[phaseId];
        require(!p.removed, "Phase removed");

        require(block.timestamp >= p.startTime, "Not started");
        require(block.timestamp <= p.endTime, "Ended");
        require(p.totalClaimed + quantity <= p.maxPhaseSupply, "Exceeds max phase");

        if (p.minPerTx != 0) {
            require(quantity >= p.minPerTx, "Invalid amount");
        }
        if (p.maxPerTx != 0) {
            require(quantity <= p.maxPerTx, "Exceeds max amount");
        }

        uint256 prevPhaseWallet = _walletByPhase[phaseId][receiver];
        uint256 nextPhaseWallet = prevPhaseWallet + quantity;
        if (p.maxPerWallet != 0) {
            require(nextPhaseWallet <= p.maxPerWallet, "Exceeds max per wallet");
        }

        _requireCurrencyAllowed(p, currency);
        _verifyClaimType(p, receiver, currency, phaseId, quantity, authData);

        uint256 payment = quantity * p.pricePerToken;
        if (maxPayment != 0) {
            require(payment <= maxPayment, "Invalid price");
        }

        if (currency == address(0)) {
            require(msg.value == payment, "Invalid price");
            if (saleRecipient != address(0) && payment > 0) {
                _sendETH(payable(saleRecipient), payment);
            }
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "Invalid price");
            if (payment > 0) {
                address sink = saleRecipient == address(0) ? address(this) : saleRecipient;
                _safeTransferFrom(currency, payer, sink, payment);
            }
        }

        require(totalSpent + quantity <= totalQuantity, "Exceeds max");

        if (_walletTotals[receiver] == 0) {
            totalParticipants += 1;
        }
        if (prevPhaseWallet == 0) {
            p.participantCount += 1;
        }

        _walletByPhase[phaseId][receiver] = nextPhaseWallet;
        _walletTotals[receiver] += quantity;
        _accounts[receiver].purchased += quantity;
        p.totalClaimed += quantity;
        totalSpent += quantity;

        emit Purchased(payer, receiver, phaseId, quantity, currency, payment);
    }

    function _withdrawRemainingTokens(address to) internal {
        require(block.timestamp >= _endTime, "Not ended");
        require(tokenAddress != address(0), "Not supported");

        uint256 remaining = fundedQuantity > claimedOut ? fundedQuantity - claimedOut : 0;
        require(remaining > 0, "No remaining token");

        claimedOut += remaining;
        _safeTransfer(tokenAddress, to, remaining);

        emit Withdrawn(tokenAddress, to, remaining);
    }

    function _writePhase(
        PhaseCondition storage p,
        PhaseConditionInput memory cfg,
        bool resetRuntime
    ) internal {
        p.metadata = cfg.metadata;
        p.claimType = cfg.claimType;
        p.startTime = cfg.startTime;
        p.endTime = cfg.endTime;
        p.maxPhaseSupply = cfg.maxPhaseSupply;
        p.pricePerToken = cfg.pricePerToken;
        p.minPerTx = cfg.minPerTx;
        p.maxPerTx = cfg.maxPerTx;
        p.maxPerWallet = cfg.maxPerWallet;
        p.validationData = cfg.validationData;

        delete p.supportedCurrencies;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < cfg.supportedCurrencies.length; i++) {
            p.supportedCurrencies.push(cfg.supportedCurrencies[i]);
        }

        if (resetRuntime) {
            p.totalClaimed = 0;
            p.participantCount = 0;
            p.removed = false;
        }
    }

    function _validatePhaseInput(PhaseConditionInput memory cfg, bytes calldata adminAuth) internal view {
        require(cfg.claimType <= 2, "Invalid claim type");
        require(cfg.startTime < cfg.endTime, "Invalid time range");
        require(cfg.maxPhaseSupply > 0, "Invalid amount range");

        if (cfg.maxPerTx != 0) {
            require(cfg.minPerTx <= cfg.maxPerTx, "Invalid amount range");
        }
        if (cfg.maxPerWallet != 0 && cfg.maxPerTx != 0) {
            require(cfg.maxPerTx <= cfg.maxPerWallet, "Exceeds max per wallet");
        }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < cfg.supportedCurrencies.length; i++) {
            require(_registrySupportsCurrency(cfg.supportedCurrencies[i]), "Unsupported currency");
        }

        if (cfg.claimType != 0) {
            require(adminAuth.length > 0, "Invalid signature");
        }
    }

    function _verifyClaimType(
        PhaseCondition storage p,
        address receiver,
        address currency,
        uint256 phaseId,
        uint256 quantity,
        bytes calldata authData
    ) internal view {
        if (p.claimType == 0) return;

        if (p.claimType == 1) {
            require(authData.length > 0, "Invalid claim type");
            return;
        }

        if (p.claimType == 2) {
            bytes32 inner = keccak256(
                abi.encode(block.chainid, address(this), receiver, currency, phaseId, quantity, p.validationData)
            );
            bytes32 digest = keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32", inner));

            address signer = _recover(digest, authData);
            address verifier = _getVerifier();
            if (verifier == address(0)) {
                verifier = address(uint160(uint256(p.validationData)));
            }

            require(signer != address(0) && signer == verifier, "Invalid signature");
            return;
        }

        revert("Invalid claim type");
    }

    function _requireCurrencyAllowed(PhaseCondition storage p, address currency) internal view {
        if (p.supportedCurrencies.length == 0) return;

        bool ok = false;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.supportedCurrencies.length; i++) {
            if (p.supportedCurrencies[i] == currency) {
                ok = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        require(ok, "Invalid currency");
    }

    function _recomputeWindow() internal {
        uint64 minStart = type(uint64).max;
        uint64 maxEnd = 0;
        bool found = false;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _phases.length; i++) {
            if (_phases[i].removed) continue;
            found = true;

            if (_phases[i].startTime < minStart) minStart = _phases[i].startTime;
            if (_phases[i].endTime > maxEnd) maxEnd = _phases[i].endTime;
        }

        if (!found) {
            _startTime = 0;
            _endTime = 0;
        } else {
            _startTime = minStart;
            _endTime = maxEnd;
        }
    }

    function _requireUpgrader() internal view {
        address upgrader = _registryLookup("Upgrader");
        require(msg.sender == upgrader, "OwnableUnauthorizedAccount");
    }

    function _registryLookup(string memory key) internal view returns (address result) {
        address reg = registry;
        if (reg == address(0)) return address(0);

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reg.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x0205febe), key));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return address(0);
        result = abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _registrySupportsCurrency(address currency) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (currency == address(0)) return true;
        address reg = registry;
        if (reg == address(0)) return true;

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reg.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xfca8d471), currency)
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return false;
        return abi.decode(data, (bool));
    }

    function _getVerifier() internal view returns (address) {
        address reg = registry;
        if (reg == address(0)) return address(0);

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reg.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x46657fe9)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return address(0);
        return abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _recover(bytes32 digest, bytes calldata sig) internal pure returns (address) {
        if (sig.length != 65) return address(0);

        bytes32 r;
        bytes32 s;
        uint8 v;
        assembly {
            r := calldataload(sig.offset)
            s := calldataload(add(sig.offset, 32))
            v := byte(0, calldataload(add(sig.offset, 64)))
        }

        if (v < 27) v += 27;
        if (v != 27 && v != 28) return address(0);

        return ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
    }

    function _upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes calldata data) internal {
        require(newImplementation.code.length > 0, "ERC1967InvalidImplementation");

        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =
            newImplementation.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(this.proxiableUUID.selector));
        require(ok && ret.length >= 32 && abi.decode(ret, (bytes32)) == _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, "ERC1967InvalidImplementation");

        _setImplementation(newImplementation);
        emit Upgraded(newImplementation);

        if (data.length > 0) {
            (bool success, bytes memory reason) = newImplementation.delegatecall(data);
            if (!success) _revertBytes(reason);
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "NonPayable");
        }
    }

    function _getImplementation() internal view returns (address impl) {
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {
            impl := sload(slot)
        }
    }

    function _setImplementation(address newImplementation) internal {
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {
            sstore(slot, newImplementation)
        }
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
            token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transfer.selector, to, amount));
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "Transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
            token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount));
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "Transfer failed");
    }

    function _sendETH(address payable to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: value}("");
        require(ok, "Transfer failed");
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    function _revertBytes(bytes memory reason) internal pure {
        assembly {
            revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
        }
    }
}

contract LendingPool {
    using SafeMath for uint256;

    address private constant ETH_ADDRESS = 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE;
    uint256 private constant _LENDINGPOOL_REVISION_CONST = 4;
    uint256 private constant _UINT_MAX_VALUE_CONST = uint256(-1);

    uint256 private _guardCounter;
    uint256 private _lastInitializedRevision;
    bool private _initializing;

    address private _addressesProvider;
    address private _core;
    address private _dataProvider;
    address private _parametersProvider;
    address private _feeProvider;

    event ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(address indexed reserve, address indexed user);
    event ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(address indexed reserve, address indexed user);

    event Deposit(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 amount,
        uint16 referral,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event RedeemUnderlying(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event Borrow(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 borrowRateMode,
        uint256 borrowRate,
        uint256 originationFee,
        uint256 borrowBalanceIncrease,
        uint16 referral,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event Repay(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        address indexed repayer,
        uint256 paybackAmount,
        uint256 fees,
        uint256 balanceIncrease,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event Swap(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 rateMode,
        uint256 borrowRate,
        uint256 balanceIncrease,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event FlashLoan(
        address indexed target,
        address indexed reserve,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 totalFee,
        uint256 protocolFee,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    constructor() public {
        _guardCounter = 1;
    }

    function() external payable {
        revert("Unsupported operation");
    }

    modifier onlyInitialized() {
        require(_core != address(0), "Contract not initialized");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        _guardCounter = _guardCounter.add(1);
        uint256 localCounter = _guardCounter;
        _;
        require(localCounter == _guardCounter, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
    }

    function initialize(address provider) external {
        require(provider != address(0), "Invalid address provider");
        require(_initializing || _lastInitializedRevision < _LENDINGPOOL_REVISION_CONST, "Contract instance has already been initialized");

        bool isTopLevelCall = !_initializing;
        if (isTopLevelCall) {
            _initializing = true;
        }

        _lastInitializedRevision = _LENDINGPOOL_REVISION_CONST;
        _addressesProvider = provider;

        ILendingPoolAddressesProvider ap = ILendingPoolAddressesProvider(provider);
        _core = ap.getLendingPoolCore();
        _dataProvider = ap.getLendingPoolDataProvider();
        _parametersProvider = ap.getLendingPoolParametersProvider();
        _feeProvider = ap.getFeeProvider();

        if (_guardCounter == 0) {
            _guardCounter = 1;
        }

        if (isTopLevelCall) {
            _initializing = false;
        }
    }

    function LENDINGPOOL_REVISION() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return _LENDINGPOOL_REVISION_CONST;
    }

    function UINT_MAX_VALUE() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return _UINT_MAX_VALUE_CONST;
    }

    function addressesProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return _addressesProvider;
    }

    function core() external view returns (address) {
        return _core;
    }

    function dataProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return _dataProvider;
    }

    function parametersProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return _parametersProvider;
    }

    function getReserves() external view onlyInitialized returns (address[] memory) {
        return ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getReserves();
    }

    function getUserReserveData(address reserve, address user) external view onlyInitialized returns (
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        bool
    ) {
        return ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getUserReserveData(reserve, user);
    }

    function getReserveData(address reserve) external view onlyInitialized returns (
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        address,
        uint40
    ) {
        return ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getReserveData(reserve);
    }

    function getReserveConfigurationData(address reserve) external view onlyInitialized returns (
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        bool,
        bool,
        bool,
        bool
    ) {
        return ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getReserveConfigurationData(reserve);
    }

    function getUserAccountData(address user) external view onlyInitialized returns (
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256,
        uint256
    ) {
        return ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getUserAccountData(user);
    }

    function deposit(address reserve, uint256 amount, uint16 referralCode)
        external
        payable
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireAmountGreaterThanZero(amount);
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);
        _requireReserveNotFreezed(reserve);

        if (_isETH(reserve)) {
            require(msg.value == amount, "Invalid msg.value sent for the deposit");
            ILendingPoolCore(_core).transferToReserve.value(msg.value)(reserve, msg.sender, amount);
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "Invalid msg.value");
            ILendingPoolCore(_core).transferToReserve(reserve, msg.sender, amount);
        }

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).updateStateOnDeposit(reserve, msg.sender, amount, true);
        emit Deposit(reserve, msg.sender, amount, referralCode, block.timestamp);
    }

    function redeemUnderlying(
        address reserve,
        address user,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 userBalanceAfterRedeem
    )
        external
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireAmountGreaterThanZero(amount);
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);

        address aToken = ILendingPoolCore(_core).getReserveATokenAddress(reserve);
        require(msg.sender == aToken, "The caller of this function can only be the aToken contract for this reserve");

        require(
            ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).balanceDecreaseAllowed(reserve, user, amount),
            "There is not enough collateral to cover a new borrow"
        );

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).updateStateOnRedeem(reserve, user, amount, userBalanceAfterRedeem == 0);
        ILendingPoolCore(_core).transferToUser(reserve, user, amount);

        emit RedeemUnderlying(reserve, user, amount, block.timestamp);
    }

    function setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(address reserve, bool useAsCollateral)
        external
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);

        if (!useAsCollateral) {
            uint256 underlyingBalance = ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getUserUnderlyingAssetBalance(reserve, msg.sender);
            if (underlyingBalance > 0) {
                require(
                    ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).balanceDecreaseAllowed(reserve, msg.sender, underlyingBalance),
                    "User deposit is already being used as collateral"
                );
            }
        }

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(reserve, msg.sender, useAsCollateral);

        if (useAsCollateral) {
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(reserve, msg.sender);
        } else {
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(reserve, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function borrow(address reserve, uint256 amount, uint256 interestRateMode, uint16 referralCode)
        external
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireAmountGreaterThanZero(amount);
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);
        _requireReserveNotFreezed(reserve);

        require(
            ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).isReserveBorrowingEnabled(reserve),
            "Reserve is not enabled for borrow"
        );
        require(interestRateMode == 1 || interestRateMode == 2, "Invalid interest rate mode selected");

        if (interestRateMode == 1) {
            require(
                ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).isUserAllowedToBorrowAtStable(reserve, msg.sender, amount),
                "User cannot borrow the selected amount with a stable rate"
            );
        }

        uint256 availableLiquidity = ILendingPoolCore(_core).getReserveAvailableLiquidity(reserve);
        require(availableLiquidity >= amount, "There is not enough liquidity available to borrow");

        uint256 borrowFee = IFeeProvider(_feeProvider).calculateLoanOriginationFee(msg.sender, amount);
        (, , uint256 balanceIncrease) = ILendingPoolCore(_core).getUserBorrowBalances(reserve, msg.sender);

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).updateStateOnBorrow(
            reserve,
            msg.sender,
            amount,
            borrowFee,
            uint8(interestRateMode)
        );
        ILendingPoolCore(_core).transferToUser(reserve, msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 borrowRate = 0;
        if (interestRateMode == 1) {
            borrowRate = ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getUserCurrentStableBorrowRate(reserve, msg.sender);
        }

        emit Borrow(
            reserve,
            msg.sender,
            amount,
            interestRateMode,
            borrowRate,
            borrowFee,
            balanceIncrease,
            referralCode,
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function repay(address reserve, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf)
        external
        payable
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireAmountGreaterThanZero(amount);
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);

        (
            uint256 principalBorrowBalance,
            uint256 compoundedBorrowBalance,
            uint256 balanceIncrease
        ) = ILendingPoolCore(_core).getUserBorrowBalances(reserve, onBehalfOf);

        uint256 originationFee = ILendingPoolCore(_core).getUserOriginationFee(reserve, onBehalfOf);

        uint256 paybackAmount = amount;
        if (amount == _UINT_MAX_VALUE_CONST || amount > compoundedBorrowBalance) {
            paybackAmount = compoundedBorrowBalance;
        }

        bool repaidWholeLoan = paybackAmount == compoundedBorrowBalance || amount == _UINT_MAX_VALUE_CONST;
        uint256 feeRepaid = repaidWholeLoan ? originationFee : 0;
        uint256 totalPayback = paybackAmount.add(feeRepaid);

        require(totalPayback > 0 || principalBorrowBalance > 0, "User does not have a borrow in progress");

        if (_isETH(reserve)) {
            require(msg.value >= totalPayback, "Invalid msg.value sent for the repayment");

            ILendingPoolCore(_core).transferToReserve.value(totalPayback)(reserve, msg.sender, totalPayback);

            if (msg.value > totalPayback) {
                address(uint160(msg.sender)).transfer(msg.value.sub(totalPayback));
            }
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "Invalid msg.value");
            ILendingPoolCore(_core).transferToReserve(reserve, msg.sender, totalPayback);
        }

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).updateStateOnRepay(
            reserve,
            onBehalfOf,
            paybackAmount,
            feeRepaid,
            balanceIncrease,
            repaidWholeLoan
        );

        emit Repay(
            reserve,
            onBehalfOf,
            msg.sender,
            paybackAmount,
            feeRepaid,
            balanceIncrease,
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function swapBorrowRateMode(address reserve)
        external
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);

        uint256 currentRateMode = ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getUserCurrentBorrowRateMode(reserve, msg.sender);
        require(currentRateMode == 1 || currentRateMode == 2, "User does not have a borrow in progress");

        uint8 newRateMode = currentRateMode == 1 ? uint8(2) : uint8(1);
        (
            uint256 principalBorrowBalance,
            uint256 compoundedBorrowBalance,
            uint256 balanceIncrease
        ) = ILendingPoolCore(_core).getUserBorrowBalances(reserve, msg.sender);

        uint256 borrowRate = ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getUserCurrentStableBorrowRate(reserve, msg.sender);

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).updateStateOnSwapRate(
            reserve,
            msg.sender,
            principalBorrowBalance,
            compoundedBorrowBalance,
            balanceIncrease,
            newRateMode
        );

        emit Swap(reserve, msg.sender, uint256(newRateMode), borrowRate, balanceIncrease, block.timestamp);
    }

    function rebalanceStableBorrowRate(address reserve, address user)
        external
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);
        _requireReserveNotFreezed(reserve);

        uint256 rateMode = ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getUserCurrentBorrowRateMode(reserve, user);
        require(rateMode == 1, "The user borrow is variable and cannot be rebalanced");

        (
            uint256 principalBorrowBalance,
            uint256 compoundedBorrowBalance,
            uint256 balanceIncrease
        ) = ILendingPoolCore(_core).getUserBorrowBalances(reserve, user);

        uint256 borrowRate = ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getUserCurrentStableBorrowRate(reserve, user);

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).updateStateOnSwapRate(
            reserve,
            user,
            principalBorrowBalance,
            compoundedBorrowBalance,
            balanceIncrease,
            1
        );

        emit Swap(reserve, user, 1, borrowRate, balanceIncrease, block.timestamp);
    }

    function flashLoan(address receiver, address reserve, uint256 amount, bytes calldata params)
        external
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireAmountGreaterThanZero(amount);
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);
        _requireReserveNotFreezed(reserve);
        require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid receiver address");

        uint256 availableLiquidity = ILendingPoolCore(_core).getReserveAvailableLiquidity(reserve);
        require(availableLiquidity >= amount, "There is not enough liquidity available to borrow");

        (uint256 totalFeeBips, uint256 protocolFeeBips) =
            ILendingPoolParametersProvider(_parametersProvider).getFlashLoanFeesInBips();

        uint256 totalFee = amount.mul(totalFeeBips).div(10000);
        uint256 protocolFee = amount.mul(protocolFeeBips).div(10000);

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).transferToUser(reserve, receiver, amount);

        require(
            IFlashLoanReceiver(receiver).executeOperation(reserve, amount, totalFee, params),
            "Flashloan execution failed"
        );

        ILendingPoolCore(_core).transferToReserve(reserve, receiver, amount.add(totalFee));
        ILendingPoolCore(_core).updateStateOnFlashLoan(reserve, amount, totalFee, protocolFee);

        emit FlashLoan(receiver, reserve, amount, totalFee, protocolFee, block.timestamp);
    }

    function liquidationCall(
        address collateral,
        address reserve,
        address user,
        uint256 purchaseAmount,
        bool receiveAToken
    )
        external
        payable
        onlyInitialized
        nonReentrant
    {
        _requireAmountGreaterThanZero(purchaseAmount);
        _requireReserveActive(collateral);
        _requireReserveActive(reserve);

        address manager = ILendingPoolAddressesProvider(_addressesProvider).getLendingPoolLiquidationManager();
        require(manager != address(0), "Invalid liquidation manager");

        (bool success, ) = manager.delegatecall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(
                bytes4(0x00a718a9),
                collateral,
                reserve,
                user,
                purchaseAmount,
                receiveAToken
            )
        );
        require(success, "Liquidation call failed");
    }

    function _isETH(address reserve) internal pure returns (bool) {
        return reserve == ETH_ADDRESS;
    }

    function _requireAmountGreaterThanZero(uint256 amount) internal pure {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than 0");
    }

    function _requireReserveActive(address reserve) internal view {
        require(
            ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getReserveIsActive(reserve),
            "Action requires an active reserve"
        );
    }

    function _requireReserveNotFreezed(address reserve) internal view {
        require(
            !ILendingPoolDataProvider(_dataProvider).getReserveIsFreezed(reserve),
            "Action requires an unfreezed reserve"
        );
    }
}

        if (reason.length == 0) revert("CALL_FAILED");

        }

    function _deleteNodeFromValidator(uint256 validatorId, uint256 nodeIndex) internal {
        if (!_validatorHasNode[validatorId][nodeIndex]) return;

        uint256[] storage arr = _validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId];
        uint256 len = arr.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {

        _spacePositionInBucket[nodeIndex] = _spaceToNodes[space].length;

    function _removeFromSpaceBucket(uint256 nodeIndex, uint8 space) internal {
        uint256[] storage bucket = _spaceToNodes[space];
        if (bucket.length == 0) return;

        uint256 idx = _spacePositionInBucket[nodeIndex];
        if (idx >= bucket.length || bucket[idx] != nodeIndex) {

            for (uint256 i = 0; i < bucket.length; i++) {

                    idx = i;
                    found = true;
                    break;

            }
            if (!found) return;
        }

        uint256 lastIdx = bucket.length - 1;
        uint256 lastNode = bucket[lastIdx];

        if (idx != lastIdx) {
            bucket[idx] = lastNode;
            _spacePositionInBucket[lastNode] = idx;
        }

        bucket.pop();
        delete _spacePositionInBucket[nodeIndex];
    }

        if (msg.sender != _owner && _vePendleImmutable != address(0)) {
            require(IVePendleLike(_vePendleImmutable).balanceOf(msg.sender) > 0, "insufficient vePendle");
        }

        uint128 week = _currentWeek();
        uint256 totalWeight;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < pools.length; i++) {
            address pool = pools[i];
            require(_isActivePool[pool], "inactive pool");

            VoteWeight storage poolWeek = _poolWeekVotes[pool][week];
            VoteWeight memory oldVote = _userPoolVote[msg.sender][pool];

            poolWeek.bias = _sub128(poolWeek.bias, oldVote.bias);
            poolWeek.slope = _sub128(poolWeek.slope, oldVote.slope);

            VoteWeight memory newVote = VoteWeight({
                bias: uint128(weights[i]),
                slope: uint128(weights[i])
            });

            poolWeek.bias += newVote.bias;
            poolWeek.slope += newVote.slope;

            _poolCurrentVote[pool] = poolWeek;
            _userPoolVote[msg.sender][pool] = newVote;
            _userVoteWeek[msg.sender][pool] = uint64(week);
            _userPoolHistory[msg.sender][pool].push(newVote);

            totalWeight += weights[i];

            emit Vote(msg.sender, pool, uint64(week), newVote);
            emit PoolVoteChange(pool, poolWeek);
        }

        require(totalWeight <= _GOVERNANCE_PENDLE_VOTE_CONST, "vote too large");

        uint128 week = _currentWeek();
        if (_weekFinalized[week]) return;

            _poolWeekVotes[pool][week] = v;

        if (chainId == uint64(block.chainid)) return 0;
        address dst = _destinationContract[chainId];
        if (dst == address(0) || _endpointImmutable == address(0)) return 0;

        uint128 week = _currentWeek();
        address[] memory pools = _activePoolsByChain[chainId];

        require(pools.length == votes_.length, "length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < pools.length; i++) {
            uint128 b = votes_[i] > type(uint128).max ? type(uint128).max : uint128(votes_[i]);
            VoteWeight memory v = VoteWeight({bias: b, slope: b});
            _poolWeekVotes[pools[i]][week] = v;
            _poolCurrentVote[pools[i]] = v;
            emit PoolVoteChange(pools[i], v);
        }
        _weekFinalized[week] = true;
        if (week > _lastFinalizedWeek) _lastFinalizedWeek = week;
    }

    function _collectVotes(address[] memory pools, uint128 week) internal view returns (uint256[] memory votes_, uint128 totalVote) {
        votes_ = new uint256[](pools.length);
        uint256 total;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < pools.length; i++) {
            uint128 v = _poolWeekVotes[pools[i]][week].bias;
            if (v == 0) v = _poolCurrentVote[pools[i]].bias;
            votes_[i] = v;
            total += v;
        }

    }

    function _weeklyPendleAmount() internal view returns (uint128) {
        uint256 amt = uint256(_pendlePerSecValue) * _WEEK_CONST;
        return amt > type(uint128).max ? type(uint128).max : uint128(amt);
    }

    function _setOwner(address newOwner) internal {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    function _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(address newImplementation, bytes memory data, bool forceCall) internal {
        require(_isContract(newImplementation), "ERC1967: new implementation is not a contract");

        try IERC1822Proxiable(newImplementation).proxiableUUID() returns (bytes32 slot) {
            require(slot == _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, "ERC1967Upgrade: unsupported proxiableUUID");
        } catch {
            revert("ERC1967Upgrade: new implementation is not UUPS");
        }

        _setImplementation(newImplementation);
        emit Upgraded(newImplementation);

        if (data.length > 0 || forceCall) {
            (bool ok, bytes memory reason) = newImplementation.delegatecall(data);
            if (!ok) {
                if (reason.length > 0) {
                    assembly {
                        revert(add(reason, 0x20), mload(reason))
                    }
                }
                revert("Address: low-level delegate call failed");
            }
        }
    }

    function _setImplementation(address newImplementation) internal {
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {
            sstore(slot, newImplementation)
        }
    }

    function _getImplementation() internal view returns (address impl) {
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {
            impl := sload(slot)
        }
    }

    function _currentWeek() internal view returns (uint128) {
        uint256 w = (block.timestamp / _WEEK_CONST) * _WEEK_CONST;
        return w > type(uint128).max ? type(uint128).max : uint128(w);
    }

    function _sendValue(address payable to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Address: insufficient balance");
        (bool success, ) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "Address: unable to send value, recipient may have reverted");
    }

    function _isContract(address a) internal view returns (bool) {
        return a.code.length > 0;
    }

    function _removeAddress(address[] storage arr, address value) internal returns (bool) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == value) {
                arr[i] = arr[arr.length - 1];
                arr.pop();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    function _sub128(uint128 a, uint128 b) internal pure returns (uint128) {
        return a > b ? a - b : 0;
    }

        IRegistryUpgrader upgrader = IRegistryUpgrader(_upgraderAddress());
        if (data.length == 0) {
            upgrader.upgrade(proxy, newImplementation);

    }

        require(_upgrader != address(0), "ContractsRegistry: Bad upgrader");

    function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal {
        bytes32 previousAdmin = _roles[role].adminRole;
        _roles[role].adminRole = adminRole;
        emit RoleAdminChanged(role, previousAdmin, adminRole);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) {
            return;
        }
        _roles[role].members[account] = true;
        _roles[role].memberList.push(account);
        _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account] = _roles[role].memberList.length;
        emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) {
            return;
        }

        _roles[role].members[account] = false;
        uint256 idx = _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account];
        if (idx > 0) {
            uint256 index = idx - 1;
            uint256 lastIndex = _roles[role].memberList.length - 1;
            if (index != lastIndex) {
                address last = _roles[role].memberList[lastIndex];
                _roles[role].memberList[index] = last;
                _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[last] = idx;
            }
            _roles[role].memberList.pop();
            delete _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account];
        }

        emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

        if (mintGuardianPausedGlobal || mintGuardianPaused[cToken]) return _fail(MARKET_PAUSED, 0);
        if (isCreditAccount[minter]) return _fail(CREDIT_ACCOUNT_RESTRICTION, 0);

        uint256 cap = supplyCaps[cToken];
        if (cap != 0) {
            uint256 total = ICTokenLike(cToken).totalSupply();
            if (total.add(mintAmount) > cap) return _fail(TOO_MANY_ASSETS, 0);

        return NO_ERROR;

        if (!marketsData[cToken].accountMembership[redeemer]) return NO_ERROR;

        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(redeemer, cToken, redeemTokens, 0);
        if (err != 0) return _fail(err, 0);
        if (shortfall != 0) return _fail(INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, 0);

        if (borrowGuardianPausedGlobal || borrowGuardianPaused[cToken]) return _fail(MARKET_PAUSED, 0);

            if (msg.sender != cToken) return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
            uint256 addErr = _addToMarketInternal(cToken, borrower);
            if (addErr != NO_ERROR) return addErr;

        uint256 cap = borrowCaps[cToken];
        if (cap != 0) {
            uint256 totalBorrows = ICTokenLike(cToken).totalBorrows();
            if (totalBorrows.add(borrowAmount) > cap) return _fail(TOO_MANY_ASSETS, 0);

        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(borrower, cToken, 0, borrowAmount);
        if (err != 0) return _fail(err, 0);
        if (shortfall != 0) return _fail(INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, 0);

    function liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens(
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address cTokenCollateral,
        uint256 actualRepayAmount
    ) external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 priceBorrowedMantissa = _getOraclePrice(cTokenBorrowed);
        uint256 priceCollateralMantissa = _getOraclePrice(cTokenCollateral);
        if (priceBorrowedMantissa == 0 || priceCollateralMantissa == 0) {
            return (PRICE_ERROR, 0);
        }

        uint256 exchangeRateMantissa = ICTokenLike(cTokenCollateral).exchangeRateStored();
        if (exchangeRateMantissa == 0) {
            return (PRICE_ERROR, 0);
        }

        uint256 numerator = actualRepayAmount.mul(liquidationIncentiveMantissa).mul(priceBorrowedMantissa);
        uint256 denominator = priceCollateralMantissa.mul(exchangeRateMantissa);
        if (denominator == 0) return (PRICE_ERROR, 0);

        uint256 seizeTokens = numerator.div(denominator);
        return (NO_ERROR, seizeTokens);
    }

    function getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(
        address account,
        address cTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) internal view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 sumCollateral = 0;
        uint256 sumBorrowPlusEffects = 0;

        address[] storage assets = accountAssetsList[account];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            address asset = assets[i];
            Market storage m = marketsData[asset];
            if (!m.isListed) continue;

            (uint256 oErr, uint256 cTokenBalance, uint256 borrowBalance, uint256 exchangeRateMantissa) =
                ICTokenLike(asset).getAccountSnapshot(account);
            if (oErr != 0) return (oErr, 0, 0);

            uint256 oraclePriceMantissa = _getOraclePrice(asset);
            if (oraclePriceMantissa == 0) return (PRICE_ERROR, 0, 0);

            uint256 tokensToDenom = m.collateralFactorMantissa.mul(exchangeRateMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE);
            tokensToDenom = tokensToDenom.mul(oraclePriceMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE);

            sumCollateral = sumCollateral.add(cTokenBalance.mul(tokensToDenom).div(EXP_SCALE));
            sumBorrowPlusEffects = sumBorrowPlusEffects.add(borrowBalance.mul(oraclePriceMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE));

            if (asset == cTokenModify) {
                sumBorrowPlusEffects = sumBorrowPlusEffects.add(redeemTokens.mul(tokensToDenom).div(EXP_SCALE));
                sumBorrowPlusEffects = sumBorrowPlusEffects.add(borrowAmount.mul(oraclePriceMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE));
            }
        }

        if (isCreditAccount[account]) {
            uint256 limit = creditLimits[account];
            if (limit > sumBorrowPlusEffects) {
                return (NO_ERROR, limit.sub(sumBorrowPlusEffects), 0);
            }
            return (NO_ERROR, 0, sumBorrowPlusEffects.sub(limit));
        }

        if (sumCollateral > sumBorrowPlusEffects) {
            return (NO_ERROR, sumCollateral.sub(sumBorrowPlusEffects), 0);
        }
        return (NO_ERROR, 0, sumBorrowPlusEffects.sub(sumCollateral));
    }

    function _addToMarketInternal(address cToken, address account) internal returns (uint256) {
        Market storage m = marketsData[cToken];
        if (!m.isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        if (m.accountMembership[account]) return NO_ERROR;
        if (accountAssetsList[account].length >= maxAssets) return _fail(TOO_MANY_ASSETS, 0);

        m.accountMembership[account] = true;
        accountAssetsList[account].push(cToken);
        emit MarketEntered(cToken, account);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function _removeAsset(address account, address cToken) internal {
        uint256 len = accountAssetsList[account].length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (accountAssetsList[account][i] == cToken) {
                accountAssetsList[account][i] = accountAssetsList[account][len - 1];
                accountAssetsList[account].length = len - 1;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    function _getOraclePrice(address cToken) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (oracle == address(0)) return 0;
        return IPriceOracleLike(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cToken);
    }

    function _fail(uint256 error, uint256 info) internal returns (uint256) {
        emit Failure(error, info, 0);
        return error;
    }

    function() external {
        if (msg.sig == bytes4(0x007e3dd2)) {
            assembly {
                mstore(0x00, 1)
                return(0x00, 0x20)
            }
        }
        revert("unknown selector");
    }

    constructor() {

            balanceOfBonded[msg.sender] -= amount;
            totalBonded -= amount;
        }

        totalStaged += amount;
