    function unbondUnderlying(uint256 amount) external {

            totalBonded -= amount;

            isNominated[candidate] = true;
            startFor[candidate] = epoch;
            periodFor[candidate] = epoch + currentEpochDuration;
            emit Proposal(msg.sender, candidate, startFor[candidate], periodFor[candidate]);

        if (previousVote == 1 && votesFor[candidate] >= weight) {
            unchecked {
                votesFor[candidate] -= weight;
            }
        }
        if (voteType == 1) {

        if (couponAmount == 0) return 0;
        uint256 factor = expiration > 2 ? 2 : (2 - expiration);
        return (couponAmount * factor) / 100;
    }

    function couponPremium(uint256 dollarAmount, uint256 expiration) public view returns (uint256) {
        return dollarAmount + additionalCouponPremium(dollarAmount, expiration) + baseCouponPremium(totalDebt);

    function couponRedemptionPenalty(uint256 couponEpoch, uint256 couponAmount, uint256 targetEpoch) public pure returns (uint256) {
        if (targetEpoch <= couponEpoch) return 0;
        uint256 periods = targetEpoch - couponEpoch;
        uint256 penalty = (couponAmount * periods) / 100;
        if (penalty > couponAmount) penalty = couponAmount;
        return penalty;
    }

    function purchaseCoupons(uint256 dollarAmount, uint256 expiration) external {
        require(dollarAmount > 0, "Market: Must purchase non-zero amount");
        _safeTransferFrom(dollar, msg.sender, address(this), dollarAmount);

        uint256 couponAmount = couponPremium(dollarAmount, expiration);
        balanceOfCoupons[msg.sender][expiration] += couponAmount;
        expiringCoupons[expiration] += couponAmount;
        totalCoupons += couponAmount;
        totalDebt += dollarAmount;

        emit CouponPurchase(msg.sender, dollarAmount, couponAmount, expiration);
        _syncNet();

    }

        _redeemCoupons(couponEpoch, couponAmount, minOutput, true);
    }

    function updateCoupons(uint256 fromEpoch, uint256 toEpoch) external {
        uint256 amount = balanceOfCoupons[msg.sender][fromEpoch];
        require(amount > 0, "Market: No coupons");
        require(balanceOfCoupons[msg.sender][toEpoch] == 0, "Market: Coupons already updated");

        balanceOfCoupons[msg.sender][fromEpoch] = 0;
        balanceOfCoupons[msg.sender][toEpoch] = amount;

        if (expiringCoupons[fromEpoch] >= amount) {
            unchecked {
                expiringCoupons[fromEpoch] -= amount;
            }
        }
        expiringCoupons[toEpoch] += amount;
        isInitialized[msg.sender] = true;

        emit CouponExpiration(fromEpoch, amount, toEpoch, totalCoupons, totalDebt);
    }

    function capture() external {
        _capture();
    }

    function advance() external {
        require(block.timestamp >= nextEpochStart(), "Bonding: Still current epoch");

        epoch += 1;
        currentEpochStart = block.timestamp;
        totalBondedAt[epoch] = totalBonded;

        _capture();
        emit Advance(epoch, block.number, block.timestamp);

        if (shouldDistributeDAI()) {
            uint256 incentive = daiAdvanceIncentive;
            uint256 bal = IERC20Like(dai).balanceOf(address(this));
            if (incentive > bal) incentive = bal;
            if (incentive > 0) {
                _safeTransfer(dai, msg.sender, incentive);
                emit DAIIncentivization(msg.sender, incentive);
            }
        }
    }

    function shouldDistributeDAI() public view returns (bool) {
        return epoch <= bootstrappingPeriod;
    }

    function nextEpochStart() public view returns (uint256) {
        return currentEpochStart + currentEpochDuration;
    }

    function timeInEpoch() external view returns (uint256) {
        if (block.timestamp <= currentEpochStart) return 0;
        return block.timestamp - currentEpochStart;
    }

    function timeLeftInEpoch() external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 end = nextEpochStart();
        if (block.timestamp >= end) return 0;
        return end - block.timestamp;
    }

    function bootstrappingAt(uint256 _epoch) external view returns (bool) {
        return _epoch < bootstrappingPeriod;
    }

    function mint(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwnerOrPool {
        balanceOf[account] += amount;
        totalSupply += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), account, amount);
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external {
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= amount, "burn");
        unchecked {
            balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;
            totalSupply -= amount;
        }
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, address(0), amount);
    }

    function _redeemCoupons(uint256 couponEpoch, uint256 couponAmount, uint256 minOutput, bool checkMin) internal {
        require(balanceOfCoupons[msg.sender][couponEpoch] >= couponAmount, "Market: Insufficient coupon balance");

        unchecked {
            balanceOfCoupons[msg.sender][couponEpoch] -= couponAmount;
        }

        if (expiringCoupons[couponEpoch] >= couponAmount) {
            unchecked {
                expiringCoupons[couponEpoch] -= couponAmount;
            }
        }

        if (totalCoupons >= couponAmount) {
            unchecked {
                totalCoupons -= couponAmount;
            }
        }

        uint256 penalty = couponRedemptionPenalty(couponEpoch, couponAmount, epoch);
        uint256 payout = couponAmount > penalty ? couponAmount - penalty : 0;

        if (checkMin) {
            require(payout >= minOutput, "Market: Insufficient output amount");
        }

        if (totalDebt >= payout) {
            unchecked {
                totalDebt -= payout;
            }
        }

        if (payout > 0) {
            _safeTransfer(dollar, msg.sender, payout);
        }

        emit CouponBurn(msg.sender, couponEpoch, couponAmount);
        emit CouponRedemption(msg.sender, payout, couponAmount);
        _syncNet();
    }

    function _capture() internal {
        uint256 oldSupply = totalSupply;
        if (oracle != address(0) && oracle.code.length > 0) {
            try IOracleLike(oracle).capture() returns (uint256, uint256) {} catch {}
        }
        uint256 newSupply = totalSupply;

        if (newSupply == oldSupply) {
            emit SupplyNeutral(oldSupply, newSupply);
        } else if (newSupply > oldSupply) {
            emit SupplyIncrease(oldSupply, newSupply, totalBonded, totalStaged, totalDebt, totalCoupons);
        } else {
            emit SupplyDecrease(oldSupply, newSupply, totalDebt, totalCoupons);
        }
    }

    function _syncNet() internal {
        totalNet = totalBonded > totalDebt ? (totalBonded - totalDebt) : 0;
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token.code.length > 0, "TOKEN_NOT_CONTRACT");
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transfer.selector, to, value));
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FAILED");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token.code.length > 0, "TOKEN_NOT_CONTRACT");
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value)
        );
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FROM_FAILED");
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert();
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert();
    }
}

    }

    function getRemainingAmount(uint256 orderId) public view returns (uint256) {
        Order storage o = _orders[orderId];
        if (o.amount <= o.filled) return 0;
        return o.amount - o.filled;
    }

    function isOrderExpired(uint256 orderId) public view returns (bool) {
        Order storage o = _orders[orderId];
        return o.user != address(0) && block.timestamp > o.expiry;
    }

    function getQueueNode(uint256 marketKey, uint256 orderId) public view returns (uint256 prev, uint256 next, bool exists) {
        bytes22 key = _keyFromUint(marketKey);
        prev = _prevInQueue[key][orderId];
        next = _nextInQueue[key][orderId];
        exists = (orderId == _queueHead[key]) || prev != 0 || next != 0;

    function activeOrderCount(uint256 marketKey) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _activeCountByKey(_keyFromUint(marketKey));

    function getActiveOrders(address token, uint8 side, uint8 kind) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {

    function placeOrder(
        uint256 side,
        uint256 kind,
        address token,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 ttl
    ) external payable nonReentrant returns (uint256) {
        return _placeOrder(side, kind, token, price, amount, ttl);
    }

    function cancelOrder(uint256 orderId) external nonReentrant {
        Order storage o = _orders[orderId];
        if (o.user == address(0)) revert("Order not found");
        if (o.user != msg.sender) revert("Not order owner");
        if (o.status != STATUS_ACTIVE) revert("Order not active");

        bytes22 key = _marketKey(o.token, o.side, o.kind);

        if (block.timestamp > o.expiry) {
            o.status = STATUS_EXPIRED;
            _dequeue(key, orderId);
            emit OrderExpired(orderId);
            revert("Order expired");
        }

        o.status = STATUS_CANCELLED;
        _dequeue(key, orderId);

        uint256 remaining = o.amount - o.filled;
        if (remaining > 0) {
            if (o.side == 1) {
                _safeTransfer(o.token, o.user, remaining);
            } else {
                uint256 quoteRefund = (remaining * o.price) / 1e18;
                (bool sent, ) = o.user.call{value: quoteRefund}("");
                require(sent, "ETH transfer to seller failed");
            }
        }

        emit OrderCancelled(orderId);
    }

    function executeOrder(uint256 orderId) public onlyAuthorized nonReentrant {
        _executeOrder(orderId);
    }

    function executeOrderPartial(uint256 orderId, uint256 fillAmount, uint256 executionPrice) public onlyAuthorized nonReentrant {
        _executeOrderPartial(orderId, fillAmount, executionPrice);
    }

    function executeOrders(MatchInput[] calldata matches_) external onlyAuthorized nonReentrant {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < matches_.length; i++) {
            _executeOrderPartial(matches_[i].orderId, matches_[i].amount, matches_[i].executionPrice);
        }
    }

    function setFeePercentage(uint256 newFee) external onlyOwner {
        if (newFee > MAX_FEE_PERCENTAGE) revert("Fee percentage too high");
        uint256 oldFee = _feePercentage;
        _feePercentage = newFee;
        emit FeePercentageUpdated(oldFee, newFee);
    }

    function setOrderSizeRange(uint256 minSize, uint256 maxSize) external onlyOwner {
        _setOrderSizeRange(minSize, maxSize);
    }

    function updateMaxOrderTTL(uint256 ttl) external onlyOwner {
        _setMaxOrderTtl(ttl);
    }

    function updateExecutionRewardBps(uint256 bps) external onlyOwner {
        _setExecutionRewardBps(bps);
    }

    function updateMaxPriceDeviation(uint256 newDeviation) external onlyOwner {
        if (newDeviation > DIVISOR) revert("Invalid price range");
        uint256 old = _maxPriceDeviation;
        _maxPriceDeviation = newDeviation;
        emit MaxPriceDeviationUpdated(old, newDeviation);
    }

    function setGradientRegistry(address newRegistry) external onlyOwner {
        _setGradientRegistry(newRegistry);
    }

    function withdrawFees(address recipient) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        if (recipient == address(0)) revert("Invalid recipient");
        uint256 amount = _totalFeesCollected;
        if (amount == 0) revert("No fees to withdraw");

        _totalFeesCollected = 0;
        (bool ok, ) = recipient.call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "ETH transfer to seller failed");

        emit FeesWithdrawn(recipient, amount);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        if (newOwner == address(0)) revert OwnableInvalidOwner(address(0));
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function getReserves(address token) public view returns (uint256 reserveToken, uint256 reserveWeth) {
        address routerAddr = _routerFromRegistry();
        require(routerAddr != address(0), "Router not set");

        address factoryAddr = _staticAddress(routerAddr, bytes4(0xc45a0155));
        require(factoryAddr != address(0), "Factory not set");

        address weth = _staticAddress(factoryAddr, bytes4(0xad5c4648));
        require(weth != address(0), "WETH not set");

        address pair = _pair(factoryAddr, token, weth);
        require(pair != address(0), "Market maker pool not set");

        (uint112 r0, uint112 r1, ) = IPairLike(pair).getReserves();
        address t0 = IPairLike(pair).token0();

        if (t0 == token) {
            reserveToken = uint256(r0);
            reserveWeth = uint256(r1);
        } else {
            reserveToken = uint256(r1);
            reserveWeth = uint256(r0);
        }
    }

    function getMarketPrice(address token) public view returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 reserveToken, uint256 reserveWeth) = getReserves(token);
        require(reserveToken > 0 && reserveWeth > 0, "Insufficient liquidity");
        return (reserveWeth * 1e18) / reserveToken;
    }

    function isPriceWithinDeviation(address token, uint256 executionPrice) public view returns (bool) {
        uint256 marketPrice = getMarketPrice(token);
        uint256 d = _absDiff(executionPrice, marketPrice);
        return (d * DIVISOR) / marketPrice <= _maxPriceDeviation;
    }

    function _placeOrder(
        uint256 sideRaw,
        uint256 kindRaw,
        address token,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 ttl
    ) internal returns (uint256 orderId) {
        require(sideRaw < 2 && kindRaw < 2, "Invalid order types");
        require(token != address(0), "Invalid token");
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than 0");
        require(price > 0, "Invalid price range");
        require(ttl > 0, "TTL must be greater than 0");
        require(ttl <= _maxOrderTtl, "TTL too long");
        require(amount >= _minOrderSize, "Amount must be greater than 0");
        require(amount <= _maxOrderSize, "Order too large");
        require(!_isBlockedToken(token), "Blocked token");

        uint8 side = uint8(sideRaw);
        uint8 kind = uint8(kindRaw);

        if (side == 0) {
            uint256 requiredQuote = (amount * price) / 1e18;
            require(msg.value >= requiredQuote, "Insufficient ETH sent");
            if (msg.value > requiredQuote) {
                (bool refundOk, ) = msg.sender.call{value: msg.value - requiredQuote}("");
                require(refundOk, "ETH transfer to seller failed");
            }
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "ETH not accepted");
            _safeTransferFrom(token, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        }

        orderId = ++_nextOrderId;
        uint256 expiry = block.timestamp + ttl;

        _orders[orderId] = Order({
            id: orderId,
            user: msg.sender,
            side: side,
            kind: kind,
            token: token,
            price: price,
            amount: amount,
            filled: 0,
            expiry: expiry,
            status: STATUS_ACTIVE
        });

        bytes22 key = _marketKey(token, side, kind);
        _enqueue(key, orderId);

        emit OrderPlaced(orderId, msg.sender, token, side, kind, price, amount, expiry);
    }

    function _executeOrder(uint256 orderId) internal {
        Order storage o = _orders[orderId];
        if (o.user == address(0)) revert("Order not found");
        uint256 remaining = getRemainingAmount(orderId);
        if (remaining == 0) return;
        uint256 px = getMarketPrice(o.token);
        _executeOrderPartial(orderId, remaining, px);
    }

    function _executeOrderPartial(uint256 orderId, uint256 fillAmount, uint256 executionPrice) internal {
        if (fillAmount == 0) revert("Fill amount must be greater than 0");

        Order storage o = _orders[orderId];
        if (o.user == address(0)) revert("Order not found");
        if (o.status != STATUS_ACTIVE) revert("Order not active");

        bytes22 key = _marketKey(o.token, o.side, o.kind);

        if (block.timestamp > o.expiry) {
            o.status = STATUS_EXPIRED;
            _dequeue(key, orderId);
            emit OrderExpired(orderId);
            return;
        }

        uint256 remaining = o.amount - o.filled;
        if (fillAmount > remaining) fillAmount = remaining;

        if (executionPrice == 0) executionPrice = getMarketPrice(o.token);
        if (!isPriceWithinDeviation(o.token, executionPrice)) {
            revert("Execution price deviates too much from market price");
        }

        if (o.kind == 0) {
            if (o.side == 0) require(executionPrice <= o.price, "Execution price exceeds buyer's max price");
            else require(executionPrice >= o.price, "Execution price below seller's min price");
        }

        o.filled += fillAmount;

        uint256 quoteAmount = (fillAmount * executionPrice) / 1e18;
        uint256 fee = (quoteAmount * _feePercentage) / DIVISOR;
        _totalFeesCollected += fee;

        if (o.filled >= o.amount) {
            o.status = STATUS_FILLED;
            _dequeue(key, orderId);
        }

        emit OrderFulfilled(orderId, fillAmount);
    }

    function _getActiveOrders(address token, uint8 side, uint8 kind) internal view returns (uint256[] memory ids) {
        bytes22 key = _marketKey(token, side, kind);
        uint256 count = _activeCountByKey(key);
        ids = new uint256[](count);

        uint256 idx;
        uint256 cur = _queueHead[key];
        while (cur != 0) {
            Order storage o = _orders[cur];
            if (o.status == STATUS_ACTIVE && block.timestamp <= o.expiry) {
                ids[idx++] = cur;
            }
            cur = _nextInQueue[key][cur];
        }
    }

    function _activeCountByKey(bytes22 key) internal view returns (uint256 count) {
        uint256 cur = _queueHead[key];
        while (cur != 0) {
            Order storage o = _orders[cur];
            if (o.status == STATUS_ACTIVE && block.timestamp <= o.expiry) {
                count++;
            }
            cur = _nextInQueue[key][cur];
        }
    }

    function _enqueue(bytes22 key, uint256 orderId) internal {
        uint256 tail = _queueTail[key];
        if (tail == 0) {
            _queueHead[key] = orderId;
            _queueTail[key] = orderId;
        } else {
            _nextInQueue[key][tail] = orderId;
            _prevInQueue[key][orderId] = tail;
            _queueTail[key] = orderId;
        }
        _marketActiveCount[key] += 1;
    }

    function _dequeue(bytes22 key, uint256 orderId) internal {
        uint256 prev = _prevInQueue[key][orderId];
        uint256 next = _nextInQueue[key][orderId];

        if (prev == 0) _queueHead[key] = next;
        else _nextInQueue[key][prev] = next;

        if (next == 0) _queueTail[key] = prev;
        else _prevInQueue[key][next] = prev;

        delete _prevInQueue[key][orderId];
        delete _nextInQueue[key][orderId];

        if (_marketActiveCount[key] > 0) {
            _marketActiveCount[key] -= 1;
        }
    }

    function _setOrderSizeRange(uint256 minSize, uint256 maxSize) internal {
        require(minSize < maxSize, "Min size must be less than max size");
        _minOrderSize = minSize;
        _maxOrderSize = maxSize;
        emit OrderSizeRangeUpdated(minSize, maxSize);
    }

    function _setMaxOrderTtl(uint256 ttl) internal {
        require(ttl > 0, "TTL must be greater than 0");
        uint256 old = _maxOrderTtl;
        _maxOrderTtl = ttl;
        emit MaxOrderTTLUpdated(old, ttl);
    }

    function _setExecutionRewardBps(uint256 bps) internal {
        require(bps <= DIVISOR, "Invalid price range");
        uint256 old = _executionRewardBps;
        _executionRewardBps = bps;
        emit ExecutionRewardBpsUpdated(old, bps);
    }

    function _setGradientRegistry(address newRegistry) internal {
        require(newRegistry != address(0), "Invalid gradient registry");
        address old = _gradientRegistry;
        _gradientRegistry = newRegistry;
        emit GradientRegistryUpdated(old, newRegistry);
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _orderTuple(uint256 orderId) internal view returns (
        uint256 id,
        address user,
        uint8 side,
        uint8 kind,
        address token,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 filled,

        Order storage o = _orders[orderId];
        return (o.id, o.user, o.side, o.kind, o.token, o.price, o.amount, o.filled, o.expiry, o.status);
    }

    function _marketKey(address token, uint8 side, uint8 kind) internal pure returns (bytes22) {
        uint176 packed = (uint176(uint160(token)) << 16) | (uint176(side) << 8) | uint176(kind);
        return bytes22(packed);
    }

    function _keyFromUint(uint256 marketKey) internal pure returns (bytes22) {
        return bytes22(uint176(marketKey));
    }

    function _routerFromRegistry() internal view returns (address) {
        return _staticAddress(_gradientRegistry, bytes4(0xf887ea40));
    }

    function _pair(address factoryAddr, address token, address weth) internal view returns (address pair) {
        if (factoryAddr == address(0)) return address(0);
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = factoryAddr.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xe6a43905), token, weth)
        );
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) {
            pair = abi.decode(data, (address));
        }
    }

    function _isBlockedToken(address token) internal view returns (bool) {
        address routerAddr = _routerFromRegistry();
        if (routerAddr == address(0)) return false;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = routerAddr.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x39b59958), token)
        );
        return ok && data.length >= 32 && abi.decode(data, (bool);
    }

    function _isAuthorized(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (account == _owner) return true;
        if (_gradientRegistry == address(0)) return false;

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = _gradientRegistry.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x14c530d5), account)
        );
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) return abi.decode(data, (bool));

        (ok, data) = _gradientRegistry.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa62986a8), account)
        );
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) return abi.decode(data, (bool));

        return false;
    }

    function _staticAddress(address target, bytes4 selector) internal view returns (address out) {
        if (target == address(0)) return address(0);
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = target.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(selector));
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) {
            out = abi.decode(data, (address));
        }
    }

    function _absDiff(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a >= b ? a - b : b - a;
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        if (!ok || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) {
            revert SafeERC20FailedOperation(token);
        }
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        if (!ok || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) {
            revert SafeERC20FailedOperation(token);
        }
    }

    function _nonReentrantBefore() internal {
        if (_reentrancyStatus == 2) revert ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall();
        _reentrancyStatus = 2;
    }

    function _nonReentrantAfter() internal {
        _reentrancyStatus = 1;
    }

    function _checkOwner() internal view {
        if (msg.sender != _owner) revert OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(msg.sender);
    }

    function _checkAuthorized() internal view {
        if (!_isAuthorized(msg.sender)) revert OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(msg.sender);
    }

    function _returnData(bytes memory data) private pure {
        assembly {
            return(add(data, 0x20), mload(data))
        }
    }

        require(signer != address(0), "ECDSA: invalid signature");
        return signer;
    }

        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            assembly {
                revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
            }
        }
        revert(fallbackMessage);
    }

        }

        try IERC1822Proxiable(newImplementation).proxiableUUID() returns (bytes32 slot) {
            require(slot == _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, "ERC1967Upgrade: unsupported proxiableUUID");
        } catch {
            revert("ERC1967Upgrade: new implementation is not UUPS");
        }

        _setImplementation(newImplementation);
        emit Upgraded(newImplementation);

        if (data.length > 0 || forceCall) {
            _functionDelegateCall(newImplementation, data);
        }
    }

    function _functionDelegateCall(address target, bytes memory data) private returns (bytes memory) {
        require(target.code.length > 0, "Address: delegate call to non-contract");
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.delegatecall(data);
        if (!success) {
            _revertWith(returndata, "Address: low-level delegate call failed");
        }
        return returndata;
    }

    function _getBoolean(bytes32 slot) private view returns (bool v) {
        assembly {
            v := sload(slot)
        }
    }

    function _revertWith(bytes memory returndata, string memory fallbackMessage) internal pure {
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            assembly {
                revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
            }
        }
        revert(fallbackMessage);
    }

    function _authorizeUpgrade(address newImplementation) internal virtual;
}

contract LeveragedOUSDCoordinatorUpgradeable is AccessControlLite, ReentrancyGuardLite, UUPSLite {

    bytes32 public constant EXECUTIVE_ROLE = keccak256("EXECUTIVE_ROLE");
    bytes32 public constant AUCTIONEER_ROLE = keccak256("AUCTIONEER_ROLE");
    bytes32 public constant GOVERNOR_ROLE =
        0x7935bd0ae54bc31f548c14dba4d37c5c64b3f8ca900cb468fb8abd54d5894f55;

    address private _positionManager;
    address private _swapper;
    address private _collateralToken;
    address private _treasury;
    address private _coordinator;

    constructor() {
        _disableInitializers();
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        if (msg.sig == bytes4(0x00ede7e4)) {
            require(msg.value == 0, "no value");
            require(msg.data.length == 36, "bad calldata");
            address newAuctioneer;
            assembly {
                newAuctioneer := shr(96, calldataload(4))
            }
            _checkRole(ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
            _setAuctioneer(newAuctioneer);
            return;
        }
        revert("unknown selector");
    }

    function initialize() external initializer {
        __UUPSUpgradeable_init();
        __ReentrancyGuard_init();

        _setRoleAdmin(ADMIN_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(EXECUTIVE_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(AUCTIONEER_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(GOVERNOR_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(GUARDIAN_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);

        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);

        _setGovernor(msg.sender);
        _setExecutive(msg.sender);
        _setGuardian(msg.sender);
        _setAuctioneer(msg.sender);
    }

    function AUCTIONEER() external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return AUCTIONEER_ROLE;
    }

    function setDependencies(
        address lvUSDToken_,
        address vaultOUSDToken_,
        address archimedes_,
        address positionManager_,
        address swapper_,
        address collateralToken_,
        address treasury_,
        address coordinator_
    ) external onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        require(
            lvUSDToken_ != address(0) &&
                vaultOUSDToken_ != address(0) &&
                archimedes_ != address(0) &&
                positionManager_ != address(0) &&
                swapper_ != address(0) &&
                collateralToken_ != address(0) &&
                treasury_ != address(0) &&
                coordinator_ != address(0),
            "cant set to 0 A"
        );

        _lvUSDToken = lvUSDToken_;
        _vaultOUSDToken = vaultOUSDToken_;
        _archimedes = archimedes_;
        _positionManager = positionManager_;
        _swapper = swapper_;
        _collateralToken = collateralToken_;
        _treasury = treasury_;
        _coordinator = coordinator_;

    }

    function setAdmin(address newAdmin) external onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(newAdmin != msg.sender, "new admin must be different");

        require(_pendingAdmin != address(0) && _adminTransferFrom != address(0), "no pending admin");

    function setGovernor(address newGovernor) external onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) {

        _setGuardian(newGuardian);

        return _staticUint(_positionManager, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x0d01a60f), positionId));
    }

    function getOUSDPrinciple(uint256 positionId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _staticUint(_positionManager, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x02c4e2eb), positionId));
    }

    function getAvailableLeverage() public view returns (uint256) {
        require(_coordinator != address(0), "coordinator not set");
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =

        require(ok && data.length >= 32, "coordinator call failed");
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function acceptLeverageAmount(uint256 amount) external onlyRole(AUCTIONEER_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        lastAcceptedLeverage = amount;
        if (_coordinator != address(0)) {
            _callNoReturn(_coordinator, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x32e4cbab), amount));

    }

    function getLeveragedOUSD(uint256 positionId, uint256 leverageAmount) external onlyRole(EXECUTIVE_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        require(leverageAmount > 0, "zero leverage");
        require(leverageAmount <= getAvailableLeverage(), "Leverage more than max allowed");
        _callNoReturn(_positionManager, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xbe724f7b), positionId, leverageAmount));
    }

    function unwindLeveragedOUSD(uint256 positionId, address receiver) external onlyRole(EXECUTIVE_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        _callNoReturn(_positionManager, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x896068a6), positionId));
        if (receiver != address(0) && _lvUSDToken != address(0)) {
            uint256 bal = _readBalance(_lvUSDToken, address(this));
            if (bal > 0) {
                _callOptionalReturn(_lvUSDToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa9059cbb), receiver, bal));
            }
        }
    }

    function repayUnderNFT(uint256 positionId, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(EXECUTIVE_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        _callNoReturn(_positionManager, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xfeabdd5f), positionId, amount));
    }

    function depositCollateralUnderNFT(uint256 positionId, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(EXECUTIVE_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        _callNoReturn(_positionManager, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x26825091), positionId, amount));
    }

    function borrowUnderNFT(uint256 positionId, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(EXECUTIVE_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        _callNoReturn(_positionManager, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xbe724f7b), positionId, amount));
    }

    function resetAndBurnLeverage() external onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        uint256 bal = _readBalance(_collateralToken == address(0) ? _lvUSDToken : _collateralToken, address(this));
        if (bal > 0 && _lvUSDToken != address(0)) {
            _callOptionalReturn(_lvUSDToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x42966c68), bal));
        }
        if (_coordinator != address(0)) {
            _callNoReturn(_coordinator, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x32e4cbab), 0));
        }
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public override {
        require(role != ADMIN_ROLE, "Admin cant use renounceRole");
        require(account == msg.sender, "can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external onlyProxy onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) {
        _authorizeUpgrade(newImplementation);
        _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(newImplementation, bytes(""), false);
    }

    function upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes calldata data)
        external
        payable
        onlyProxy
        onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE)
    {
        _authorizeUpgrade(newImplementation);
        _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(newImplementation, data, true);
    }

    function _authorizeUpgrade(address) internal view override onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) {}

    function _setGovernor(address newGovernor) internal {
        require(newGovernor != address(0), "cant set to 0 A");
        require(newGovernor != _governor, "New gov must be different");
        address old = _governor;
        _governor = newGovernor;
        _grantRole(GOVERNOR_ROLE, newGovernor);
        if (old != address(0)) _revokeRole(GOVERNOR_ROLE, old);
    }

    function _setGuardian(address newGuardian) internal {
        require(newGuardian != address(0), "cant set to 0 A");
        require(newGuardian != _guardian, "New guardian must be different");
        address old = _guardian;
        _guardian = newGuardian;
        _grantRole(GUARDIAN_ROLE, newGuardian);
        if (old != address(0)) _revokeRole(GUARDIAN_ROLE, old);
    }

    function _setExecutive(address newExecutive) internal {
        require(newExecutive != address(0), "cant set to 0 A");
        require(newExecutive != _executive, "New exec must be different");
        address old = _executive;
        _executive = newExecutive;
        _grantRole(EXECUTIVE_ROLE, newExecutive);
        if (old != address(0)) _revokeRole(EXECUTIVE_ROLE, old);
    }

    function _setAuctioneer(address newAuctioneer) internal {
        require(newAuctioneer != address(0), "cant set to 0 A");
        require(newAuctioneer != _auctioneer, "New Auctioneer must be diff");
        address old = _auctioneer;
        _auctioneer = newAuctioneer;
        _grantRole(AUCTIONEER_ROLE, newAuctioneer);
        if (old != address(0)) _revokeRole(AUCTIONEER_ROLE, old);
    }

    function _staticUint(address target, bytes memory data) internal view returns (uint256) {
        require(target != address(0), "dependency not set");
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = target.staticcall(data);
        require(ok && ret.length >= 32, "staticcall failed");
        return abi.decode(ret, (uint256));
    }

    function _callNoReturn(address target, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(target != address(0), "dependency not set");
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = target.call(data);
        if (!ok) _revertWith(ret, "low-level call failed");
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(token != address(0), "token not set");
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(data);
        if (!ok) _revertWith(ret, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (ret.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }

    function _forceApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 value) internal {
        if (token == address(0) || spender == address(0)) return;
        uint256 current = _readAllowance(token, address(this), spender);
        if (current != 0 && value != 0) {
            _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x095ea7b3), spender, 0));
        }
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x095ea7b3), spender, value));
    }

    function _readAllowance(address token, address owner, address spender) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (token == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xdd62ed3e), owner, spender));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _readBalance(address token, address owner) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (token == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x70a08231), owner));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }
}

        if (_balances[msg.sender][asset] == 0 && _useAsCollateral[msg.sender][asset]) {
            _setUserCollateral(msg.sender, asset, false);
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(asset, msg.sender);
        }

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Withdraw(asset, msg.sender, to, amountToWithdraw);
        return amountToWithdraw;
    }

    function borrow(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 interestRateMode,
        uint16 referralCode,
        address onBehalfOf
    ) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(amount > 0, "INVALID_AMOUNT");
        require(interestRateMode == 1 || interestRateMode == 2, "INVALID_RATE_MODE");
        _requireNotBlacklisted(msg.sender);
        _requireNotBlacklisted(onBehalfOf);

        if (interestRateMode == 1) {
            _stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] = _stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset].add(amount);
        } else {
            _variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] = _variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset].add(amount);
        }

        _setUserBorrowing(onBehalfOf, asset, true);
        _safeTransfer(asset, msg.sender, amount);

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Borrow(asset, msg.sender, onBehalfOf, amount, interestRateMode, 0, referralCode);
    }

    function repay(address asset, uint256 amount, uint256 rateMode, address onBehalfOf) external whenNotPaused returns (uint256) {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(rateMode == 1 || rateMode == 2, "INVALID_RATE_MODE");
        _requireNotBlacklisted(msg.sender);
        _requireNotBlacklisted(onBehalfOf);

        uint256 debt = rateMode == 1 ? _stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] : _variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset];
        require(debt > 0, "NO_DEBT");

        uint256 payback = amount == uint256(-1) ? debt : _min(amount, debt);
        _safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), payback);

        if (rateMode == 1) {
            _stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] = debt.sub(payback);
        } else {
            _variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] = debt.sub(payback);
        }

        if (_stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset].add(_variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset]) == 0) {
            _setUserBorrowing(onBehalfOf, asset, false);
        }

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Repay(asset, onBehalfOf, msg.sender, payback);
        return payback;
    }

    function swapBorrowRateMode(address asset, uint256 rateMode) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(rateMode == 1 || rateMode == 2, "INVALID_RATE_MODE");

        uint256 stableDebt = _stableDebts[msg.sender][asset];
        uint256 variableDebt = _variableDebts[msg.sender][asset];
        require(stableDebt > 0 || variableDebt > 0, "NO_DEBT");

        if (rateMode == 1) {
            require(variableDebt > 0, "NO_VARIABLE_DEBT");
            _variableDebts[msg.sender][asset] = 0;
            _stableDebts[msg.sender][asset] = _stableDebts[msg.sender][asset].add(variableDebt);
        } else {
            require(stableDebt > 0, "NO_STABLE_DEBT");
            _stableDebts[msg.sender][asset] = 0;
            _variableDebts[msg.sender][asset] = _variableDebts[msg.sender][asset].add(stableDebt);
        }

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Swap(asset, msg.sender, rateMode);
    }

    function setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(address asset, bool useAsCollateral) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        _requireNotBlacklisted(msg.sender);

        if (useAsCollateral) {
            require(_balances[msg.sender][asset] > 0, "NO_DEPOSIT");
        }

        bool current = _useAsCollateral[msg.sender][asset];
        if (current == useAsCollateral) return;

        _setUserCollateral(msg.sender, asset, useAsCollateral);
        if (useAsCollateral) emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(asset, msg.sender);
        else emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(asset, msg.sender);
    }

    function rebalanceStableBorrowRate(address asset, address user) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(_stableDebts[user][asset] > 0, "NO_STABLE_DEBT");
        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit RebalanceStableBorrowRate(asset, user);
    }

    function finalizeTransfer(
        address asset,
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 balanceFromBefore,
        uint256 balanceToBefore
    ) external whenNotPaused {
        ReserveData storage r = _reserves[asset];
        require(r.initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(msg.sender == r.aTokenAddress, "CALLER_MUST_BE_ATOKEN");

        if (from != address(0)) {
            require(_balances[from][asset] == balanceFromBefore, "FROM_BALANCE_MISMATCH");
        }
        if (to != address(0)) {
            require(_balances[to][asset] == balanceToBefore, "TO_BALANCE_MISMATCH");
        }

        if (from != to && amount > 0) {
            if (from != address(0)) {
                _balances[from][asset] = _balances[from][asset].sub(amount);
            }
            if (to != address(0)) {
                _balances[to][asset] = _balances[to][asset].add(amount);
            }
        }

        if (from != address(0) && _balances[from][asset] == 0 && _useAsCollateral[from][asset]) {
            _setUserCollateral(from, asset, false);
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(asset, from);
        }

        if (to != address(0) && _balances[to][asset] > 0 && !_useAsCollateral[to][asset]) {
            _setUserCollateral(to, asset, true);
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(asset, to);
        }
    }

    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        bytes calldata params,
        uint16 referralCode
    ) external whenNotPaused {
        require(receiverAddress != address(0), "INVALID_RECEIVER");
        require(assets.length == amounts.length, "INCONSISTENT_PARAMS");

        uint256[] memory premiums = new uint256[](assets.length);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            require(_reserves[assets[i]].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
            premiums[i] = amounts[i].mul(FLASHLOAN_PREMIUM_TOTAL).div(10000);
            _safeTransfer(assets[i], receiverAddress, amounts[i]);
        }

        bool ok = IFlashLoanReceiver(receiverAddress).executeOperation(assets, amounts, premiums, msg.sender, params);
        require(ok, "INVALID_FLASHLOAN_EXECUTOR_RETURN");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            uint256 amountPlusPremium = amounts[i].add(premiums[i]);
            _safeTransferFrom(assets[i], receiverAddress, address(this), amountPlusPremium);
            emit FlashLoan(receiverAddress, msg.sender, assets[i], amounts[i], premiums[i], referralCode);
            _touchReserve(assets[i]);
        }
    }

    function liquidationCall(
        address collateralAsset,
        address debtAsset,
        address user,
        uint256 debtToCover,
        bool receiveAToken
    ) external whenNotPaused {
        _requireNotBlacklisted(user);

        address collateralManager = _getCollateralManager();
        require(collateralManager != address(0) && _isContract(collateralManager), "Address: call to non-contract");

        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = collateralManager.delegatecall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(
                bytes4(0x00a718a9),
                collateralAsset,
                debtAsset,
                user,
                debtToCover,
                receiveAToken
            )
        );

        if (!success) {
            if (returndata.length > 0) {
                assembly {
                    revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
                }
            }
            revert("LIQUIDATION_CALL_FAILED");
        }
    }

    function repayAllAndBlacklist(address user) external whenNotPaused {
        require(user != address(0), "INVALID_USER");
        address cfg = _getConfigurator();
        require(msg.sender == user || msg.sender == cfg, "NOT_AUTHORIZED");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _reservesList.length; i++) {
            address asset = _reservesList[i];
            _stableDebts[user][asset] = 0;
            _variableDebts[user][asset] = 0;
            _setUserBorrowing(user, asset, false);
        }

        _blacklisted[user] = true;
        emit Blacklist(user);
    }

    function _setUserCollateral(address user, address asset, bool value) internal {
        _useAsCollateral[user][asset] = value;
        uint256 bit = uint256(_reserves[asset].id).mul(2);
        _setUserConfigBit(user, bit, value);
    }

    function _setUserBorrowing(address user, address asset, bool value) internal {
        uint256 bit = uint256(_reserves[asset].id).mul(2).add(1);
        _setUserConfigBit(user, bit, value);
    }

    function _setUserConfigBit(address user, uint256 bit, bool value) internal {
        uint256 mask = uint256(1) << bit;
        if (value) {
            _userConfigurationData[user] = _userConfigurationData[user] | mask;
        } else {
            _userConfigurationData[user] = _userConfigurationData[user] & (~mask);
        }
    }

    function _touchReserve(address asset) internal {
        _reserves[asset].lastUpdateTimestamp = uint40(block.timestamp);
        _emitReserveDataUpdated(asset);
    }

    function _emitReserveDataUpdated(address asset) internal {
        ReserveData storage r = _reserves[asset];
        emit ReserveDataUpdated(
            asset,
            uint256(r.currentLiquidityRate),
            uint256(r.currentStableBorrowRate),
            uint256(r.currentVariableBorrowRate),
            uint256(r.liquidityIndex),
            uint256(r.variableBorrowIndex)
        );
    }

    function _getConfigurator() internal view returns (address cfg) {
        if (_addressesProvider == address(0)) return address(0);
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = _addressesProvider.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x85c858b1)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return address(0);
        cfg = abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _getCollateralManager() internal view returns (address cm) {
        if (_addressesProvider == address(0)) return address(0);
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = _addressesProvider.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x712d9171)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return address(0);
        cm = abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _getAssetPrice(address asset) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_addressesProvider == address(0)) return 1e18;

        (bool okProvider, bytes memory dataProvider) = _addressesProvider.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xfca513a8)));
        if (!okProvider || dataProvider.length < 32) return 1e18;

        address oracle = abi.decode(dataProvider, (address));
        if (oracle == address(0) || !_isContract(oracle)) return 1e18;

        (bool okOracle, bytes memory dataOracle) = oracle.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xb3596f07), asset));
        if (!okOracle || dataOracle.length < 32) return 1e18;

        return abi.decode(dataOracle, (uint256));
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa9059cbb), to, value));
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x23b872dd), from, to, value));
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(_isContract(token), "Address: call to non-contract");
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = token.call(data);
        require(success, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }

    function _requireNotBlacklisted(address user) internal view {
        require(!_blacklisted[user], "BLACKLISTED");
    }

    function _isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly {
            size := extcodesize(account)
        }
        return size > 0;
    }

    function _min(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a < b ? a : b;
    }
}

            emergencyWithdrawalUnlockTime = block.timestamp + DEFAULT_DELAY;

        if (block.timestamp < emergencyWithdrawalUnlockTime) revert DelayNotElapsed();

        } else {

        address recipient = protocolWallet;
        if (asset == address(0)) {
            _sendNative(recipient, amount);
        } else {
            _safeTransfer(asset, recipient, amount);
        }

        emit EmergencyWithdraw(asset, amount, recipient);

        if (newWallet == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress();

        if (_pendingProtocolWallet != newWallet) {
            _pendingProtocolWallet = newWallet;
            protocolWalletUpdateTime = block.timestamp + DEFAULT_DELAY;
            return;
        }

        if (block.timestamp < protocolWalletUpdateTime) revert DelayNotElapsed();

        address oldWallet = protocolWallet;
        protocolWallet = _pendingProtocolWallet;
        _pendingProtocolWallet = address(0);
        protocolWalletUpdateTime = 0;

    }

    function _buyWithUSD(address beneficiary, uint256 usdValue) internal {
        if (usdValue < MIN_PURCHASE_USD || usdValue > MAX_PURCHASE_USD) revert InvalidAmount();
        if (_stages.length == 0) revert NoActiveStage();

        uint256 usdRemaining = usdValue;
        uint256 i = currentStage;

        while (usdRemaining > 0 && i < _stages.length) {
            Stage storage s = _stages[i];

            if (block.timestamp > s.endTime || s.tokensSold >= s.tokensAvailable) {
                unchecked {
                    ++i;
                }
                continue;
            }

            uint256 stageRemaining = s.tokensAvailable - s.tokensSold;
            uint256 tokensWanted = (usdRemaining * 1e18) / s.priceUsd;
            if (tokensWanted == 0) break;

            uint256 tokensToBuy = tokensWanted > stageRemaining ? stageRemaining : tokensWanted;
            uint256 usdUsed = (tokensToBuy * s.priceUsd) / 1e18;
            if (usdUsed == 0) break;

            s.tokensSold += tokensToBuy;
            _userStageTokens[beneficiary][i] += tokensToBuy;
            _userTotalTokens[beneficiary] += tokensToBuy;

            totalTokensSold += tokensToBuy;
            totalSoldInUSD += usdUsed;

            usdRemaining -= usdUsed;

            if (s.tokensSold == s.tokensAvailable) {
                unchecked {
                    ++i;
                }
            }
        }

        currentStage = i;
        if (usdRemaining != 0) revert NoActiveStage();
        if (totalTokensSold > MAX_TOKENS_FOR_SALE) revert InvalidAmount();
    }

    function _preDepositChecks(address beneficiary) internal view {
        if (beneficiary == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress();
        if (blacklisted[msg.sender]) revert AccountBlacklisted(msg.sender);
        if (blacklisted[beneficiary]) revert AccountBlacklisted(beneficiary);
    }

    function _readPriceData() internal view returns (uint80 roundId, int256 answer, uint256 updatedAt, uint80 answeredInRound) {
        (roundId, answer, , updatedAt, answeredInRound) = IAggregatorV3(priceFeed).latestRoundData();
        if (answer <= 0) revert InvalidPriceFeedValue();
        if (updatedAt == 0) revert RoundNotComplete();
        if (answeredInRound < roundId) revert RoundNotComplete();
        if (block.timestamp > updatedAt + heartbeat) revert StalePrice();
    }

    function _tokenAmountToUSD(address token, uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint8 d = 6;
        try IERC20Minimal(token).decimals() returns (uint8 dec) {
            d = dec;
        } catch {}
        if (d > 77) revert InvalidAmount();
        uint256 unit = 10 ** uint256(d);
        return (amount * PRICE_PRECISION) / unit;
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        if (!success || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) {
            revert SafeTransferFailed();
        }
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        if (!success || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) {
            revert SafeTransferFromFailed();
        }
    }

    function _sendNative(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        if (!ok) revert SafeTransferFailed();
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

        }

        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");
        _totalSupply += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: burn from the zero address");

        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "ERC20: burn amount exceeds balance");

        unchecked {
            _balances[from] = bal - amount;
            _totalSupply -= amount;
        }

        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
    }

        require(holder != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");

        emit Approval(holder, spender, amount);
    }

    function _spendAllowance(address holder, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 current = _allowances[holder][spender];
        if (current != type(uint256).max) {
            require(current >= amount, "ERC20: insufficient allowance");
            unchecked {

            }
            emit Approval(holder, spender, _allowances[holder][spender]);
        }
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, amount));
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount));
    }

    function _safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector, spender, amount));
    }

    function _forceApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 current = IERC20(token).allowance(address(this), spender);
        if (current != 0 && amount != 0) {
            _safeApprove(token, spender, 0);
        }
        _safeApprove(token, spender, amount);
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(token.code.length > 0, "Address: call to non-contract");

        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = token.call(data);
        if (!success) {
            if (returndata.length > 0) {
                assembly {
                    revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
                }
            }
            revert("SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        }

        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC20Minimal {
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
    function balanceOf(address) external view returns (uint256);
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);
}

interface IERC721Like {
    function balanceOf(address owner) external view returns (uint256);
    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address);
    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address);
    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) external view returns (bool);
    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256);
}

interface IVestingCurve {
    function getVestedPayoutAtTime(
        uint256 payout,
        uint256 vestingStart,
        uint256 vestingTerm,
        uint256 timestamp
    ) external view returns (uint256);
}

contract BillVestingCurveV220 {
    function getVestedPayoutAtTime(
        uint256 payout,
        uint256 vestingStart,
        uint256 vestingTerm,
        uint256 timestamp
    ) external pure returns (uint256) {
        if (timestamp <= vestingStart) return 0;
        if (vestingTerm == 0) return payout;
        uint256 elapsed = timestamp - vestingStart;
        if (elapsed >= vestingTerm) return payout;
        return (payout * elapsed) / vestingTerm;
    }
}

contract BillBrokerV220 {
    uint256 public constant MAX_FEE = 1_000_000;
    string public constant VERSION = "2.2.0";

    bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x164eb3c8934b38dc6d928ee073001889e55e5906e6d507f75a52c9f3fe10f75c;

    bytes32 public constant BILLING_ROLE = 0xc73a27fbb8feb318a8925ab6a4b4df16b973580518358aeb6d83627615c8ce71;
    bytes32 public constant CLAIM_APPROVER_ROLE = 0xcb4ffdad14a53b69e7cebbe49af38e6fe640276b71655d8d7d9f0927b6977a47;

    struct Terms {
        uint256 controlVariable;
        uint256 vestingTerm;
        uint256 minimumPrice;
        uint256 maxPayout;
        uint256 fee;
        uint256 maxTotalPayout;
        uint256 initialDebt;
    }

        uint256 principalPaid;
        uint256 payout;
        uint256 claimed;
        uint256 vestingStart;
        uint256 vestingTerm;
        uint256 createdAt;
        uint256 lastClaimAt;
    }

        address payoutToken;
        address principalToken;
        address customTreasury;
        address billNft;
        uint256[] feeTiers;
        uint256[] fees;

        address feeTo;
        address operations;
        address vestingCurve;
    }

    event BillCreated(uint256 indexed billId, uint256 principal, uint256 payout, uint256 fee);
    event BillClaimed(uint256 indexed billId, address indexed recipient, uint256 payout, uint256 totalClaimed);
    event BillRefilled(address indexed from, uint256 amount);

    event TermsSet(uint8 indexed parameter, uint256 input);
    event SetFees(uint256[] tiers, uint256[] fees);
    event MaxTotalPayoutChanged(uint256 value);
    event FeeToChanged(address indexed feeTo);

    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);

    address private _owner;
    bool private _paused;
    bool private _initialized;

    address private _payoutToken;
    address private _principalToken;
    address private _customTreasury;
    address private _billNft;
    address private _feeTo;
    address private _vestingCurve;

    uint256[] private _feeTierThresholds;
    uint256[] private _feeTierValues;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _billOwner;
    mapping(uint256 => bool) private _billClosed;
    mapping(address => uint256[]) private _userBills;
    uint256[] private _allIssuedBillIds;
    uint256 private _nextBillId = 1;

    uint256 private _totalPrincipalBilled;
    uint256 private _totalPayoutGiven;
    uint256 private _totalDebt;
    uint256 private _lastDecay;

    bool private _feeInPayout;
    uint256 private _vestingAdjustment;
    uint256 private _updateInterval;

    Terms private _terms;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _claimApproval;

    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool)) private _roles;
    mapping(bytes32 => bytes32) private _roleAdmins;
    mapping(bytes32 => address[]) private _roleMembers;
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _roleIndexPlusOne;

        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

        require(msg.sender == _owner || hasRole(BILLING_ROLE, msg.sender), "Caller is not owner or has required role");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _;

        _status = 2;
        _;

        _status = 1;
        _setRoleAdmin(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(OPERATIONS_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(BILLING_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(CLAIM_APPROVER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);

    function initialize(
        address initialOwner,
        InitAddressConfig calldata cfg,
        Terms calldata t,
        InitRoles calldata r,
        address[] calldata adminAccounts
    ) external initializer {
        require(initialOwner != address(0), "owner cannot be zero");
        require(cfg.payoutToken != address(0), "payoutToken cannot be zero");
        require(cfg.principalToken != address(0), "principalToken cannot be zero");
        require(cfg.billNft != address(0), "billNft cannot be zero");
        require(r.feeTo != address(0), "feeTo cannot be zero");

        _owner = initialOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), initialOwner);

        _payoutToken = cfg.payoutToken;
        _principalToken = cfg.principalToken;
        _customTreasury = cfg.customTreasury;
        _billNft = cfg.billNft;
        _feeTo = r.feeTo;
        _feeInPayout = cfg.feeInPayout;

        _terms = t;
        _totalDebt = t.initialDebt;
        _lastDecay = block.timestamp;
        _vestingAdjustment = block.timestamp;
        _updateInterval = 1 hours;

        if (r.vestingCurve == address(0)) {
            _vestingCurve = address(new BillVestingCurveV220());
        } else {
            _vestingCurve = r.vestingCurve;
        }

        _setFeeTiers(cfg.feeTiers, cfg.fees);

        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, initialOwner);
        _grantRole(BILLING_ROLE, initialOwner);

        if (r.operations != address(0)) {
            _grantRole(OPERATIONS_ROLE, r.operations);
            _grantRole(BILLING_ROLE, r.operations);
        }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < adminAccounts.length; i++) {
            if (adminAccounts[i] != address(0)) {
                _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, adminAccounts[i]);
            }
        }

        emit BillInitialized(_terms, block.timestamp);
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || interfaceId == 0x7965db0b || interfaceId == 0x5a05180f;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

        require(
            msg.sender == _owner || hasRole(OPERATIONS_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender),
            "Caller is not owner or has required role"
        );
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _paused = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

        require(_paused, "Pausable: not paused");
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);

        return _paused;
    }

        return _payoutToken;
    }
