        return _principalToken;
    }

    function customTreasury() external view returns (address) {
        return _customTreasury;
    }

    function billNft() external view returns (address) {
        return _billNft;
    }

    function vestingCurve() external view returns (address) {
        return _vestingCurve;
    }

    function feeInPayout() external view returns (bool) {
        return _feeInPayout;
    }

    function terms()
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 controlVariable,
            uint256 vestingTerm,
            uint256 minimumPrice,
            uint256 maxPayout_,
            uint256 fee,
            uint256 maxTotalPayout_,
            uint256 initialDebt
        )
    {
        Terms memory t = _terms;
        return (
            t.controlVariable,
            t.vestingTerm,
            t.minimumPrice,
            t.maxPayout,
            t.fee,
            t.maxTotalPayout,
            t.initialDebt
        );
    }

    function totalPrincipalBilled() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalPrincipalBilled;
    }

    function totalPayoutGiven() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalPayoutGiven;
    }

    function totalDebt() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalDebt;
    }

    function lastDecay() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lastDecay;
    }

    function getMaxTotalPayout() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _terms.maxTotalPayout;
    }

    function maxPayout() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _terms.maxPayout;
    }

    function currentDebt() public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 decay = debtDecay();
        return _totalDebt > decay ? _totalDebt - decay : 0;
    }

    function debtDecay() public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_terms.vestingTerm == 0) return 0;
        if (block.timestamp <= _lastDecay) return 0;
        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - _lastDecay;
        uint256 decay = (_totalDebt * elapsed) / _terms.vestingTerm;
        if (decay > _totalDebt) decay = _totalDebt;
        return decay;
    }

    function debtRatio() public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_payoutToken == address(0)) return 0;
        try IERC20Minimal(_payoutToken).totalSupply() returns (uint256 supply) {
            if (supply == 0) return 0;
            return (currentDebt() * 1e18) / supply;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function billPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 price = (_terms.controlVariable * debtRatio()) / 1e18;
        if (price < _terms.minimumPrice) price = _terms.minimumPrice;
        return price;
    }

    function currentFee() public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_feeTierThresholds.length == 0) {
            return _terms.fee;
        }
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _feeTierThresholds.length; i++) {
            if (_totalPrincipalBilled <= _feeTierThresholds[i]) {
                return _feeTierValues[i];
            }
        }
        return _feeTierValues[_feeTierValues.length - 1];
    }

    function trueBillPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 fee = currentFee();
        if (fee >= MAX_FEE) return type(uint256).max;
        return (billPrice() * MAX_FEE) / (MAX_FEE - fee);
    }

    function payoutFor(uint256 principalAmount) public view returns (uint256 payout, uint256 fee) {
        uint256 price = trueBillPrice();
        if (price == 0 || price == type(uint256).max) {
            return (0, 0);
        }
        uint256 gross = (principalAmount * 1e18) / price;
        fee = (gross * currentFee()) / MAX_FEE;
        payout = _feeInPayout ? (gross - fee) : gross;
    }

    function pendingPayout(uint256 billId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return claimablePayout(billId);
    }

    function claimablePayout(uint256 billId) public view returns (uint256) {
        Bill storage b = _bills[billId];
        if (b.payout == 0 || _billClosed[billId]) return 0;
        uint256 vested = _vestedPayoutAtTime(b, block.timestamp);
        if (vested > b.payout) vested = b.payout;
        return vested > b.claimed ? vested - b.claimed : 0;
    }

    function pendingVesting(uint256 billId) external view returns (uint256) {
        Bill storage b = _bills[billId];
        if (b.payout == 0 || _billClosed[billId]) return 0;
        uint256 end = b.vestingStart + b.vestingTerm;
        if (block.timestamp >= end) return 0;
        return end - block.timestamp;
    }

    function vestingPeriod(uint256 billId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _bills[billId].vestingTerm;
    }

    function vestedPayoutAtTime(uint256 billId, uint256 timestamp) public view returns (uint256) {
        Bill storage b = _bills[billId];
        return _vestedPayoutAtTime(b, timestamp);
    }

    function vestingPayout(uint256 billId) external view returns (uint256) {
        Bill storage b = _bills[billId];
        return _vestedPayoutAtTime(b, block.timestamp);
    }

    function getVestedPayoutAtTime(
        uint256 payout,
        uint256 vestingStart,
        uint256 vestingTerm,
        uint256 timestamp
    ) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return _linearVested(payout, vestingStart, vestingTerm, timestamp);
    }

    function setClaimApproval(address account, bool approved) external {
        _claimApproval[msg.sender][account] = approved;
        emit UpdateClaimApproval(msg.sender, account, approved);
    }

    function redeemerApproved(address account, address redeemer) external view returns (bool) {
        return _claimApproval[account][redeemer];
    }

    function setFeeTiers(uint256[] calldata tiers, uint256[] calldata fees) external onlyOwnerOrBilling {
        _setFeeTiers(tiers, fees);
        emit SetFees(tiers, fees);
    }

    function getFeeTierLength() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _feeTierThresholds.length;
    }

    function feeTiers(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256 tier, uint256 fee) {
        require(index < _feeTierThresholds.length, "feeTier mismatch");
        return (_feeTierThresholds[index], _feeTierValues[index]);
    }

    function setBondTerms(uint8 parameter, uint256 input) external onlyOwner {
        if (parameter == 0) {
            require(input >= 36 hours, "Vesting must be >= 36 hours");
            _terms.vestingTerm = input;
        } else if (parameter == 1) {
            _terms.maxPayout = input;
        } else if (parameter == 2) {
            require(input <= MAX_FEE, "Invalid fee");
            _terms.fee = input;
        } else if (parameter == 3) {
            _terms.minimumPrice = input;
        } else if (parameter == 4) {
            require(input >= _totalPayoutGiven, "maxTotalPayout cannot be below totalPayoutGiven");
            _terms.maxTotalPayout = input;
            emit MaxTotalPayoutChanged(input);
        } else {
            revert("invalid parameter");
        }
        emit TermsSet(parameter, input);
    }

    function setBCV(uint256 value) external onlyOwnerOrBilling {
        uint256 oldP = billPrice();
        _terms.controlVariable = value;
        emit TermsSet(0, value);
        emit BillPriceChanged(oldP, billPrice());
    }

    function setMinPrice(uint256 value) external onlyOwnerOrBilling {
        uint256 oldP = billPrice();
        _terms.minimumPrice = value;
        emit TermsSet(3, value);
        emit BillPriceChanged(oldP, billPrice());
    }

    function setMaxTotalPayout(uint256 value) external onlyOwnerOrBilling {
        require(value >= _totalPayoutGiven, "maxTotalPayout <= totalPayout");
        _terms.maxTotalPayout = value;
        emit MaxTotalPayoutChanged(value);
    }

    function changeFeeTo(address newFeeTo) external onlyOwner {
        require(newFeeTo != address(0), "Cannot be address(0)");
        _feeTo = newFeeTo;
        emit FeeToChanged(newFeeTo);
    }

    function refillPayoutToken(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant onlyOwnerOrBilling {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount is 0");
        _safeTransferFrom(_payoutToken, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        _terms.maxTotalPayout += amount;
        emit BillRefilled(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function transferStuckToken(address token, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(token != address(0), "Invalid address");
        _safeTransfer(token, _owner, amount);
    }

    function deposit(uint256 principalAmount, uint256 maxPrice, address depositor)
        external
        nonReentrant
        whenNotPaused
        returns (uint256 billId)
    {
        require(depositor != address(0), "Invalid address");
        require(depositor == msg.sender || msg.sender.code.length > 0, "no deposits to other address");
        require(principalAmount > 0, "Amount is 0");

        _decayDebt();

        uint256 price = trueBillPrice();
        require(price <= maxPrice, "Slippage more than max price");

        (uint256 payout, uint256 fee) = payoutFor(principalAmount);
        require(payout > 0, "Bill too small");
        require(payout <= _terms.maxPayout, "Bill too large");
        require(_totalPayoutGiven + payout <= _terms.maxTotalPayout, "Max total payout exceeded");

        _safeTransferFrom(_principalToken, msg.sender, address(this), principalAmount);
        if (_customTreasury != address(0)) {
            _safeTransfer(_principalToken, _customTreasury, principalAmount);
        }

        billId = _nextBillId++;
        Bill storage b = _bills[billId];
        b.principalPaid = principalAmount;
        b.payout = payout;
        b.claimed = 0;
        b.vestingStart = block.timestamp;
        b.vestingTerm = _terms.vestingTerm;
        b.createdAt = block.timestamp;
        b.lastClaimAt = block.timestamp;

        _billOwner[billId] = depositor;
        _userBills[depositor].push(billId);
        _allIssuedBillIds.push(billId);

        _totalPrincipalBilled += principalAmount;
        _totalPayoutGiven += payout;
        _totalDebt += payout;
        _lastDecay = block.timestamp;

        if (!_feeInPayout && fee > 0 && _feeTo != address(0)) {
            if (IERC20Minimal(_payoutToken).balanceOf(address(this)) >= fee) {
                _safeTransfer(_payoutToken, _feeTo, fee);
            }
        }

        emit BillCreated(billId, principalAmount, payout, fee);
    }

    function claim(uint256 billId) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (uint256 payout) {
        payout = _claimCore(billId);
    }

    function redeem(uint256 billId) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (uint256 payout) {
        payout = _claimCore(billId);
    }

    function batchClaim(uint256[] calldata billIds) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (uint256 totalPayout) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < billIds.length; i++) {
            totalPayout += _claimCore(billIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function batchRedeem(uint256[] calldata billIds) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (uint256 totalPayout) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < billIds.length; i++) {
            totalPayout += _claimCore(billIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function billInfo(uint256 billId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 principalPaid,
            uint256 payout,
            uint256 claimed,
            uint256 vestingStart,
            uint256 vestingTerm,
            uint256 createdAt,
            uint256 lastClaimAt
        )
    {
        Bill storage b = _bills[billId];
        return (b.principalPaid, b.payout, b.claimed, b.vestingStart, b.vestingTerm, b.createdAt, b.lastClaimAt);
    }

    function getBillInfo(uint256 billId)
        external
        view
        returns (Bill memory bill, address billOwner_, bool closed, uint256 claimable)
    {
        bill = _bills[billId];
        billOwner_ = _billHolder(billId);
        closed = _billClosed[billId];
        claimable = claimablePayout(billId);
    }

    function allIssuedBillIds() external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _allIssuedBillIds;
    }

    function getBillIds(address account) public view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        if (_billNft != address(0)) {
            try IERC721Like(_billNft).balanceOf(account) returns (uint256 bal) {
                uint256[] memory tmp = new uint256[](bal);
                uint256 n;
                for (uint256 i = 0; i < bal; i++) {
                    try IERC721Like(_billNft).tokenOfOwnerByIndex(account, i) returns (uint256 id) {
                        if (!_billClosed[id]) {
                            tmp[n] = id;
                            n++;
                        }
                    } catch {}
                }
                uint256[] memory out = new uint256[](n);
                for (uint256 j = 0; j < n; j++) out[j] = tmp[j];
                return out;
            } catch {}
        }

        uint256[] storage src = _userBills[account];
        uint256[] memory tmp2 = new uint256[](src.length);
        uint256 m;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            uint256 id2 = src[i];
            if (!_billClosed[id2]) {
                tmp2[m] = id2;
                m++;
            }
        }
        uint256[] memory out2 = new uint256[](m);
        for (uint256 j2 = 0; j2 < m; j2++) out2[j2] = tmp2[j2];
        return out2;
    }

    function userBillIds() external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return getBillIds(msg.sender);
    }

    function getBillIdsInRange(address account, uint256 start, uint256 end) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256[] memory ids = getBillIds(account);
        require(start <= end, "invalid range");
        if (end > ids.length) end = ids.length;
        require(start <= end, "invalid range");
        uint256[] memory out = new uint256[](end - start);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
            out[i] = ids[start + i];
        }
        return out;
    }

    function getRoleMemberCount(bytes32 role) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _roleMembers[role].length;
    }

    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return _roleMembers[role][index];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 admin = _roleAdmins[role];
        return admin == bytes32(0) ? DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE : admin;
    }

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role][account];
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(msg.sender == _owner || hasRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender), "Caller is not owner or has required role");
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(msg.sender == _owner || hasRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender), "Caller is not owner or has required role");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function _claimCore(uint256 billId) internal returns (uint256 payout) {
        require(!_billClosed[billId], "Bill is disabled");
        Bill storage b = _bills[billId];
        require(b.payout > 0, "not a valid bill id");

        address holder = _billHolder(billId);
        require(holder != address(0), "not a valid bill id");
        require(_canClaimBill(billId, holder, msg.sender), "not approved");

        uint256 vested = _vestedPayoutAtTime(b, block.timestamp);
        if (vested > b.payout) vested = b.payout;
        require(vested > b.claimed, "nothing to claim");

        payout = vested - b.claimed;
        b.claimed = vested;
        b.lastClaimAt = block.timestamp;
        if (b.claimed >= b.payout) {
            _billClosed[billId] = true;
        }

        _safeTransfer(_payoutToken, holder, payout);
        emit BillClaimed(billId, holder, payout, b.claimed);
    }

    function _vestedPayoutAtTime(Bill storage b, uint256 timestamp) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_vestingCurve != address(0)) {
            try IVestingCurve(_vestingCurve).getVestedPayoutAtTime(
                b.payout,
                b.vestingStart,
                b.vestingTerm,
                timestamp
            ) returns (uint256 v) {
                return v > b.payout ? b.payout : v;
            } catch {}
        }
        return _linearVested(b.payout, b.vestingStart, b.vestingTerm, timestamp);
    }

    function _linearVested(
        uint256 payout,
        uint256 vestingStart,
        uint256 vestingTerm,
        uint256 timestamp
    ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (timestamp <= vestingStart) return 0;
        if (vestingTerm == 0) return payout;
        uint256 elapsed = timestamp - vestingStart;
        if (elapsed >= vestingTerm) return payout;
        return (payout * elapsed) / vestingTerm;
    }

    function _decayDebt() internal {
        uint256 decay = debtDecay();
        if (decay >= _totalDebt) {
            _totalDebt = 0;
        } else {
            _totalDebt -= decay;
        }
        _lastDecay = block.timestamp;
    }

    function _billHolder(uint256 billId) internal view returns (address) {
        if (_billNft != address(0)) {
            try IERC721Like(_billNft).ownerOf(billId) returns (address nftOwner) {
                if (nftOwner != address(0)) return nftOwner;
            } catch {}
        }
        return _billOwner[billId];
    }

    function _canClaimBill(uint256 billId, address holder, address caller) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (caller == holder) return true;
        if (_claimApproval[holder][caller]) return true;
        if (caller == _owner || hasRole(OPERATIONS_ROLE, caller) || hasRole(BILLING_ROLE, caller) || hasRole(CLAIM_APPROVER_ROLE, caller)) {
            return true;
        }

        if (_billNft != address(0)) {
            try IERC721Like(_billNft).ownerOf(billId) returns (address nftOwner) {
                if (nftOwner == caller) return true;
                try IERC721Like(_billNft).getApproved(billId) returns (address approved) {
                    if (approved == caller) return true;
                } catch {}
                try IERC721Like(_billNft).isApprovedForAll(nftOwner, caller) returns (bool ok) {
                    if (ok) return true;
                } catch {}
            } catch {}
        }

        return false;
    }

    function _setFeeTiers(uint256[] memory tiers, uint256[] memory fees) internal {
        require(tiers.length == fees.length, "tier length != fee length");

        delete _feeTierThresholds;
        delete _feeTierValues;

        if (tiers.length == 0) return;

        uint256 prev;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tiers.length; i++) {
            require(fees[i] <= MAX_FEE, "Invalid fee");
            if (i > 0) {
                require(tiers[i] > prev, "only increasing order");
            }
            prev = tiers[i];
            _feeTierThresholds.push(tiers[i]);
            _feeTierValues.push(fees[i]);
        }
    }

    function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal {
        _roleAdmins[role] = adminRole;
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role][account]) return;
        _roles[role][account] = true;
        _roleMembers[role].push(account);
        _roleIndexPlusOne[role][account] = _roleMembers[role].length;
        emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role][account]) return;
        _roles[role][account] = false;

        uint256 idx = _roleIndexPlusOne[role][account];
        if (idx != 0) {
            uint256 i = idx - 1;
            uint256 last = _roleMembers[role].length - 1;
            if (i != last) {
                address lastMember = _roleMembers[role][last];
                _roleMembers[role][i] = lastMember;
                _roleIndexPlusOne[role][lastMember] = idx;
            }
            _roleMembers[role].pop();
            delete _roleIndexPlusOne[role][account];
        }

        emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transfer.selector, to, amount));
        require(ok, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (ret.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        require(ok, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (ret.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }
}
